definition: conjunction: and; also links clauses; in Arabic phrases read wa.
Preposition: in, at, into; also "door" as a noun in other contexts.
preposition: from, of, by, than; also marks source or cause.
conjunction and relative particle: that, which, who; introduces clauses of content, purpose or result.
Persian postposition marking the definite direct object; also marks dative or possessive in some constructions.
3rd person singular present of budan "to be"; is, exists; also used as copula after nouns and adjectives.
demonstrative pronoun/adjective: this, these.
Persian first-person pronoun; I, me; after a noun: my.
Arabic preposition: from, of, some of; also partitive.
Arabic relative/interrogative pronoun: he who, whoever; who? As in man yuẓhiruhu'lláh.
usage: In Arabic phrases of the Writings 'whoever, he who', above all in من یظهره الله 'Him Whom God shall make manifest', the Báb's title for the Promised One.

definition: adjective: divine, of God; also vocative "O my God" (iláhí). From iláh, god; root '-l-h.
usage: In the Writings 'divine', as in تعالیم الهی 'divine teachings' and فیوضات الهی 'divine bounties'; at the head of prayers الهی 'O my God'.

definition: Third-person singular pronoun: he, she, him, her; also possessive "his/her" after a noun.
adjective: blessed, holy; Bahá'í usage in Jamál-i Mubárak, the Blessed Beauty (Bahá'u'lláh). Root b-r-k.
usage: 'Blessed', applied to holy persons and places; Jamál-i-Mubárak جمال مبارک 'the Blessed Beauty' is Bahá'u'lláh, and ‘Abdu'l-Bahá uses it for His Father's writings and presence.

definition: Noun: matter, affair, command; Bahá'í usage: the Cause (of God). Root a-m-r.
usage: In the Writings usually 'the Cause', the Faith itself, as in امر الله 'the Cause of God' and امر مبارک 'the blessed Cause'; also God's command, or simply a matter or affair.

definition: demonstrative pronoun and adjective: that, it; opposite of ín (this).
Arabic particle: anna/inna "that, verily"; also in "if" and an "that (+verb)" depending on vowelling.
Noun: end, limit; in "dar niháyat" = with the utmost degree of, extremely. Root n-h-y.
usage: Mostly in در نهایت 'in the utmost', intensifying the following quality (در نهایت محبت 'with the utmost love'); also 'end, limit', as in بی‌نهایت 'infinite'.

definition: God; the Arabic name of the Deity, frequent in compounds such as Bahá'u'lláh and amru'lláh.
usage: The name of God, frequent in compounds such as بهاءالله 'the Glory of God', امرالله 'the Cause of God' and کلمة الله 'the Word of God'.

definition: Determiner: every, each, any; har du = both.
vocative particle: O!, used before an addressee, e.g. ay yár "O friend".
Preposition: on, upon, over; against; to (with certain verbs).
Verb: 3rd sg. past of búdan, to be; he/she/it was.
all, the whole, every one; adjective/noun. Root j-m-‘.
usage: 'All, the entirety', often before a plural, as in جمیع احبا 'all the friends' and جمیع ملل 'all nations'.

definition: personal pronoun: you (plural or polite singular); also your after a noun.
The Most Glorious; elative of bahí (glorious), with definite article; as in Bahá'u'lláh al-Abhá. Root b-h-w.
usage: Closes salutations: علیکم البهاء الابهی 'upon you be the Glory of the Most Glorious'; also in ملکوت الابهی 'the Abhá Kingdom'.

definition: conjunction/preposition: until, up to; so that, in order that.
Beauty, comeliness; Bahá'í usage: Jamál-i-Mubárak, the Blessed Beauty (Bahá'u'lláh). Root j-m-l.
usage: 'Beauty', in the Writings above all a title of Bahá'u'lláh: جمال مبارک 'the Blessed Beauty', جمال قدم 'the Ancient Beauty', جمال ابهی 'the Abhá Beauty'.

definition: Arabic: the glory, splendour, light; in "‘alaykum al-Bahá’ al-Abhá" the closing salutation. Root b-h-w.
usage: 'The Glory', the Greatest Name; in the closing salutation علیک البهاء الابهی and in بهاءالله 'the Glory of God'.

definition: verb: becomes, turns into; 3rd sg. present subjunctive of gashtan/gardídan.
verb: becomes, is (done); 3rd sg. subjunctive/present of shudan, also forms passives.
noun: cause, means, reason; "sabab gardad" = becomes the cause of. Root s-b-b.
usage: 'Cause, means', most often in سبب ... گردد / شود 'becomes the cause of', as in سبب هدایت 'the means of guidance'.

definition: Verbal noun: upbringing, education, training, nurture. Root r-b-w.
usage: 'Education, training', in ‘Abdu'l-Bahá's writings on the education of children (تربیت اطفال) and the spiritual and moral training of humanity; مربی is the educator.

definition: Honorific title before holy or eminent persons: His Holiness, presence. Root ḥ-ḍ-r.
usage: A title of reverence before holy persons: حضرت بهاءالله, حضرت اعلی 'the Báb', حضرت مسیح 'Christ'; also 'presence', as in در حضرت 'in the presence'.

definition: conjunction: if, in case.
past 3rd sg. of shudan: became, was; auxiliary forming passives.
3rd sg. present/subjunctive of namúdan: does, makes; shows; light verb with nouns.
usage: Light verb 'does, makes' after Arabic nouns (ملاحظه نماید 'consider', ظاهر نماید 'make manifest'); the formal equivalent of کند.

definition: preposition: with, together with, despite (bá vujúd).
Conjunction: but, however, yet.
contraction of ín ast: this is; often introduces a conclusion: "this is why".
Arabic preposition ‘alá with 2nd sg. pronoun; upon you, as in "‘alayka al-Bahá’", upon thee be the Glory.
usage: In salutations: علیک البهاء الابهی 'upon thee be the Glory of the Most Glorious', closing many Tablets of ‘Abdu'l-Bahá.

definition: Preposition: to, by, with, in; often prefixed as bi-.
Conjunction: because, for, since.
covenant, solemn pact; Bahá'í usage: the Covenant of Bahá'u'lláh. Root w-th-q.
usage: 'The Covenant', above all the Covenant of Bahá'u'lláh naming ‘Abdu'l-Bahá its Centre: مرکز میثاق 'the Centre of the Covenant', عهد و میثاق 'the Covenant', ثبوت بر میثاق 'firmness in the Covenant'.

definition: Noun: state, condition; adverbially "now, at present". Root ḥ-w-l.
usage: 'State, condition', and adverbially حال 'now', often introducing a new instruction (حال باید 'now you must').

definition: noun: motion, movement; departure, journey; action. Root ḥ-r-k.
usage: 'Motion, movement'; also departure on a journey (حرکت به امریکا) and action or conduct, as in حرکت بموجب تعالیم 'acting in accordance with the teachings'.

definition: noun: world, realm, universe; plural ‘aválim. Root ‘-l-m.
usage: 'World, realm', as in عالم انسانی 'the world of humanity', عالم بالا 'the world above', and عالم ملکوت 'the Kingdom'.

definition: 2nd person plural subjunctive/imperative of budan: be (you all), may you be.
verbal noun (form II) of ‘allama: teaching, instruction, education. Root ‘-l-m.
usage: 'Teaching, instruction'; its plural تعالیم is 'the Teachings' of Bahá'u'lláh, as in تعالیم الهی 'the divine Teachings'.

definition: Pronoun: you (2nd person singular, intimate); also your after izáfih.
plural of ḥabíb (aḥibbá') with izáfih; friends, loved ones; Bahá'í usage: the believers. Root ḥ-b-b.
usage: 'The friends', i.e. the Bahá'ís, as in احبای الهی 'the friends of God' and احبای رحمانی 'the friends of the Merciful'.

definition: modal verb: must, should, it is necessary; from báyistan.
Proper name: "Servant of Bahá", title of ‘Abbás Effendi (1844–1921), son of Bahá'u'lláh and Centre of the Covenant.
usage: The title 'Servant of Bahá' chosen by ‘Abbás Effendi, Centre of the Covenant; He signs His Tablets ع ع (‘Abdu'l-Bahá ‘Abbás).

definition: Negative particle: no, not; nah ... nah = neither ... nor; at sentence end: is not.
noun: soul, life, spirit; also "dear one".
usage: 'Soul, life', often in devotion: جان و دل 'heart and soul', جانفشانی 'self-sacrifice'; also an endearment 'dear'.

definition: noun: reality, truth, essence; dar ḥaqíqat = in truth. Root ḥ-q-q.
usage: 'Reality, truth', as in حقیقت انسانی 'the human reality', شمس حقیقت 'the Sun of Truth', and در حقیقت 'in truth'.

definition: Noun: love, affection, kindness. Root ḥ-b-b.
usage: 'Love', especially the love of God (محبت الله) and love among people, as in محبت و الفت 'love and fellowship'.

definition: Adverb: always, ever, continually.
conjunction: when, since, because; preposition: like, as.
3rd sg. subjunctive of búdan: (that) it be, may be, should be.
Adjective/adverb: other, another; further, any more, no longer (with negative).
noun: spirit, soul; rúḥ al-quds = Holy Spirit. Root r-w-ḥ.
usage: 'Spirit, soul', as in روح القدس 'the Holy Spirit', روح انسانی 'the human spirit', and the devotional روحی له الفداء 'may my spirit be a sacrifice for him'.

definition: preposition/adjective: like, similar to, resembling.
verb: became, was (made); past 3rd sg. of gardídan; also 2nd pl. subjunctive "may you become".
notes: verb, past 3rd sg. or 2nd pl. of gardídan

definition: Conjunction: or; in Arabic also vocative particle "O".
plural of yár: friends, companions; Bahá'í usage: the believers.
usage: 'Friends, companions', ‘Abdu'l-Bahá's warm Persian word for the believers, as in یاران الهی 'the friends of God' and یاران رحمانی.

definition: Number: one; also indefinite "a, a single".
Plural of núr; lights, rays, radiance. Root n-w-r.
usage: 'Lights', of divine grace or the Kingdom, as in انوار ملکوت 'the lights of the Kingdom' and انوار هدایت 'the lights of guidance'.

definition: adverb and adjective: very, much, many.
Honorific title for a man: His Honour, the respected; literally threshold, presence. Root j-n-b.
usage: A title of respect before a man's name, 'His Honour', in letters and greetings (جناب آقا ...); literally 'threshold, presence'.

definition: noun: the Kingdom, heavenly dominion, spiritual realm. Root m-l-k.
usage: 'The Kingdom', the spiritual realm, as in ملکوت ابهی 'the Abhá Kingdom' and ملکوت الهی 'the Kingdom of God'; also the destination of the departed (صعود به ملکوت).

definition: verb: did, made; past stem of namúdan, used as light verb after nouns (e.g. ẓáhir namúd).
Adverb: also, too, even; as prefix ham-: same, fellow (ham-vaṭan, compatriot).
2nd person singular subjunctive of gashtan/gardídan: may you become, that you become.
plural of ta’yíd (form II verbal noun): divine confirmations, assistance, strengthening. Root a-y-d.
usage: 'Confirmations', the divine assistance that aids those who serve, as in تأییدات ملکوت ابهی 'the confirmations of the Abhá Kingdom' and تأییدات الهیه.

definition: Numeral: two; har du = both.
verb: they become; 3rd pl. present subjunctive of shudan; also forms passives.
Arabic preposition: on, upon, over; in compounds like ‘ala'l-khuṣúṣ "especially". Also the name ‘Alí.
Proper name ‘Alí, "exalted"; common given name (e.g. Mullá Muḥammad-‘Alí). Root ‘-l-w.
Arabic phrase ‘alá (upon) + al-khuṣúṣ (the particular), used in Persian as one word: especially, particularly. Root kh-ṣ-ṣ.
usage: Especially, particularly; singles out the most important of the things just named.

definition: Arabic preposition: in, into, about; in Persian compounds such as fi'l-ḥaqíqih, in truth.
noun: heart, inner self. Root q-l-b.
usage: 'Heart', the seat of spiritual perception, as in قلب پاک 'a pure heart'; often paired with روح and جان.

definition: noun: existence, being; person; bá vujúd-i ín = despite this. Root w-j-d.
usage: 'Existence, being', as in عالم وجود 'the world of being'; also 'one's whole being' and با وجود 'despite'.

definition: conjunction: that, the fact that; az ínkih = because.
Preposition: for, for the sake of; often in "az baráy" (for).
2nd person singular imperative of rasándan: convey, deliver, transmit (greetings, a message).
usage: 'Convey', closing ‘Abdu'l-Bahá's letters: تحیت ابدع ابهی برسان 'convey the most wondrous Abhá greeting' to the friends.

definition: Noun: day, daytime; "shab va rúz" = night and day.
Adjective: bright, luminous, lit; clear, evident; "rawshan namúdan" to illumine.
usage: 'Bright, illumined', often spiritually: روشن گردد 'become illumined', in images of hearts and faces lit by the light of God.

definition: Arabic li- (to, for) + Alláh: to/for God; in al-ḥamdu li'lláh, praise be to God.
usage: In praise formulas: الحمد لله 'praise be to God'; also تقرباً لله 'for the sake of God'.

definition: the Messiah, Christ (Jesus); literally "the anointed". Root m-s-ḥ.
usage: 'Christ, the Messiah', usually حضرت مسیح 'His Holiness Christ', often in ‘Abdu'l-Bahá's talks and letters to Western believers.

definition: present 3rd pl. subjunctive of namúdan: (that) they do/make; common light verb.
usage: Light verb 'they do, make' after Arabic nouns, the formal equivalent of کنند.

definition: All, every, the whole; kullan, entirely. Root k-l-l.
usage: 'All, the whole', as in کل اهل عالم 'all the people of the world'; also substantively کل 'everyone'.

definition: verb: does, makes; 3rd sg. present subjunctive of kardan, common light verb.
Elative adjective: most glorious, most splendid; as in Malakút-i-Abhá, Jamál-i-Abhá. Root b-h-w.
usage: 'Most Glorious', the superlative of Bahá: ملکوت ابهی 'the Abhá Kingdom', جمال ابهی 'the Abhá Beauty', and the greeting الله ابهی 'God is Most Glorious'.

definition: Threshold, doorway, sacred court; Bahá'í usage: the Holy Threshold, servitude at the Shrine.
usage: 'Threshold', especially the Sacred Threshold of the holy Shrines; ‘Abdu'l-Bahá speaks of servitude at the Holy Threshold (عبودیت آستان مقدس).

definition: Adjective from ásmán (sky, heaven): heavenly, celestial.
usage: 'Heavenly, celestial', as in تعالیم آسمانی 'heavenly teachings' and نفوس آسمانی 'heavenly souls'.

definition: Arabic: the praise; in "al-ḥamdu li'lláh" praise be to God. Root ḥ-m-d.
usage: Mainly in الحمد لله 'praise be to God', expressing gratitude for news or bounties.

definition: conjunction: but, however; as for.
Plural of amah; maidservants; Bahá'í usage: women believers, handmaidens of the Merciful. Root '-m-w.
usage: 'Handmaidens', the women believers, chiefly in اماء الرحمن 'handmaidens of the Merciful', often paired with احبا (the men).

definition: Interrogative particle introducing a yes/no or rhetorical question; whether, is it that.
preposition and noun: after, afterwards; "ba‘d az" = after. Root b-‘-d.
Verb: 3rd pl. past of búdan, to be; they were.
adjective/noun: obtained, attained, resulting; ḥáṣil kardan = to obtain. Root ḥ-ṣ-l.
usage: 'Obtained, attained', mostly in compounds حاصل شود / گردد 'be attained' and حاصل کردن 'to obtain'.

definition: noun: truth, right; al-Ḥaqq, the Truth, i.e. God. Root ḥ-q-q.
usage: 'Truth, right'; as حق 'the Truth' a name of God, as in امر حق 'the Cause of God' and حق جل جلاله.

definition: noun: joy, gladness, delight. Root s-r-r.
usage: 'Joy, gladness', as in سبب سرور 'a cause of joy' and روح و ریحان و سرور; often the joy the friends' news brings ‘Abdu'l-Bahá.

definition: present 2nd sg. subjunctive of shudan: (that) you become.
noun: favour, grace, loving care, bounty (often divine). Root ‘-n-y.
usage: 'Grace, favour', usually divine, as in عنایت الهی 'divine grace' and به عنایت حق 'by the grace of God'.

definition: adverb: therefore, for this reason; Arabic li- "for" + hádhá "this".
usage: 'Therefore', introducing a conclusion or instruction in formal letters.

definition: Arabic relative/negative particle: what, that which; also not.
Persian first-person plural pronoun: we, us, our.
noun: centre, focal point; Markaz-i Mítháq = Centre of the Covenant. Root r-k-z.
usage: 'Centre', above all in مرکز میثاق 'the Centre of the Covenant', ‘Abdu'l-Bahá's station.

definition: Noun: observation, consideration, regard; "muláḥaẓih kardan/namúdan" to observe, consider. Root l-ḥ-ẓ.
usage: 'Consideration, regard', usually in ملاحظه نما / کنید 'consider, observe', calling attention to an example or truth.

definition: verbal prefix marking present or past continuous/habitual action, as in mí-kunam "I do".
Noun námih "letter, epistle" with izáfih (letter of…).
usage: 'Letter', in ‘Abdu'l-Bahá's acknowledgements: نامهٔ شما رسید 'your letter has arrived'.

definition: Plural of nafs; souls, persons, people. Root n-f-s.
usage: 'Souls, persons', as in نفوس مبارکه 'blessed souls' and نفوس مستعده 'receptive souls'.

definition: noun: light, radiance; spiritual illumination. Plural anvár. Root n-w-r.
usage: 'Light', divine and spiritual, as in نور هدایت 'the light of guidance' and نور حقیقت.

definition: conjunction/adverb: then, therefore, so; also behind, after.
Interrogative/exclamatory: what, what a!; chih ... chih = whether ... or.
Noun: book, scripture; "Kitáb" often the Holy Book. Root k-t-b.
usage: 'Book', often scripture: کتاب اقدس 'the Most Holy Book', کتاب عهدی 'the Book of the Covenant'; also any book.

definition: Verbal noun (form X): capacity, aptitude, readiness, potential. Root ‘-d-d.
usage: 'Capacity, receptivity', a key idea in ‘Abdu'l-Bahá's teaching that souls receive grace according to their capacity (به قدر استعداد).

definition: Adjective from insán (man, human being): human, of humankind. Root '-n-s.
usage: 'Human', as in عالم انسانی 'the world of humanity', وحدت عالم انسانی 'the oneness of humankind' and کمالات انسانی 'human perfections'.

definition: conjunction: that, the one who; "bá vujúd-i ánkih" = although.
Prefix bi- "to, in" + malakút "kingdom, realm" (the heavenly Kingdom). Root m-l-k.
usage: 'To/in the Kingdom', as in توجه بملکوت ابهی 'turning to the Abhá Kingdom'.

definition: proper noun: Khurasan, province of north-eastern Iran.
Reflexive pronoun: self, oneself, own; bi-khudí-i-khud = on one's own.
noun: heart, mind, inner self; "bi-ján u dil" = with heart and soul.
usage: 'Heart', often paired with جان: به جان و دل 'with heart and soul'; the heart illumined by the love of God.

definition: verb: arrived, reached, was received; past 3rd sg. of rasídan.
Noun: way, path, road; "dar sabíl-i" in the path of. Root s-b-l.
usage: 'Path', usually در سبیل 'in the path of', as in در سبیل الهی 'in the path of God' and جانفشانی در سبیل امر.

definition: noun: person, individual. Root sh-kh-ṣ.
Noun: side, part; "az qibal-i man" = on my behalf. Also qabl: before. Root q-b-l.
usage: In از قبل 'on behalf of', as in از قبل من 'on my behalf', when sending greetings.

definition: preposition/noun: like, similar to; a likeness, equal. Root m-th-l.
man + rá: me (as object), to me.
Noun: gift, bestowal, bounty, divine favour. Root w-h-b.
usage: 'Bounty, gift', usually divine, as in موهبت الهی 'divine bounty' and موهبت کبری 'the supreme bounty'.

definition: noun nafs "soul, person, self" + indefinite -í: a person, anyone, a soul. Root n-f-s.
usage: 'A soul, anyone', as in هر نفسی 'every soul' and نفسی که 'a person who'.

definition: past 3rd sg. / past stem of kardan: did, made; after báyad: one must do.
1st sg. past of kardan: I did, I made; light verb.
Adverb (with negative): never, not at all; otherwise "forever". Root '-b-d.
usage: 'Never, not at all' with a negative verb, as in ابداً جائز نه 'not at all permissible'.

definition: elative of ‘alí: most high, supreme; Ḥaḍrat-i A‘lá = the Báb; Qalam-i A‘lá = the Most Exalted Pen. Root ‘-l-w.
usage: 'Most Exalted', above all حضرت اعلی 'His Holiness the Exalted One', the Báb; also قلم اعلی 'the Supreme Pen' of Bahá'u'lláh.

definition: noun: sun, sunlight.
usage: 'Sun', often figuratively: آفتاب حقیقت 'the Sun of Truth', for the Manifestation of God.

definition: adverb: certainly, surely, of course. From Arabic al-battata.
Pronoun: they, those (persons); plural of án.
Enclitic copula/auxiliary, 3rd pl.: they are; forms present perfect (shudih-and, they have become).
pronoun: they, them, those (plural of án).
pronoun: that which, whatever (án + chih).
verb: comes; 3rd sg. present/subjunctive of ámadan.
bi- + khidmat: to/in the service (of). Root kh-d-m.
usage: 'To/in the service of', as in بخدمت امر قیام 'arising to serve the Cause'.

definition: conjunction: but rather, on the contrary; also perhaps, in the hope that.
proper name: Bahá’u’lláh, "Glory of God", Founder of the Bahá'í Faith (1817–1892).
usage: 'The Glory of God', title of Mírzá Ḥusayn-‘Alí, the Founder of the Bahá'í Faith; also جمال مبارک 'the Blessed Beauty'.

definition: Comparative of bih (good): better, preferable.
past 1st sg. of búdan: I was.
Preposition and prefix: without, -less (bí-‘aql, without reason).
Noun: greeting, salutation, salaam. Root ḥ-y-y.
usage: 'Greeting', in salutations such as تحیت ابدع ابهی 'the most wondrous Abhá greeting'.

definition: Verbal noun (form V): progress, advancement, ascent. Root r-q-y.
usage: 'Progress', material and spiritual, as in ترقیات روحانی 'spiritual progress' and ترقی عالم انسانی 'the advancement of humanity'.

definition: noun: life, existence, vitality. Root ḥ-y-y.
usage: 'Life', often spiritual, as in حیات ابدیه 'eternal life' and روح حیات 'the spirit of life'.

definition: Reflexive pronoun/adjective: one's own, self; also kinsman.
usage: 'One's own', the literary equivalent of خود.

definition: verb: has, possesses; 3rd sg. present of dáshtan.
noun: mention, remembrance; praise of God; zikr. Root dh-k-r.
usage: 'Mention, remembrance', as in ذکر الهی 'remembrance of God', in ذکر شد 'was mentioned', and in remembering souls by name.

definition: Past participle of shudan: become, been; forms passives (dádih shudih, has been given).
Noun: shade, shadow; shelter, protection ("under the shadow of"). Root ẓ-l-l.
usage: 'Shadow, shelter', as in در ظل امر 'under the shelter of the Cause' and ظل عنایت 'the shadow of grace'.

definition: Noun: love, passionate love, ardour. Root ‘-sh-q.
usage: 'Love, passionate love', the mystical love for God, as in آتش عشق 'the fire of love'.

definition: adjective: great, mighty, immense. Root ‘-ẓ-m.
usage: 'Great, mighty', as in امر عظیم 'the mighty Cause' and اسم اعظم from the same root.

definition: Plural of ‘aql; minds, intellects, reason. Root ‘-q-l.
usage: 'Minds, intellects', as in عقول و نفوس 'minds and souls' and in contrasts between human reason and divine knowledge.

definition: Noun: mother.
Noun/preposition: middle, midst; among, between ("dar miyán-i").
verb, 2nd pl. present/subjunctive of namúdan: you do, make, show (auxiliary verb).
usage: Light verb 'you do' after Arabic nouns (ملاحظه نمایید 'consider'); formal equivalent of کنید.

definition: verb, 3rd pl. past of namúdan: they did, made, showed; often auxiliary.
usage: Light verb 'they did'; with honorific plural for one exalted person, as in فرمودند.

definition: Adverb: also, too, likewise.
verb: is not; negative present 3rd sg. of "to be".
1st person singular present of hastan: I am.
adverb: likewise, also, in the same way.
Noun: unity, oneness. Root w-ḥ-d.
usage: 'Unity, oneness', as in وحدت عالم انسانی 'the oneness of humankind' and وحدت اصلیه 'essential unity'.

definition: adjective/adverb: such, thus, like this.
Imperative 2nd sg. of kardan: do, make; with noun: consider (muláḥaẓih kun).
3rd person plural present/subjunctive of kardan: they do, make; forms compound verbs.
verb, 3rd pl. subjunctive/present of gardídan/gashtan: (that) they become.
yik (one) + ḥarakat (motion, movement); one kind of motion. Root ḥ-r-k.
Inhabited, prosperous; place-name suffix (Ḥasan-Ábád, ‘Ishqábád).
noun: unity, union, oneness; verbal noun form VIII of root w-ḥ-d.
usage: 'Unity, union', as in اتحاد و اتفاق 'unity and concord' and اتحاد احبا 'the unity of the friends'.

definition: Noun: difference, disagreement, discord. Verbal noun of form VIII, root kh-l-f.
usage: 'Difference, discord', what the Teachings remove, as in رفع اختلاف 'removal of discord'.

definition: noun, plural of sirr: secrets, mysteries. Root s-r-r.
usage: 'Mysteries', as in اسرار الهی 'divine mysteries' and اسرار ملکوت 'the mysteries of the Kingdom'.

definition: Plural of ṭifl; children, infants. Root ṭ-f-l.
usage: 'Children', as in تربیت اطفال 'the education of children'.

definition: Plural of ufuq; horizons, regions of the world, the whole world. Root '-f-q.
usage: 'Horizons', the whole world, as in انتشار امر در آفاق 'the spread of the Cause throughout the world'.

definition: Plural of lawḥ; tablets; in Bahá'í usage the revealed Tablets (letters) of the Central Figures. Root l-w-ḥ.
usage: 'Tablets', the revealed letters of Bahá'u'lláh and ‘Abdu'l-Bahá, as in الواح مبارکه 'the blessed Tablets' and الواح وصایا 'the Will and Testament'.

definition: Arabic preposition: to, until; ila'l-abad = forever.
Arabic phrase ilá (to) + al-abad (eternity), used in Persian as one word: for ever, eternally. Root '-b-d.
usage: For ever, to all eternity; said of what endures without end, such as the Covenant or God's grace.

definition: Proper name: America, chiefly the United States.
Noun: assembly, gathering, society, council.
usage: 'Assembly, gathering', as in انجمن روحانی 'Spiritual Assembly' in early usage, and gatherings of the friends.

definition: noun: human being, man (humankind). Root a-n-s.
usage: 'Human being', in ‘Abdu'l-Bahá's teaching on the nobility and spiritual nature of man.

definition: proper noun: Iran, Persia.
Adjective/noun: noble, magnanimous, illustrious; that noble person.
usage: 'Noble, illustrious', a respectful term for an esteemed person, as in آن بزرگوار 'that noble one'.

definition: noun: servant, slave, bondsman; here with izáfih (bandiy-i, servant of).
usage: 'Servant', in humble self-designation and servitude to God, as in بندهٔ آستان 'servant of the Threshold'.

definition: Preposition: except, but, other than, nothing but.
God; Persian name for the Deity.
usage: 'God', the Persian name for the Deity, as in خدا را شکر 'thanks be to God'.

definition: verb: you (pl./polite) have; 2nd pl. present of dáshtan.
Noun: girl, daughter.
Adjective: of the All-Merciful, divine, heavenly. From raḥmán; root r-ḥ-m.
usage: 'Of the All-Merciful, spiritual', as in احبای رحمانی 'the spiritual friends' and نفوس رحمانی 'heavenly souls'.

definition: divine name: the All-Merciful, the Compassionate; "imá’-i Raḥmán" = handmaids of the Merciful. Root r-ḥ-m.
usage: The All-Merciful, as in اماء الرحمن 'handmaidens of the Merciful' and بندگان رحمن.

definition: noun: time, age, epoch; dar zamán-i = in the time of.
usage: 'Time, age', as in در این زمان 'in this age' and in references to the present Dispensation.

definition: noun: night; "shab u rúz" = night and day.
Noun: the East, Orient; sunrise. Root sh-r-q.
usage: 'The East', often with غرب in calls to the unity of East and West (شرق و غرب).

definition: noun: child, infant; pl. aṭfál. Root ṭ-f-l.
Arabic: upon you (pl.); ‘alá + -kum; in greetings such as ‘alaykum Bahá'u'l-Abhá.
usage: In the salutation علیکم البهاء الابهی 'upon you be the Glory of the Most Glorious'.

definition: noun: outpouring, bounty, grace, abundance. Root f-y-ḍ.
usage: 'Grace, outpouring', as in فیض الهی 'divine grace'; plural فیوضات 'bounties'.

definition: verbal noun: rising, standing up; arising to serve (qiyám namúdan). Root q-w-m.
usage: 'Arising', above all to serve the Cause: قیام بر خدمت امر 'arising to serve the Cause'.

definition: Noun: return, going back; "murája‘at namúdan" to return. Root r-j-‘.
usage: 'Return', from a journey, as in مراجعت به ایران.

definition: English loanword Mister, title before a man's name.
adjective (form II passive participle): holy, sanctified, sacred. Root q-d-s.
usage: 'Holy, sacred', as in ارض مقدس 'the Holy Land' and آستان مقدس 'the Sacred Threshold'.

definition: noun: kindness, affection, loving greetings.
usage: 'Kindness, loving greetings', often in conveying ‘Abdu'l-Bahá's affection: نهایت مهربانی 'utmost kindness'.

definition: Verb, 3rd sg. present of shudan: becomes, is (made); passive auxiliary.
Noun: spreading, diffusion, publication. Root n-sh-r.
usage: 'Spreading', as in نشر نفحات الله 'diffusing the fragrances of God' and نشر تعالیم 'spreading the teachings'.

definition: Plural of naṣíḥat; counsels, admonitions, advice. Root n-ṣ-ḥ.
usage: 'Counsels, exhortations', as in نصایح و وصایا 'counsels and exhortations' of ‘Abdu'l-Bahá.

definition: Look, sight, regard, consideration; naẓar kardan, to look. Root n-ẓ-r.
usage: 'Look, regard', as in نظر عنایت 'the glance of favour' and نظر به 'in view of'.

definition: plural of nafḥa: breaths, fragrances, sweet scents (of God's Cause). Root n-f-ḥ.
usage: 'Fragrances', the spiritual influence of the Cause, as in نشر نفحات الله 'diffusing the fragrances of God', i.e. teaching the Faith.

definition: past 2nd sg. of namúdan: you did/made.
adjective: greatest, supreme; feminine elative of kabír (masc. akbar). Root k-b-r.
usage: 'Greatest, supreme', as in موهبت کبری 'the supreme bounty' and آیت کبری 'the greatest sign'.

definition: Indefinite or relative suffix -í written after final h (e.g. khiṭábih-’í "a talk", daraj-ih-’í).
Verbal noun (form IV): conveying, delivering a message; ablágh dáshtan, to convey. Root b-l-gh.
usage: 'Conveying', usually ابلاغ دار / نما 'convey' greetings or a message.

definition: Plural of athar; traces, signs, effects; writings, works. Root '-th-r.
usage: 'Traces, signs', and the writings of the Central Figures, as in آثار مبارکه 'the sacred Writings'.

definition: Arabic noun with article: the truth, reality; "fi'l-ḥaqíqa" = in truth, truly. Root ḥ-q-q.
usage: In فی الحقیقه 'in truth, truly'.

definition: Arabic noun with article; in ‘ala'l-khuṣúṣ, especially, particularly. Root kh-ṣ-ṣ.
usage: In علی الخصوص 'especially, particularly'.

definition: Arabic: the ransom, sacrifice; rúḥí lahu'l-fidá' = may my life be a sacrifice for him. Root f-d-y.
usage: In devotional formulas such as روحی له الفداء 'may my spirit be a sacrifice for him', said of Bahá'u'lláh or a holy one.

definition: noun umíd (hope) + -am (my): my hope.
plural of yawm: days; time, period. Root y-w-m.
usage: 'Days, time', as in این ایام 'these days' and ایام الله 'the Days of God'.

definition: 3rd person plural subjunctive of budan: that they be, may they be.
Noun from bakhshídan: giving, bounty, generosity; forgiveness.
usage: 'Bounty, generosity', often divine, as in بخشش الهی 'divine bounty'.

definition: noun: proof, demonstration, decisive argument. Root b-r-h-n.
usage: 'Proof', as in دلیل و برهان 'proof and argument' for the truth of the Cause.

definition: Adjective/noun from Bahá: Bahá'í, follower of Bahá'u'lláh.
usage: 'Bahá'í', of or follower of Bahá'u'lláh.

definition: Plural of Bahá'í; followers of Bahá'u'lláh.
usage: 'Bahá'ís', the followers of Bahá'u'lláh.

definition: Adverb: completely, wholly, altogether; bi- plus kullí (total). Root k-l-l.
Verb, 2nd pl. imperative of kúshídan: strive, endeavour, exert yourselves.
usage: 'Strive', urging the friends to effort in service, as in بکوشید تا 'strive that'.

definition: adjective: firm, steadfast, established, proven. Active participle of root th-b-t.
usage: 'Firm, steadfast', especially in the Covenant: ثابت بر میثاق 'firm in the Covenant'.

definition: Noun: world, universe.
usage: 'World', as in جهان انسانی 'the human world'.

definition: adjective: straight, upright, right, true.
adjective: spiritual, of the spirit. Root r-w-ḥ.
usage: 'Spiritual', as in محفل روحانی 'Spiritual Assembly' and فضائل روحانی 'spiritual virtues'.

definition: rúḥ + -í: my spirit; rúḥí lahu'l-fidá' = may my spirit be his sacrifice.
usage: In روحی له الفداء 'may my spirit be a sacrifice for him', a devotional formula after the name of a holy one.

definition: noun: journey, travel, trip. Root s-f-r.
usage: 'Journey', including ‘Abdu'l-Bahá's travels to the West (سفر امریکا).

definition: verb: they became, were; past 3rd pl. of shudan.
noun: sun; "shams-i ḥaqíqat" = Sun of Truth. Root sh-m-s.
usage: 'Sun', mostly figuratively in شمس حقیقت 'the Sun of Truth', for the Manifestation of God.

definition: adjective: manifest, apparent, visible; outward. Active participle of root ẓ-h-r.
usage: 'Manifest, apparent', as in ظاهر شد 'became manifest'; also 'outward' contrasted with باطن 'inward'.

definition: Sultan ‘Abdu'l-Ḥamíd II, Ottoman sultan (r. 1876–1909) who kept ‘Abdu'l-Bahá imprisoned.
noun: the West, west; the Occident. Root gh-r-b.
usage: 'The West', often with شرق in calls to the unity of East and West.

definition: Active participle: educator, trainer, one who nurtures. Root r-b-w; related to tarbiyat.
usage: 'Educator', as in مربی عالم 'the educator of the world', for the Manifestations of God.

definition: Passive participle (form II): aided, granted success, enabled. Root w-f-q.
usage: 'Aided, granted success' by God, in prayers that the friends be موفق و مؤید 'aided and confirmed'.

definition: adjective (form II passive participle): confirmed, aided, strengthened (by God). Root a-y-d.
usage: 'Confirmed, strengthened' by God, as in مؤید و موفق 'confirmed and aided'.

definition: verb: you know; 2nd sg. present of dánistan with prefix mí-.
verb: (he) used to say/command; honorific plural, past imperfective of farmúdan.
usage: 'Used to say', the honorific plural for words of Bahá'u'lláh or another exalted one.

definition: Verb: 3rd pl. present of kardan, to do/make; they do, they are making.
negative present 3rd sg. subjunctive of búdan: (if) there be not, should not be.
Preposition: near, with, in the presence of, before.
2nd person singular subjunctive of namúdan: you do/make; auxiliary in compound verbs.
usage: Light verb 'you do' after Arabic nouns; formal equivalent of کنی.

definition: Verb, 1st sg. past of namúdan: I did, made, performed (auxiliary in compound verbs).
usage: Light verb 'I did' after Arabic nouns; formal equivalent of کردم.

definition: past participle of namúdan: done, made; forms perfect tenses.
usage: Light verb 'done' forming perfect tenses after Arabic nouns; formal equivalent of کرده.

definition: Adjective: one, single, unified. Root w-ḥ-d.
usage: 'One, single', as in یک روح واحد 'one single spirit' and in teaching on the oneness of humanity.

definition: adjective/adverb: such, so, in that way; "chunán ast kih" = it is such that.
Verb: 2nd pl. present/subjunctive/imperative of kardan, to do/make; used in compound verbs.
Interrogative: where is? (rhetorical: where now is ...?).
usage: 'Where is?', in rhetorical laments such as 'where now are the kings of the past?'.

definition: Conjunction: that is, namely, i.e. (Arabic "it means"). Root ‘-n-y.
plural of ḥabíb: friends, loved ones; Bahá'í usage: the believers. Root ḥ-b-b.
usage: 'The beloved ones, the friends', the Bahá'ís, as in احباء الله 'the friends of God'.

definition: Noun/adjective: rest, repose, calm, peace; "árám giriftan" to find rest.
noun árizú "wish, longing, hope" with izáfih: the wish of.
usage: 'Wish, longing', as in آرزوی عبدالبهاء 'the wish of ‘Abdu'l-Bahá'.

definition: noun: foundation, basis. Root '-s-s.
usage: 'Foundation', as in اساس امر الله 'the foundation of the Cause of God' and اساس الهی.

definition: noun: origin, root, essence; dar aṣl = originally, in essence. Root '-ṣ-l.
usage: 'Origin, essence', as in اصل اساس 'the very foundation' and در اصل 'in essence'.

definition: Verbal noun (form IV): expression, declaration, showing; "iẓhár kardan" to express. Root ẓ-h-r.
usage: 'Expression, declaration', in اظهار محبت 'showing love' and اظهار امر 'the declaration of the Cause'.

definition: verbal noun (form IV): raising, exalting; i‘lá'-i kalimatu'lláh = exalting the Word of God. Root ‘-l-w.
usage: 'Exalting', as in اعلاء کلمة الله 'exalting the Word of God', the promotion of the Cause.

definition: Arabic particle: except, but; va'llá = otherwise.
Arabic: eternity; "ila'l-abad" forever. Root '-b-d.
usage: In الی الابد 'forever'.

definition: noun: affection, fellowship, familiarity, harmony. Root '-l-f.
usage: 'Fellowship, affection', usually paired: محبت و الفت 'love and fellowship'.

definition: Noun with article: holiness, sanctity; in Rúḥu'l-Quds, the Holy Spirit. Root q-d-s.
usage: 'Holiness', in روح القدس 'the Holy Spirit' and ارض القدس 'the Holy Land'.

definition: 3rd sg. past of ámadan: came; dar mayán ámad, arose.
umídvár (hopeful) + -am: I am hopeful, I hope.
usage: 'I hope', ‘Abdu'l-Bahá's frequent prayerful wish for the friends: امیدوارم که 'I hope that'.

definition: noun: people, followers, inhabitants; ahl-i Bahá = the people of Bahá. Root '-h-l.
usage: 'People, followers', as in اهل بهاء 'the people of Bahá' and اهل عالم 'the peoples of the world'.

definition: Verb, 2nd sg. subjunctive of búdan: (that) you be.
Adjective: remaining, lasting, enduring; "báqí mándan" to remain. Root b-q-y.
usage: 'Lasting, enduring', as in باقی و برقرار 'abiding and established', contrasted with فانی 'transient'.

definition: preposition bi "to, with" + ín "this": to this, with this.
Pronoun/adjective: some, certain ones. Root b-‘-ḍ.
preposition bi- + mújib: in accordance with, by virtue of. Root w-j-b.
usage: 'In accordance with', as in بموجب تعالیم 'according to the teachings'.

definition: imperative 2nd sg. of kúshídan: strive! endeavor!
usage: 'Strive!', urging a believer to effort in service.

definition: Verb: 3rd sg. subjunctive of ámadan, to come; that it come, may come.
noun: influence, effect, impression. Root '-th-r.
usage: 'Influence, effect', the power of the Word of God and of deeds over hearts (تأثیر کلمة الله).

definition: noun: self-sacrifice, devotion, literally scattering one's life.
usage: 'Self-sacrifice', devoted service to the Cause, as in جانفشانی در سبیل امر.

definition: Noun: body, physical form, matter. Root j-s-m.
usage: 'Body', contrasted with روح 'spirit' in teaching on the spiritual and physical worlds.

definition: noun: splendour, shining forth, manifestation; "jilvih namúdan" = to shine forth. Root j-l-w.
usage: 'Splendour, shining forth', as in جلوه نمود 'shone forth', of divine light or attributes.

definition: noun: freedom, liberty. Root ḥ-r-r.
usage: 'Freedom', including ‘Abdu'l-Bahá's release from imprisonment after the Young Turk revolution.

definition: Adjective: real, true, genuine. Root ḥ-q-q.
usage: 'Real, true', as in محبت حقیقی 'true love' and بهائی حقیقی 'a true Bahá'í'.

definition: noun: service; presence (of a superior). Root kh-d-m.
usage: 'Service', above all service to the Cause (خدمت امر الله) and to humanity; also 'presence', as in بخدمت ... 'to the presence of'.

definition: Comparative of khush: pleasanter, happier, better.
Past participle of dádan: given; va‘dih dádih shudih, has been promised.
Imperative 2nd sg. of dáshtan: have, keep; ablágh dár, convey.
verb, 3rd pl. present of dáshtan: they have, possess.
Past stem / 3rd sg. past of dáshtan: had, held; with nouns forms compound verbs (mabdhúl dásht).
notes: verb, 3rd sg. past or infinitive stem of dáshtan

definition: Divine name: the All-Merciful, the Compassionate; "imá'-i Raḥmán" handmaids of the Merciful. Root r-ḥ-m.
usage: The All-Merciful, as in اماء رحمان 'handmaidens of the Merciful' and بندگان رحمان.

definition: active participle: shining, radiating; evident. Root s-ṭ-‘.
usage: 'Shining, radiating', of divine lights: انوار ساطع 'radiant lights'.

definition: Noun: tree; figuratively the Tree of the Cause. Root sh-j-r.
usage: 'Tree', figuratively the Tree of the Cause or of life, as in شجرهٔ امر 'the Tree of the Cause'.

definition: noun: candle, taper; figurative lamp of guidance.
usage: Literally a candle; in the Writings often a figure for the light of guidance, as in شمع هدایت 'the candle of guidance', and for the believer who burns away in service.

shift: Here: the ascension, the passing of a holy or noble soul to the next world. Today: ascent, rising, climbing (death is درگذشت).
definition: verbal noun: ascent; Bahá'í usage: ascension, passing (death) of a holy or noble soul. Root ṣ-‘-d.
usage: In the Writings the ascension or passing of a holy soul, as in صعود جمال مبارک 'the Ascension of Bahá'u'lláh'; in modern Persian usually a physical rise or climb.

definition: Noun: weakness, frailty, infirmity. Root ḍ-‘-f.
usage: Weakness or frailty, often of the body or of human capacity, set against divine power and confirmation (تأیید).

definition: Noun: side, direction, part; "az ṭaraf-i man" = on my behalf. Root ṭ-r-f.
usage: A side or direction; in letters often in از طرف 'on behalf of', as when greetings are conveyed on someone's behalf.

definition: Noun: servitude, servitude to God, devotion. Root ‘-b-d.
usage: Servitude to God; ‘Abdu'l-Bahá's chosen station, as in عبودیت آستان مقدس 'servitude at the Sacred Threshold', rendered 'servitude'.

definition: Noun: glory, honour, might, dignity. Root ‘-z-z.
usage: Glory, honour or might; used of divine glory and of the honour God bestows, as in عزت ابدیه 'everlasting glory'.

definition: adjective: dear, beloved; mighty, honoured. Root ‘-z-z.
usage: Dear or beloved, often in address to the believers (یاران عزیز 'dear friends'); also the divine name 'the Mighty'.

definition: Plural of ‘aqídih; beliefs, doctrines, convictions. Root ‘-q-d.
usage: Beliefs or doctrines, often the inherited creeds of peoples that the Writings ask to be independently investigated.

definition: noun: banner, standard, flag; ‘alam-i Mítháq = banner of the Covenant. Root ‘-l-m.
usage: A banner or standard, as in علم امر الله 'the banner of the Cause of God' and the raising of the standard of the Faith.

definition: noun: knowledge, learning, science. Root ‘-l-m.
usage: Knowledge or learning, both divine knowledge and acquired science; the Writings stress the acquisition of علم and its harmony with religion.

definition: noun: loftiness, exaltation, elevation. Root ‘-l-w.
usage: Exaltation or loftiness, used of the elevated station of the Cause or of souls, often paired with سمو.

definition: noun: sciences, branches of knowledge; plural of ‘ilm. Root ‘-l-m.
usage: The sciences or branches of learning, as in علوم و فنون 'sciences and arts', which the Writings urge the friends to acquire.

definition: noun: deed, action, work; "‘amal gardad" = be acted upon. Root ‘-m-l.
usage: A deed or act; the Writings stress deeds over words, and the phrase اعمال طیبه 'goodly deeds' is common.

definition: noun: booty, prize; ghanímat shumurdan/dánistan = to treasure, seize as an opportunity. Root gh-n-m.
usage: Literally booty; in the Writings used in غنیمت شمردن 'to count as a boon', urging the friends to seize the precious opportunity.

definition: Noun: grace, bounty, excellence; learning, merit. Root f-ḍ-l.
usage: God's grace or bounty, freely given and not earned, as in فضل الهی 'divine bounty'; often contrasted with عدل 'justice'.

definition: noun: century, age, era. Root q-r-n.
usage: A century or age, as in قرن انوار 'the century of light' used of this Dispensation.

definition: Noun: shortcoming, failure, neglect, negligence. Root q-ṣ-r.
usage: Shortcoming or failing, often in humble self-reference to one's shortcomings in service.

definition: Noun: pen, reed-pen; "qalam-i Mítháq" the Pen of the Covenant. Root q-l-m.
usage: A pen; capitalised as 'the Pen' for the Pen of the Most High (قلم اعلی), the revelation of Bahá'u'lláh.

definition: Plural of qalb; hearts. Root q-l-b.
usage: Hearts, the seat of faith and love; common in phrases of attraction and illumination of hearts (قلوب منجذب).

definition: Strength, power, might. Root q-w-y.
usage: Power or strength, often the power of the Covenant or of the Holy Spirit that sustains the believers.

definition: quvvih with izáfih: power, faculty, force of. Root q-w-y.
usage: Construct form 'the power of', as in قوهٴ روح القدس 'the power of the Holy Spirit' or قوهٴ ملکوت 'the power of the Kingdom'.

definition: Arabic negative particle: no, not; lá iláha illá'lláh.
Arabic li- + -hu: to/for him; in rúḥí lahu'l-fidá, my spirit be a sacrifice for him.
Conjunction: but, however (Arabic lákin).
Active participle used as noun: obstacle, hindrance, preventer. Root m-n-‘.
usage: An obstacle or hindrance; often in negative phrases saying nothing can hinder the progress of the Cause.

definition: mubárak "blessed" + ast "is": is blessed; in jamál-i-mubárak-ast "is of the Blessed Beauty".
usage: Blessed (is); مبارک is used throughout the Writings for what is holy, as in جمال مبارک 'the Blessed Beauty'.

definition: active participle: one who explains; Mubayyin-i Kitáb = Interpreter of the Book. Root b-y-n.
usage: 'The Interpreter' (مبیّن آیات), the title of ‘Abdu'l-Bahá as authorised interpreter of Bahá'u'lláh's Writings under the Covenant.

definition: adjective: clear, manifest, evident; kitáb-i mubín = the lucid book. Root b-y-n.
usage: Clear or manifest, a Qur'anic epithet (کتاب مبین 'the perspicuous Book'), often rendered 'perspicuous' or 'manifest'.

definition: Passive participle (form IV): executed, carried out; mujrá dáshtan, to accord, show. Root j-r-y.
usage: Carried out or put into effect, as in مجری داشتن 'to carry out' laws or instructions.

definition: the Prophet Muhammad; also a common personal name. Root ḥ-m-d (praised).
usage: The Prophet Muḥammad; also a common personal name of believers.

definition: adjective (passive participle): blamed, blameworthy, reprehensible. Root dh-m-m.
usage: Blameworthy or reprehensible, of qualities to be avoided, often contrasted with ممدوح 'praiseworthy'.

definition: passive participle: wronged, oppressed, victim of injustice. Root ẓ-l-m.
usage: Wronged or oppressed; a title Bahá'u'lláh uses for Himself ('this Wronged One'), and used of the persecuted believers.

definition: noun: place of appearance; manifestation, embodiment; Maẓhar = Manifestation of God. Root ẓ-h-r.
usage: 'Manifestation', as in مظهر الهی / مظهر امر 'the Manifestation of God', the Prophet who reflects God's attributes.

definition: Passive participle: known, evident, clear. Root ‘-l-m.
usage: Known or evident; frequent in معلوم است 'it is evident'.

definition: Passive participle: intended, purpose, aim; the desired goal, the Beloved. Root q-ṣ-d.
usage: Purpose or intent; also 'the Desired One', as in مقصود عالمیان 'the Desire of the worlds'.

definition: Meeting, encounter, visit. Root l-q-y (form III).
usage: Meeting; used of meeting the friends and of attaining the presence (لقاء) of God's Manifestation.

definition: adjective: waiting, expecting, awaiting. Form VIII participle of root n-ẓ-r.
usage: Awaiting; used of peoples awaiting the Promised One and of the expectation of a reply or of confirmations.

definition: particle: except, unless; in questions: can it be that, do they not.
Title before a name: Mr., learned man; after a name: prince.
usage: A Persian title of nobility or learning placed before names, as in میرزا حسینعلی (Bahá'u'lláh's given name).

definition: verb: I used to do, I was doing; 1st sg. past imperfective of kardan.
verb: does, makes; present 3rd sg. of kardan.
noun: letter, epistle; writing.
usage: A letter; ‘Abdu'l-Bahá often refers to letters received from the friends (نامهٴ شما 'your letter') in His replies.

definition: Negative 3rd person singular present of dáshtan: does not have.
notes: verb, negative 3rd sg. present of dáshtan

definition: Noun: soul, self, person; one individual ("yak nafs"). Root n-f-s.
usage: The soul or self; also a person (نفوس 'souls'); in a negative sense the selfish self (نفس و هوی 'self and passion').

definition: noun: growth, development, used in nashv-u-namá "growth and development"; also present stem of namúdan.
usage: Growth or development, often paired with نشو (نشو و نما 'growth and development') for spiritual progress.

definition: verb, 3rd pl. negative present/subjunctive of namúdan: they do not do/make.
adjective: luminous, radiant, spiritual, full of light. From núr. Root n-w-r.
usage: Luminous or radiant, of souls, hearts and gatherings illumined by faith (نفوس نورانی 'luminous souls').

definition: Noun: guidance, leading aright; "hidáyat kardan" to guide. Root h-d-y.
usage: Divine guidance, as in نور هدایت 'the light of guidance' and the guidance of souls to the Cause.

definition: conjunction: although, even if, however much.
3rd person plural present of hastan: they are.
noun: endeavor, resolve, high aspiration, effort. Root h-m-m.
usage: High endeavour or resolve, as in همت نمایید 'exert yourselves'; ‘Abdu'l-Bahá urges the friends to show high endeavour in service.

definition: Adjective/pronoun: all, every, everyone; "hamih já" everywhere.
Conjunction: but, however (Arabic wa-lákin).
Proper name: Paris, capital of France, visited by 'Abdu'l-Bahá in 1911 and 1913.
usage: The city of Paris, which ‘Abdu'l-Bahá visited in 1911 and 1913.

definition: Noun: father; pidar va mádar, parents.
usage: Father; also used figuratively of God's loving care and of ‘Abdu'l-Bahá's fatherly love for the friends.

definition: Noun: ray, beam, radiance; reflection, effect.
usage: A ray of light, often of divine grace (پرتو عنایت 'the ray of bounty').

definition: Noun: message, tidings.
usage: A message, including the divine message delivered to humanity and greetings conveyed between believers.

definition: past 3rd pl. of kardan: they did/made.
past participle of kardan: done, made; used in perfect tenses.
Pronoun: someone, anyone; with negative, no one.
noun: perfection, completeness; bi-kamál-i = with utmost. Root k-m-l.
usage: Perfection, also 'utmost' in بکمال; used of human and spiritual perfection.

definition: Plural of kamál; perfections, virtues, accomplishments. Root k-m-l.
usage: Perfections or virtues, as in کمالات انسانی 'human perfections' and کمالات روحانی 'spiritual perfections'.

definition: Verb, 3rd sg. past of gashtan: became, turned; was (passive auxiliary).
Noun: flower, rose. (Also gil: clay, in other contexts.)
usage: A flower or rose; figuratively the believers and spiritual virtues, as in gardens of the heart.

definition: verb: you (sg.) find, attain; 2nd sg. subjunctive of yáftan; with nouns forms compounds (ta‘míd yábí, be baptized).
Certainty, assurance; certain. Root y-q-n.
usage: Certainty or certitude of faith, as in ایقان 'certitude' (cf. Kitáb-i-Íqán); also 'certain'.

definition: pronoun: one, someone; "yakí ... yakí" = one ... another.
Feminine adjective of abadí: eternal, everlasting. Root '-b-d.
usage: Everlasting, often in عزت ابدیه 'everlasting glory' and حیات ابدیه 'eternal life'.

definition: noun: son, son of; in names like Ibn-i Abhar, Ibn-i Aṣdaq. Root b-n-y.
usage: 'Son of', mainly in names and Arabic phrases; in the Writings also in ابن آدم 'son of man'.

definition: noun: respect, honour, reverence. Form VIII of root ḥ-r-m.
usage: Respect or reverence, as shown to parents, teachers and to all religions.

definition: Plural of idrák; perceptions, understandings, faculties of comprehension. Root d-r-k.
usage: Perceptions or powers of understanding, of the human mind and spirit.

definition: contraction of az ín: from this, of this.
Plural of sabab: causes, means, provisions. Root s-b-b.
usage: Means or causes, as in اسباب 'the means' God has provided; also equipment.

definition: Verbal noun (form X): steadfastness, constancy, uprightness. Root q-w-m.
usage: Steadfastness, especially firmness in the Covenant (استقامت بر امر الله).

definition: adjective: evident, manifest, clear, apparent.
usage: Manifest or evident; used of signs and truths made plain, as in آشکار گردید 'became manifest'.

definition: adjective: greatest, most great; elative of ‘aẓím. Root ‘-ẓ-m.
usage: 'Most Great', as in اسم اعظم 'the Most Great Name' and صلح اعظم 'the Most Great Peace'.

definition: verbal noun (form IV): announcement, proclamation, declaration. Root ‘-l-n.
usage: Proclamation or announcement, as of the Cause or of the Covenant.

definition: Plural of ‘amal; deeds, actions, conduct. Root ‘-m-l.
usage: Deeds or actions; the Writings ask that the friends' deeds, not words, show their faith (اعمال طیبه).

definition: Noun/title: master, sir, gentleman; title before a name.
usage: A Persian title 'master' or 'sir'; in the Writings also Áqá as a title of ‘Abdu'l-Bahá (سرکار آقا 'the Master').

definition: Noun: clime, region, land, country.
usage: A clime or region; often in phrases about the spread of the Cause to all climes.

definition: adjective: the Most High, the Most Exalted; elative of ‘alí. Root ‘-l-w. E.g. al-qalam al-a‘lá.
usage: 'The Most Exalted', as in ربی الاعلی and the title حضرت اعلی for the Báb.

definition: Plural of luṭf; favours, kindnesses, graces. Root l-ṭ-f.
usage: Favours or kindnesses, especially divine favours (الطاف الهیه).

definition: noun: imparting, conveying, casting; ilqá kardan "to impart, inspire". Form IV verbal noun of root l-q-y.
usage: Imparting or instilling, as of spiritual teachings or ideas into hearts.

definition: feminine form of iláhí: divine, of God.
usage: Divine, Arabic feminine form used after Arabic plurals, as in تعالیم الهیه 'divine teachings'.

definition: Adjective: faithful, trustworthy; also a personal name (Ḥájí Amín). Root '-m-n.
usage: Trustworthy; trustworthiness (امانت) is a central virtue in the Writings; also title of the Trustee of Ḥuqúqu'lláh (امین حقوق).

definition: verbal noun (form VIII): spreading, dissemination, publication. Root n-sh-r.
usage: Spreading or diffusion, as in انتشار نفحات الله 'the diffusion of the divine fragrances'.

definition: Adverb: there, that place.
Arabic phrase: if God wills, God willing.
usage: 'God willing', a Qur'anic formula; used to express hope that a matter will come to pass with divine help.

definition: Arabic restrictive particle: only, indeed, verily.
Noun: importance, significance. Root h-m-m.
usage: Importance, used to stress the significance of a matter.

definition: ú "he/him" + ast "is": he is; it is his.
adjective/adverb: first, beginning; firstly. Root '-w-l.
usage: First; also 'the First' as a divine attribute.

definition: plural of yatím: orphans. Root y-t-m.
usage: Orphans, whose care is enjoined in the Writings.

definition: present 3rd pl. subjunctive of ámadan: (that) they come; bi-ihtizáz áyand = be stirred.
ín "this" + maqám "station, place, case": in this regard, at this point.
usage: 'In this station' or 'at this point', used to introduce a statement on a theme.

definition: gate, door; Ḥaḍrat-i Báb = the Báb, Herald of the Bahá'í Faith. Root b-w-b.
usage: The Báb, 'the Gate', title of the Forerunner of Bahá'u'lláh; also a gate.

definition: adverb: in short, anyhow, at any rate (resumes the discourse).
usage: 'In short', 'in brief', a transition summarising what has been said.

definition: bi- + amr: to/in the Cause; amr = command, matter, the Cause (of God). Root '-m-r.
usage: 'To the Cause', as in خدمت بامر الله 'service to the Cause of God'.

definition: bi- (to, in) + án (that): to that, in it, thereto.
Prefix bi- "to" + ú "him/her": to him, to her.
Verb, 3rd sg. subjunctive of tábídan: (may it) shine, radiate.
usage: Used of the light of the Sun of Truth shining forth on hearts and regions.

definition: bi (with) + ján (soul, life); bi-ján va dil, with heart and soul.
usage: 'With the soul', in بجان و دل 'with heart and soul'; urges wholehearted service.

definition: preposition: for, for the sake of, because of; "bi-jihat-i" = on account of. Root w-j-h.
Verb, 2nd pl. imperative of dánistan: know! appreciate.
preposition: without; Arabic bi + dún.
verb: convey, deliver (pl./polite); imperative 2nd pl. of rasándan.
Plural of bishárat; glad tidings; Tablet of Bishárát. Root b-sh-r.
usage: Glad tidings, as of the coming of the Promised One or news of the progress of the Cause.

definition: noun: humanity, mankind, human being. Root b-sh-r.
usage: Mankind or humanity, as in عالم بشر 'the world of humanity' and وحدت عالم بشر 'the oneness of mankind'.

definition: bi + qadr: to the extent of, as much as; bi-qadr-i-imkán, as far as possible.
bi- + quvvat: with/by the power (of). Root q-w-y.
usage: 'With the power', as with the power of the Covenant or of the Holy Spirit.

definition: bi- (with) + quvvat (power, strength) + indefinite -í; with a power. Root q-w-y.
usage: 'With a power', describing a power beyond human means.

definition: Preposition bi- (to) + man (I, me): to me, unto me.
noun: structure, edifice, foundation. Root b-n-y.
usage: An edifice or foundation, as in بنیان صلح 'the edifice of peace' or of the Cause.

definition: Glory, splendour; ahl-i-Bahá, the people of Bahá (Bahá'ís). Root b-h-w.
usage: 'Glory' or 'Splendour', the Greatest Name, as in بهاءالله 'the Glory of God' and the greeting الله ابهی.

definition: Past participle of búdan: been; búdih ast, has been.
Prefix bi- "with" + kamál "perfection": with the utmost, perfectly. Root k-m-l.
usage: 'With the utmost', as in بکمال محبت 'with the utmost love'.

definition: verbal noun (form V): being affected, emotion, sorrow. Root '-th-r.
usage: Grief or sorrow; in the Writings expressions of deep sorrow at a passing or a calamity; modern sense 'being affected'.

definition: verbal noun (form V): sorrow, grief, lamenting. Root ḥ-s-r.
usage: Regret or lamentation, often for lost opportunities.

definition: Verbal noun: bearing, enduring, forbearance; with fart/kardan, to endure. Root ḥ-m-l.
usage: Forbearance or endurance of hardship and tests.

definition: verbal noun (form VI): difference, disparity. Root f-w-t.
usage: Difference; used of the differences in human capacity and degree.

definition: Verbal noun (form II): sanctification, holiness, sanctity. Root q-d-s.
usage: Sanctity or holiness, as in تقدیس و تنزیه 'sanctity and purity'.

definition: noun: turning towards, attention, orientation. Form V of root w-j-h.
usage: Turning, especially turning the heart to God or to the Kingdom (توجه بملکوت).

definition: noun: gathering, collection; jam‘ kardan/shudan = to gather. Root j-m-‘.
usage: Gathering or assembled; also 'plural' and جمع شدن 'to gather'.

definition: noun: direction, aspect, respect; reason (az ín jihat = for this reason). Root w-j-h.
usage: Respect, aspect or reason; in بجهت 'for the sake of' and از جهت 'in respect of'.

definition: noun: ignorance. Root j-h-l.
usage: Ignorance, contrasted with knowledge and named as a cause of prejudice and strife.

definition: particle: even; until, up to.
Noun: beauty, goodness, excellence; also in place name Ḥasan-Ábád. Root ḥ-s-n.
usage: Goodliness or beauty, as in حسن اخلاق 'goodly character'.

definition: Proper name Ḥasan ("good"); here in the place name Ḥasan-Ábád.
Plural of ḥaḍrat; honourable persons, those people (often ironic). Root ḥ-ḍ-r.
usage: Plural of حضرت, used for respected persons or groups, 'those souls' or 'the gentlemen'.

definition: noun: government, rule, authority. Root ḥ-k-m.
usage: Government; the Writings enjoin obedience to just government.

definition: active participle: servant, one who serves. Root kh-d-m.
usage: Servant; used humbly of the believers' service to the Cause and to humanity.

definition: Danger, peril, risk. Root kh-ṭ-r.
Noun/adverb: summary, essence; in short, to sum up. Root kh-l-ṣ.
usage: 'In brief', a transition summarising a letter's points.

definition: Noun: creation, created beings; people, mankind. Root kh-l-q.
usage: The people or creation; also the act of creating.

definition: 3rd person singular present of kháhán; future auxiliary "will" or "wants".
verb, 1st sg. present of kh(w)ástan: I want, ask; also future auxiliary "I will".
verb, 2nd sg. present of kh(w)ástan; auxiliary forming the future: you will.
noun: happiness, pleasure, joy; from khush "pleasant".
usage: Happiness or joy, as a spiritual gift of faith.

definition: Adjective: knowing, wise, learned; a sage.
usage: Wise or knowing; also a divine attribute (خدای دانا 'the All-Knowing God').

definition: Plural of dukhtar; girls, daughters.
usage: Girls or daughters; the Writings stress the education of girls.

definition: Noun: hand; "dast dar ághúsh" = arm in arm, embracing.
usage: Hand; in phrases like دست بدست 'hand in hand' and figuratively of aid.

definition: Noun: prayer, supplication, invocation. Root d-‘-w.
usage: Prayer or supplication, as in دعا و مناجات; also a blessing invoked on someone.

definition: Loanword: dollar.
usage: Dollar, in references to contributions or expenses in America.

definition: Noun: proof, evidence, sign; guide. Root d-l-l.
usage: Proof or evidence, as of the truth of the Manifestation.

definition: Plural of dígar: others, other people.
Atom, mote, particle; the least amount. Root dh-r-r.
usage: An atom or mote, used as a figure for the smallest thing or for humility.

definition: noun: rest, comfort, ease. Root r-w-ḥ.
usage: Rest or comfort; often of forgoing comfort for service.

definition: Noun: Lord, master; God. Root r-b-b.
usage: 'Lord', a title of God, as in ربّ الجنود 'Lord of Hosts' and in prayers یا ربّ 'O Lord'.

definition: Plural of rúḥání; spiritual souls; Bahá'í usage: the believers.
usage: 'Spiritual ones', souls of the spiritual world or spiritually minded believers.

definition: rúz + indefinite -í: a day, one day; az rúzí kih = since the day that.
noun: face, countenance; also "on, upon" as preposition (rú-yi).
usage: Face; also in روی بخدا 'turning one's face to God'.

definition: noun: sweet basil, fragrant herb; rúḥ u rayḥán = joy and fragrance, spiritual delight. Root r-w-ḥ.
usage: Sweet herb or fragrance, a figure for spiritual delights (روح و ریحان 'joy and fragrance').

definition: adjective: alive, living; zindih shudan = to come to life.
usage: Alive, especially spiritually alive through faith.

definition: noun: head; top; also sar nihádan "to place on the head".
usage: Head; also in idioms such as سر و جان 'head and soul'.

definition: noun: secret, mystery, inner essence. Root s-r-r.
usage: A mystery or secret, as in سرّ الله (a title of ‘Abdu'l-Bahá, 'the Mystery of God').

definition: Lamp, light. Root s-r-j.
usage: A lamp, often of divine guidance.

definition: feminine form of sarmadí: eternal, everlasting.
usage: Everlasting, often paired with ابدیه.

definition: Adverb: perhaps, maybe; also "is fitting" (báyad va sháyad, as it should and befits).
shakhṣ "person" + indefinite -í: a person, someone. Root sh-kh-ṣ.
usage: A person or someone.

definition: Noun: severity, intensity, vehemence. Root sh-d-d.
usage: Intensity or severity, as of tests or of love.

definition: Pronoun shumá "you" with plural -há: you (all).
noun: testimony, witness; martyrdom. Root sh-h-d.
usage: Testimony or witness; also martyrdom.

definition: Active participle: issuing, proceeding, emanating; issued. Root ṣ-d-r.
usage: Issued; of a Tablet or command issued (صادر شد).

definition: Noun: health, soundness; correctness. Root ṣ-ḥ-ḥ.
usage: Health, also truth or validity.

definition: Adjective: explicit, clear, unequivocal. Root ṣ-r-ḥ.
usage: Explicit, as in نصوص صریحه 'explicit texts' and the clear words of the Covenant.

definition: noun: non-existence, nothingness; absence, lack. Root ‘-d-m.
usage: Nothingness or non-existence, contrasted with وجود 'existence'.

definition: noun: knowledge, recognition (esp. of God), mystical understanding. Root ‘-r-f.
usage: Recognition or knowledge of God, as in عرفان الله, the first duty of every soul.

definition: noun: age, era, epoch; also afternoon. Root ‘-ṣ-r.
usage: Age or era, as in عصر نورانی 'this luminous age'; also afternoon.

definition: Arabic ‘alá + -kunna: upon you (feminine plural); ‘alaykunna'l-Bahá'.
adjective: transient, mortal, evanescent; effaced (in God). Root f-n-y.
usage: Perishable or evanescent; contrasts the transient world with the eternal.

definition: noun: opportunity, leisure, free time. Root f-r-ṣ.
usage: Opportunity; urges the friends to seize the moment for service.

definition: noun: religious duty, obligation; farḍ-i ‘ayn = individual obligation. Root f-r-ḍ.
usage: A binding duty or obligation, as in فرض است 'it is obligatory'.

definition: 3rd person singular past of farmúdan (honorific "to do, say, command"); used for holy persons.
usage: Honorific 'said' or 'did'; used of the Manifestation or ‘Abdu'l-Bahá, rendered 'hath said'.

definition: proper name: Dr. Amínu'lláh Faríd; as adjective, unique, peerless. Root f-r-d.
noun: innate nature, natural disposition, original constitution. Root f-ṭ-r.
usage: Innate nature, the inborn disposition of man.

definition: adjective/noun: poor, needy; a poor one, humble before God. Root f-q-r.
usage: Poor; also spiritual poverty before God.

definition: Pronoun: such-and-such person, so-and-so (often referring to oneself discreetly).
noun faná with izáfih: annihilation, passing away, effacement of self. Root f-n-y.
usage: Annihilation or evanescence (of self), a Sufi term for self-effacement before God.

definition: Fikr (thought) + indefinite -í: a thought, any thought. Root f-k-r.
active participle: cutting, decisive, conclusive; "naṣṣ-i qáṭi‘" = conclusive text. Root q-ṭ-‘.
usage: Decisive or conclusive, as in برهان قاطع 'conclusive proof'.

definition: noun: kind, sort, part, division. Root q-s-m.
usage: A kind or type.

definition: Arabic negative particle making a verb future: will not, never (lan yataghayyar, will never change).
verb, 3rd sg. present/subjunctive of mándan: remains, stays.
Active participle (form VIII): united, at one. Root w-ḥ-d.
usage: United, of the believers united in love and in purpose.

definition: adjective (form VIII participle): agreed, united, in accord. Root w-f-q.
usage: Agreed or united, of hearts in accord.

definition: noun: assembly, gathering-place, meeting. Root j-m-‘.
usage: A gathering or assembly.

definition: proper name: Marv (Merv), ancient city of Khurasan, now in Turkmenistan.
usage: A city in Khurásán.

definition: adjective: glad, happy, joyful. Passive participle of root s-r-r.
usage: Joyous or happy; common in wishes for the friends' happiness.

definition: English title Mrs. transliterated into Persian script.
English title Mrs. written in Persian script.
Active participle: assured, confident, at peace. Root ṭ-m-'-n.
usage: Assured, of hearts certain of divine confirmation.

definition: Noun: station, rank, position, place; "dar ín maqám" = in this respect. Root q-w-m.
usage: Station or rank, as in the station of the Manifestation; also a holy place or shrine (مقام اعلی 'the Shrine of the Báb').

definition: feminine of muqaddas: holy, sacred; used with plurals like maẓáhir. Root q-d-s.
usage: Holy, feminine form used after Arabic plurals.

definition: Adjective from malakút: of the Kingdom, heavenly, celestial. Root m-l-k.
usage: Celestial or of the Kingdom (ملکوت).

definition: adjective (form IV active participle): possible. Root m-k-n.
usage: Possible; also contingent being in philosophy (ممکن vs. واجب).

definition: adjective (form VII participle): attracted, enraptured, drawn. Root j-dh-b.
usage: Enraptured or attracted, especially to the Kingdom of God (منجذب بملکوت).

definition: noun: virtue, merit, praiseworthy quality. Root n-q-b.
usage: A virtue or praiseworthy quality.

definition: noun: seal, signet; stamp used on tablets.
usage: A seal or stamp; also used figuratively.

definition: noun: love, affection, kindness; also the sun.
usage: Love or kindness; also the sun.

definition: Passive participle: promised; the Promised One. Root w-‘-d.
usage: 'The Promised One', the awaited Manifestation of all religions.

definition: noun: field, arena, square.
usage: An arena or field, often of service or of tests.

definition: Verb, 3rd sg. present of rasídan: reaches, arrives.
verb, 1st sg. present of kardan: I do, I make.
Noun: deliverance, rescue, salvation. Root n-j-w.
usage: Salvation or deliverance, spiritual or worldly.

definition: noun: call, summons, cry; nidá kardan = to call out. Root n-d-w.
usage: The call, as in ندای الهی 'the divine call' raised to humanity.

definition: Arabic plural: women.
usage: Women; the Writings stress the equality of women and men.

definition: verb: did not become, was not; negative past 3rd sg. of shudan.
notes: verb, negative past 3rd sg. of shudan

definition: adjective/noun: like, similar, equal, peer; "naẓír-i" = such as. Root n-ẓ-r.
usage: Like or peer, often in بی‌نظیر 'peerless'.

definition: Plural nufús "souls, persons" + indefinite -í: some souls.
usage: Souls or persons, as in نفوسی که 'souls who'.

definition: verb: does not remain; negative 3rd sg. subjunctive (or past) of mándan.
1st sg. present/subjunctive of namúdan: (that) I do, make.
abstract noun: radiance, luminosity, spirituality. From núrání. Root n-w-r.
usage: Luminosity or spirituality, the radiance of souls.

definition: Verb, 3rd sg. past of nivishtan: wrote.
Noun: kind, species, sort; "naw‘-i bashar" humankind. Root n-w-‘.
usage: A kind or species, as in نوع بشر 'humankind'.

definition: Noun/adjective: shining, luminous; luminary, sun. Root n-w-r.
usage: A luminary, as in نیّر اعظم 'the Most Great Luminary' for the Manifestation.

definition: Negative 1st person singular present of hastan: I am not.
Pronoun: whatever, however much; "har-chih tarbiyat shavad" = however much it is trained.
Numeral: thousand.
verb: is, exists; present 3rd sg. of "to be" (existential).
Adjective/pronoun: no, none, any (with negative); nothing.
plural of wajh: faces; aspects. Root w-j-h.
usage: Faces, in Arabic phrases on the illumination of faces (وجوه نورانی).

definition: Time, moment; har vaqt, whenever. Root w-q-t.
Noun: nurture, upbringing, rearing; "parvarish yáftan" to be raised. From parvardan.
usage: Nurture or education, as in the nurturing of children and spiritual growth.

definition: Loanword: professor, title before a name.
Noun: son, boy.
Noun: refuge, shelter, protection.
usage: Refuge or shelter, often in God's protection.

definition: numeral: five.
Noun: money, coin.
noun: foot, trace; "pay dar pay" = one after another, continuously.
usage: After or in pursuit of.

definition: interrogative: why?
noun chashmih "spring, fountain" + izáfih: the fountain of.
usage: A spring or fountain of; figurative for divine sources of life and knowledge.

definition: Numeral: four.
noun kitáb (book) + indefinite -í: a book. Root k-t-b.
Adjective: crooked, bent, twisted.
usage: Crooked, as in going astray.

definition: Church (from Greek ekklesia), with izáfih; kalísiyá-yi muvaḥḥidín, Unitarian church.
usage: The church of; used of churches where ‘Abdu'l-Bahá spoke.

definition: Plural of kanísih: churches, synagogues.
1st person singular present/subjunctive of kardan: I do, make; auxiliary in compound verbs.
Verb, 2nd sg. subjunctive/present of kardan: (that) you do, make.
Verb, 1st pl. subjunctive/present of kardan: (that) we do, make.
Noun: jewel, gem, pearl; essence, substance.
usage: A gem or jewel; figurative for the essence of virtues and of man.

definition: verb: they find, attain; 3rd pl. subjunctive of yáftan; parvarish yáband = be reared.
noun: friend, companion, beloved; plural yárán.
usage: A friend; in the Writings یاران 'friends' means the believers.

definition: Verb, 3rd sg. past of yáftan: found, obtained; auxiliary "came to be" (vuṣúl yáft = arrived).
Elative: most wondrous, most excellent; taḥíyyat-i-abda‘-i-abhá. Root b-d-‘.
usage: Most wondrous or unprecedented, as in بدیع.

definition: Feminine adjective abadíyyih with izáfih: eternal, everlasting. Root '-b-d.
usage: Everlasting, often of glory or life.

definition: verbal noun (form VIII): agreement, concord, unity; also occurrence. Root w-f-q.
usage: Concord or agreement, as in اتحاد و اتفاق 'unity and concord'.

definition: Verbal noun: need, want, necessity. Root ḥ-w-j.
Ikhtiláf (difference) + indefinite -í: any difference or disagreement. Root kh-l-f.
usage: Any difference or disagreement, which the Writings urge to avoid.

definition: plural of adab: manners, culture, good conduct. Root '-d-b.
usage: Manners or courtesy (ادب), a virtue stressed in the Writings.

definition: Plural of ra’y: opinions, views. Root r-'-y.
usage: Opinions or views; also votes.

definition: Noun: wish, desire, hope, longing.
usage: Wish or longing, as for meeting or for service.

definition: Plural of rukn; pillars, foundations, limbs; one's whole being. Root r-k-n.
usage: Pillars or foundations, as of the Cause or of society.

definition: verbal noun (form VIII): hearing, listening. Root s-m-‘.
usage: Hearkening or listening, as to the divine call.

definition: noun: name; "ism-i a‘ẓam" = the Greatest Name. Root s-m-w.
usage: A name; in the Writings also the divine Names and اسم اعظم 'the Most Great Name'.

definition: Verbal noun (form VIII): mistake, error; confusion, doubt. Root sh-b-h.
usage: An error or mistake.

definition: Verbal noun (form VIII): longing, yearning, eagerness. Root sh-w-q.
usage: Longing or yearning, of the heart for God.

definition: Verbal noun (form IV): dawning, shining forth, illumination. Root sh-r-q.
usage: Dawning or shining, as of the Sun of Truth.

definition: noun, plural of áshná: acquaintances; ironic áshnáyán-i bígánih = estranged acquaintances.
Plural of ṭaraf; sides, directions, surroundings, all quarters. Root ṭ-r-f.
usage: Sides or regions, as in اطراف عالم 'all parts of the world'.

definition: Plural of ṭifl with indefinite -í: (some) children. Root ṭ-f-l.
usage: Children, whose education is stressed.

definition: verbal noun: tranquillity, assurance, certitude, confidence. Root ṭ-m-n.
usage: Assurance or certainty of heart.

definition: Verbal noun (form VIII): belief, conviction, creed. Root ‘-q-d.
Plural of ‘uḍv with izáfih: members, limbs of. Root ‘-ḍ-w.
usage: Members of an assembly or body.

definition: Noun: embrace, bosom, lap.
usage: An embrace, as in آغوش محبت 'embrace of love'.

definition: adjective: dejected, withered, frozen.
noun: horizon; pl. áfáq. Root '-f-q.
usage: The horizon, as in افق اعلی 'the Supreme Horizon'.

definition: noun: thoughts, ideas; plural of fikr. Root f-k-r.
Verbal noun (form IV): establishing, setting up, adducing (proof). Root q-w-m.
usage: Establishing, as in اقامه برهان 'establishing proof'.

definition: al- + adhkár (plural of dhikr): remembrances, devotions; Mashriqu'l-Adhkár = House of Worship. Root dh-k-r.
usage: Remembrances or invocations of God.

definition: Arabic adverb: now, at present; "ilá al-án" = until now.
Arabic noun with article: confirmation, divine assistance. Root '-y-d.
usage: Divine confirmation, as in تأییدات الهیه.

definition: Arabic relative pronoun (masc. sg.): who, which, he who.
Arabic relative pronoun, masculine plural: those who.
Arabic: the man; ayyuha'r-rajul = O man. Root r-j-l.
Arabic noun with article: forgiveness, pardon. Root gh-f-r.
Arabic: the virtues, excellences; in the name Abu'l-Faḍá'il (Mírzá Abu'l-Faḍl). Root f-ḍ-l.
noun: god, deity; in lá iláha illá huwa "there is no God but He". Root '-l-h.
usage: God or deity, as in لا اله الا الله.

definition: iláhí (divine) + ast (is): is divine, is of God.
enclitic 1st sg. of búdan "am"; after a past participle forms the present perfect (kardih am = I have done).
Plural of imtiḥán; tests, trials, ordeals. Root m-ḥ-n.
usage: Tests or trials that strengthen faith.

definition: Adverb/noun: today, this day.
usage: Today or this Day, in the Writings 'this Day' of God.

definition: Verbal noun: possibility; "‘álam-i-imkán" the contingent world. Root m-k-n.
usage: The contingent world (عالم امکان), creation as opposed to God.

definition: Noun: hope, hopefulness, expectation.
Arabic pronoun 2nd m. sg.: you, thou.
verbal noun (form VII): attraction, rapture, being drawn. Root j-dh-b.
usage: Attraction or rapture, especially to the Kingdom.

definition: Insání (human) + object marker rá written joined: the human (world/reality) as object.
án (that) + ast (is): it is that, it is due to that.
Verbal noun (form VII): detachment, severance (from worldly things). Root q-ṭ-‘.
usage: Detachment from all save God.

definition: Arabic inna (verily) + -ka (you): verily You (are).
noun, plural: inhabitants, people of a place. Root '-h-l.
usage: Inhabitants or people of a place.

definition: Noun: voice, song, melody.
usage: Voice or song; often poetic, as in آواز بلبل 'the song of the nightingale' and the call or voice of the Kingdom (آواز ملکوت).

definition: Plural of varaq; leaves, sheets, papers, writings. Root w-r-q.
usage: Leaves or sheets, used of letters and writings (اوراق 'pages') and of the leaves of trees in imagery of spiritual spring.

definition: Plural of vahm: idle fancies, superstitions, vain imaginings. Root w-h-m.
usage: 'Vain imaginings' or idle fancies, the superstitions and false beliefs that veil people from truth; often paired with ظنون 'idle fancies'.

definition: elative of kabír: greater, greatest; also name component (‘Alí-Akbar). Root k-b-r.
usage: 'Greatest', as in الله اکبر 'God is Most Great' and اسم اکبر 'the Most Great Name'; also part of personal names such as علی‌اکبر.

definition: Verbal noun (form IV): faith, belief. Root '-m-n.
usage: 'Faith' or belief in God and His Manifestation, often paired with ایقان 'certitude'; in Bahá'í usage recognition of the Manifestation joined with obedience.

definition: adverb: here, this place.
ín (this) + khuṣúṣ (matter, respect): in this regard.
ín (this) + muddat (period, time).
Arabic vocative particle: O (followed by a noun with article, e.g. ayyuha'r-rajul).
adverb: again, still; adjective: open (báz kardan = to open).
bi (to) + ástán: to the (Holy) Threshold.
usage: 'To the Threshold', the Sacred Threshold of the Shrines; used in phrases of servitude such as عبودیت آستان مقدس 'servitude at the Sacred Threshold'.

definition: bi- (to) + án (that) + ṣafaḥát (pages; regions): to those parts, to that land.
usage: 'To those regions'; صفحات is used for lands or parts of the world, as in صفحات امریک 'the regions of America'.

definition: bi- + ihtizáz (stirring, quivering, rapture): be stirred. Root h-z-z.
usage: Rapture or quivering motion; به اهتزاز آمدن 'to be stirred, to vibrate', often of hearts or the world stirred by the Word of God.

definition: bi "to" + awj "zenith, summit": to the height.
usage: 'To the zenith'; in phrases of spiritual ascent such as به اوج عزت 'to the height of glory'.

definition: bi "by, through" + tarbiyat "education, training". Root r-b-w.
usage: Education or training (تربیت), a key concept in the Writings: divine and moral education of souls, as in تربیت الهی 'divine education'.

definition: bi- + ta‘lím: through teaching, by instruction. Root ‘-l-m.
usage: Teaching or instruction; تعلیم و تربیت 'education and training' of children is often stressed.

definition: bi "to" + já "place": bi-já ávardan "to carry out, fulfil".
usage: Used in the compound بجا آوردن 'to carry out, fulfil', e.g. of performing duties, prayers or ordinances.

definition: bi- "to" + janáb "his honour" (title before names): to the honoured.
usage: Janáb, 'his honour', a respectful title placed before names of addressees in Tablets, as in جناب آقا ...

definition: Adjective: pure, sheer, absolute, unmixed. Root b-ḥ-t.
usage: 'Sheer, pure, absolute', usually with abstract nouns such as عدم بحت 'utter nothingness' or فقر بحت.

definition: past 3rd sg. of bakhshídan: gave, bestowed.
usage: 'Bestowed', used of God granting bounty, life or confirmation, as in حیات بخشید 'gave life'.

definition: verb: wants, wishes, seeks; 3rd sg. subjunctive of khwástan.
Verb: 3rd sg. present/subjunctive of bar-khástan, to rise up; also to be removed, vanish.
usage: 'Arise', frequent in exhortations to arise to serve the Cause (بر خدمت امر برخیزد); also 'to be removed', of veils or enmity.

definition: 3rd sg. subjunctive of rasídan: (that) it reach, arrive.
usage: 'Attain, reach', used of reaching a station, receiving a letter, or attaining the divine presence.

definition: bi- "by, with, to" + rúḥ "spirit": by/through the spirit. Root r-w-ḥ.
usage: Spirit (روح), as in روح القدس 'the Holy Spirit' and روح ایمان 'the spirit of faith'; with به 'through the spirit'.

definition: noun: appearance, manifestation, emergence. Root b-r-z.
usage: Appearance or manifestation, as in بروز و ظهور 'appearance and manifestation' of qualities or of divine signs.

definition: bi- + sabab: because of, by means of. Root s-b-b.
usage: 'Because of, by reason of'; سبب 'cause' also appears in سبب نجات 'the cause of salvation'.

definition: Preposition bi- + sitáyish (praise): to/in praise; "bi-sitáyish pardákhtan" to engage in praising.
usage: Praise (ستایش) of God; به ستایش پرداختن 'to engage in praise'.

definition: Noun: good news, glad tidings. Root b-sh-r.
