usage: 'Glad tidings', especially news of the coming of the Kingdom or of the new Revelation; بشارات 'prophecies, glad tidings' of past scriptures.

definition: Inner sight, discernment, insight. Root b-ṣ-r.
usage: Inner 'insight' or discernment, the spiritual eye that recognizes truth, as in چشم بصیرت 'the eye of insight'.

definition: bi- (to/in) + ‘ubúdiyyat (servitude to God, servanthood). Root ‘-b-d.
usage: 'Servitude' to God and to the Threshold, which ‘Abdu'l-Bahá claimed as His highest station (عبودیت آستان مقدس).

definition: noun baqá "continuance, permanence, eternity" + izáfih. Root b-q-y.
usage: 'Everlastingness, permanence', the opposite of فنا 'evanescence'; e.g. بقای روح 'the immortality of the soul'.

definition: noun: spot, place, site; buq‘iy-i mubárakih = the holy spot. Root b-q-‘.
usage: 'Spot, site', esp. a holy place, as in بقعهٴ مبارکه 'the blessed spot' and بقعهٴ نوراء 'the luminous spot'.

definition: bi "by" + quvvih "power, strength" + izáfih. Root q-w-y.
usage: Power or strength, as in بقوهٴ الهی 'through the power of God' and قوهٴ روح القدس.

definition: Adjective: high, lofty, loud; buland shudan, to be raised.
usage: 'High, lofty, loud', e.g. ندای بلند 'a loud call' and بلند شدن 'to be raised'.

definition: bi (to) + Mistar (Mr., from English).
bi- + manzilih + izáfih: in the position of, like, as. Root n-z-l.
usage: 'As, in the station of', as in بمنزلهٴ روح 'like the spirit' and بمنزلهٴ شمس 'as the sun'.

definition: bi- + miyán: into the middle; bi-miyán ámadan = to arise, come up.
usage: 'Into the midst'; بمیان آمدن 'to arise, come up', of a matter or question.

definition: Foundation, building with izáfih; bináy-i ... guzáshtan, to start, lay the foundation of. Root b-n-y.
usage: 'Foundation, edifice', as in بنای ملکوت 'the edifice of the Kingdom' and بنیان 'foundation'; also بنا گذاشتن 'to lay the foundation'.

definition: Prefix bi- "with, by" + nafaḥát "fragrances, breaths" (plural of nafḥa). Root n-f-ḥ.
usage: 'Breaths, fragrances', usually of God's grace: نفحات الله 'the breaths of God', نفحات قدس 'holy breaths'.

definition: bi + niháyat: with the utmost, extremely.
usage: 'With the utmost', an intensifier, as in بنهایت محبت 'with the utmost love'.

definition: Noun: glory, splendour, light; in "Bahá’u'lláh" and greetings "Bahá’u'lláh al-Abhá". Root b-h-w.
usage: 'Glory', the Greatest Name; in بهاءالله 'the Glory of God', یا بهاء الأبهی, and the salutation علیه بهاء الله 'upon him be the Glory of God'.

definition: bi- + hamín: in/with this very same.
verb: say!, tell; imperative of guftan.
usage: 'Say!', often introducing words the reader is to speak or a message to convey; parallels Arabic قل.

definition: bi- + yád: in remembrance of, mindful of.
usage: 'In remembrance of'; بیاد آوردن 'to remember', as in remembering friends in prayer.

definition: verb: adorn!, embellish; 2nd pl. imperative of árástan.
usage: 'Adorn ye', in exhortations to adorn oneself with virtues, e.g. به اخلاق رحمانی بیارایید 'adorn yourselves with divine qualities'.

definition: Noun: house, home; also a verse of poetry. Root b-y-t.
usage: 'House', as in بیت الله 'the House of God', بیت العدل 'the House of Justice' and بیت مبارک 'the Blessed House'; also a verse of poetry.

definition: adjective/noun: stranger, alien, foreign, estranged.
usage: 'Stranger, alien', contrasted with آشنا 'friend, familiar'; the Writings urge treating none as a stranger (بیگانه).

definition: noun: summer.
Verbal noun (form II): compiling, authoring a book; composition. Root '-l-f.
usage: Composition or compilation of books; also 'bringing together', as in تألیف قلوب 'uniting of hearts'.

definition: Feminine adjective of támm: complete, perfect, entire. Root t-m-m.
usage: 'Complete, perfect', agreeing with feminine or plural nouns, as in قدرت تامه 'full power'.

definition: noun ta'yíd (confirmation, divine assistance) + indefinite -í. Root '-y-d.
usage: 'Confirmation', the divine assistance promised to those who serve, often in تأیید و توفیق 'confirmation and success'.

definition: verbal noun (form II): change, transformation, exchange. Root b-d-l.
usage: 'Change, transformation', e.g. تبدیل اخلاق 'transformation of character'.

definition: verbal noun (form II): writing, composing, drafting. Root ḥ-r-r.
usage: 'Writing', especially of letters and Tablets: تحریر نامه 'writing a letter'.

definition: verbal noun (form II): inciting, urging, encouraging. Root ḥ-r-ṣ.
usage: 'Exhortation, urging', as in تحریص و تشویق 'exhortation and encouragement' to service.

definition: verbal noun (form II): acquisition, attainment, study. Root ḥ-ṣ-l.
usage: 'Acquisition', of knowledge or virtues, as in تحصیل علوم 'acquiring the sciences'.

definition: Comparative suffix: more, -er (lázim-tar, more necessary).
verbal noun (form II): promoting, propagating, spreading. Root r-w-j.
usage: 'Promotion, spreading', e.g. ترویج امر الله 'the promotion of the Cause of God' and ترویج تعالیم.

definition: Verbal noun (form II): encouragement, inciting, arousing desire. Root sh-w-q.
usage: 'Encouragement', of believers to teach and serve; often with تحریص.

definition: noun: supplication, humble entreaty. Form V of root ḍ-r-‘.
usage: Humble 'supplication', often in تضرع و ابتهال 'supplication and entreaty' before God.

definition: Plural of ta‘lím; teachings, instructions. Root ‘-l-m.
usage: 'Teachings', especially the Teachings of Bahá'u'lláh (تعالیم بهاءالله, تعالیم الهی).

definition: adjective: whole, all, complete, entire. Root t-m-m.
Plural of tawfíq; divine aid, success, favourable confirmations. Root w-f-q.
usage: Divine 'confirmations' and success granted by God, as in توفیقات الهیه 'divine confirmations'.

definition: noun: duty, obligation, charge. Root k-l-f.
usage: 'Duty, obligation', esp. a religious duty; تکلیف 'what is required' of the believers.

definition: noun: steadfastness, firmness; establishment, proof. Root th-b-t.
usage: 'Steadfastness', usually in ثبوت و رسوخ 'firmness and steadfastness' in the Covenant.

definition: Noun: place; "hamih já" = everywhere.
Adjective: eternal, everlasting.
usage: 'Everlasting', as in حیات جاودانی 'everlasting life' and عزت جاودانی 'eternal glory'.

definition: verbal noun (form III): dispute, quarrel, contention. Root j-d-l.
usage: 'Contention, dispute', forbidden in the Writings, often in نزاع و جدال 'strife and contention'.

definition: Adjective: new. Root j-d-d.
usage: 'New', as in خلق جدید 'a new creation' and دور جدید 'the new cycle'.

definition: Feminine of jadíd: new. Root j-d-d.
usage: 'New', agreeing with feminine or plural nouns, as in روح جدیده 'new spirit'.

definition: plural of jarídih: newspapers, journals. Root j-r-d.
usage: 'Newspapers', in references to the press reporting ‘Abdu'l-Bahá's talks.

definition: Adjective: bodily, physical, material. Root j-s-m.
usage: 'Physical', contrasted with روحانی 'spiritual', as in مدنیت جسمانی و روحانی 'material and spiritual civilization'.

definition: jilvih + izáfih: manifestation, splendor, appearance.
usage: 'Effulgence, splendour', the shining forth of God's light, as in جلوهٴ الهی 'the divine effulgence'.

definition: Arabic noun: garden, paradise; in construct (jannati'r-Riḍván). Root j-n-n.
usage: 'Garden, Paradise', as in جنة الرضوان 'the Garden of Riḍván' and جنة الأبهی 'the All-Glorious Paradise'.

definition: noun: answer, reply, response. Root j-w-b.
noun: imprisonment, confinement; "ḥabs namúdan" = to imprison. Root ḥ-b-s.
usage: 'Imprisonment', often of the imprisonment of Bahá'u'lláh and ‘Abdu'l-Bahá (حبس و زندان).

definition: Double plural of ḥijáb; veils, coverings, barriers. Root ḥ-j-b.
usage: 'Veils' that hide truth from the soul, as in خرق حجبات 'rending the veils'.

definition: Noun: proof, evidence, argument. Root ḥ-j-j.
usage: 'Proof', esp. the proof of God's Manifestation, as in حجت و برهان 'proof and argument'.

definition: noun: sharpness, keenness, acuteness. Root ḥ-d-d.
usage: 'Keenness, sharpness', e.g. of sight or wit; also 'vehemence'.
notes: in ABU1490 "و حدت" is a mis-split of vaḥdat

definition: adjective: lowly, humble, despised, insignificant. Root ḥ-q-r.
usage: 'Lowly, humble'; used in self-effacing expressions and of worldly things as insignificant.

definition: Ḥayát (life) + ast (is) written joined: is life.
noun: mind, memory, heart; dar khátir = in mind. Root kh-ṭ-r.
usage: 'Mind, heart', in phrases such as خاطر جمع 'at peace' and بخاطر آوردن 'to remember'.

definition: Noun: house, home.
noun: shame, embarrassment. Root kh-j-l.
usage: 'Shame', as in خجل و شرمسار 'ashamed and abashed', of falling short before God.

definition: khidmat with indefinite -í: a service. Root kh-d-m.
usage: 'Service', a central value in the Writings, as in خدمت امر الله 'service to the Cause of God' and خدمت عالم انسانی 'service to humanity'.

definition: adjective: ruined, destroyed, desolate; "kharáb kardan" = to ruin. Root kh-r-b.
usage: 'Ruined, desolate', of the world's condition or a desolate heart; contrasted with آباد 'flourishing'.

definition: Noun: ruin, destruction, devastation. From Arabic kharáb.
usage: 'Ruin', the devastation caused by war and prejudice.

definition: Noun: loss, ruin, perdition. Root kh-s-r.
usage: 'Perdition, loss', as in خسران مبین 'manifest loss', of those who turn away from God.

definition: Noun: request, entreaty, desire. From khástan.
usage: 'Entreaty, request', as in خواهش من این است 'my entreaty is this'.

definition: Adjective: good, pleasant, sweet, happy; khush-ávaz = sweet-voiced.
noun: fear, dread. Root kh-w-f.
usage: 'Fear', often in خوف و رجا 'fear and hope'.

definition: noun: disposition, nature, character; "rúy u khúy" = face and character.
usage: 'Character, disposition', in the pair روی و خوی 'face and character'.

definition: noun: thought, idea, intention; imagination, fancy. Root kh-y-l.
usage: 'Thought, idea' or 'vain fancy'; also intention (خیال داشتن 'to intend').

definition: noun: good, welfare; khayr-kháh "well-wisher"; also "no" in colloquial Persian. Root kh-y-r.
usage: 'Good, welfare', as in خیر عموم 'the general good' and خیرخواه 'well-wisher'.

definition: verb: gave; past stem of dádan; also infinitive-like after modal (parvarish dád "nurture").
verb: I have; 1st sg. present of dáshtan.
past 3rd pl. of dánistan: they knew, considered.
Noun darajih "degree, rank, level" with izáfih. Root d-r-j.
usage: 'Degree, rank', as in درجهٴ کمال 'the degree of perfection'.

definition: Noun: pain, ache, suffering, affliction.
usage: 'Pain, affliction', often paired with درمان 'remedy', of the world's ills and their divine healing.

definition: verb: they give; 3rd pl. present subjunctive of dádan.
loanword (French docteur): doctor.
dídih + izáfih: eye; sight.
usage: 'Eye', as in دیدهٴ بینا 'the seeing eye' and دیدهٴ بصیرت 'the eye of insight'.

definition: Adjective: lowly, abased, humiliated. Root dh-l-l.
usage: 'Abased, abject', contrasted with عزیز 'glorious'; of those humbled in the world.

definition: Active participle: firm, steadfast, well-rooted. Root r-s-kh.
usage: 'Steadfast', as in ثابت و راسخ 'firm and steadfast' in the Covenant.

definition: adjective: lordly, divine, of the Lord. From rabb. Root r-b-b.
usage: 'Divine, of the Lord', as in تعالیم ربانی 'divine teachings' and نفحات ربانی.

definition: Arabic: rabb "Lord" + -ka "your": thy Lord. Root r-b-b.
usage: 'Thy Lord', in Qur'anic-style phrases such as رحمة ربک 'the mercy of thy Lord'.

definition: Arabic: rabb "Lord" + -í "my": my Lord. Root r-b-b.
usage: 'My Lord', a common opening of prayers: ربی ربی 'O my Lord'.

definition: noun: mercy, compassion; e.g. raḥmat rabbik "the mercy of thy Lord". Root r-ḥ-m.
usage: 'Mercy', in Arabic phrases such as رحمة ربک 'the mercy of thy Lord'.

definition: Noun: mercy, compassion, grace. Root r-ḥ-m.
usage: 'Mercy, grace' of God, as in رحمت الهی 'divine mercy' and باران رحمت 'rain of mercy'.

definition: verb: brings, conveys, causes to reach; 3rd sg. subjunctive of rasándan.
Plural of risálih: treatises, epistles, letters. Root r-s-l.
usage: 'Epistles, treatises', the written works of the Central Figures and others, as in رسایل و الواح.

definition: verb: reaches, attains, arrives; 3rd sg. subjunctive of rasídan.
Verb, 1st sg. past of raftan: I went.
Adjective: high, lofty, exalted. Root r-f-‘.
usage: 'Lofty, exalted', as in مقام رفیع 'exalted station'.

definition: Plural of rábiṭih; ties, connections, relations. Root r-b-ṭ.
usage: 'Ties, relations', as in روابط ضروریه 'the necessary relations' arising from the nature of things.

definition: Noun: glass; lamp-glass. Root z-j-j.
usage: 'Glass', esp. the lamp-glass of the Qur'anic Light Verse; the lamp and the glass as images of the Manifestation.

definition: noun: earth, ground, land, soil.
verb: strikes, casts; 3rd sg. present subjunctive of zadan (e.g. mawj zanad "surges").
interjection: beware! take heed!
usage: 'Beware!', a solemn warning, as in زنهار زنهار 'beware, beware!'.

definition: noun: year.
adjective: other, the rest, remaining. Root s-y-r.
usage: 'Other, the rest', as in سایر ادیان 'the other religions' and سایر ملل 'the other nations'.

definition: noun: prison, imprisonment. Root s-j-n.
usage: 'Prison', esp. the Most Great Prison of ‘Akká (سجن اعظم).

definition: Noun: throne, couch. Root s-r-r.
usage: 'Throne', as in سریر سلطنت 'the throne of sovereignty' and the throne of God's Kingdom.

definition: Adjective: worthy, deserving, fitting, proper.
usage: 'Meet, worthy, fitting', as in سزاوار است 'it is meet', of conduct befitting the believers.

definition: noun: sovereignty, kingship, reign. Root s-l-ṭ.
usage: 'Sovereignty', both earthly kingship and the spiritual sovereignty of God's Kingdom (سلطنت الهیه).

definition: Loftiness, elevation, sublimity. Root s-m-w.
usage: 'Sublimity, loftiness', of the station of the Cause or of the soul, often in سمو و علو.

definition: noun: age, years of life; ham-sinn "of the same age".
usage: 'Age'; سن بلوغ 'the age of maturity'.

definition: verbal noun: rest, stillness, inactivity, tranquillity. Root s-k-n.
usage: 'Tranquillity, rest', as in سکون و قرار 'calm and composure'.

definition: noun: joy, gladness.
usage: 'Gladness', of the joy of the friends, as in سرور و شادمانی 'joy and gladness'.

definition: noun: king, shah.
usage: 'Shah, king', referring to the Persian monarchs, e.g. ناصرالدین شاه.

definition: noun: shepherd.
usage: 'Shepherd', an image of the divine Educator who gathers the flock (اغنام).

definition: Noun/adjective: martyr; witness. Root sh-h-d.
usage: 'Martyr', esp. the Bahá'í martyrs of Persia; also 'witness', and a divine name (الشهید).

definition: noun: patience, endurance, forbearance. Root ṣ-b-r.
usage: 'Patience', in the face of tests, often in صبر و تحمل 'patience and endurance'.

definition: Noun: shell, oyster shell (holding a pearl).
usage: 'Shell', the oyster shell that holds the pearl, an image of the human heart or of hidden spiritual worth.

definition: Adjective: pure, sheer, absolute (faná-yi ṣirf, utter self-effacement). Root ṣ-r-f.
usage: 'Utter, pure', as in فنای صرف 'utter self-effacement' and عدم صرف 'pure nothingness'.

shift: Here: regions, lands, as in the regions of America. Today: pages (صفحه); lands is سرزمین‌ها.
definition: Plural of ṣafḥih; pages, surfaces; by extension regions, lands. Root ṣ-f-ḥ.
usage: 'Regions, lands' (literally 'pages'), as in صفحات امریکا 'the regions of America'; today mainly 'pages'.

definition: Noun: protection, safekeeping, preservation. Root ṣ-w-n.
usage: 'Protection', usually in حفظ و صون 'protection and safekeeping' of God.

definition: noun: printing, publishing; also nature, temperament. Root ṭ-b-‘.
usage: 'Printing' of books and Tablets (طبع و نشر 'printing and publishing'); also 'nature, temperament'.

definition: verb stem of ṭalabídan, 1st sg. present (after mí-): I seek, request.
usage: 'I beseech', as in از خدا می‌طلبم 'I beseech God', in prayers for the friends.

definition: Noun: manner, way, mode; "har ṭawr" in whatever way. Root ṭ-w-r.
usage: 'Manner, way'; also in Arabic contexts طور سینا 'Mount Sinai'.

definition: Noun: appearance, manifestation; Bahá'í usage: a Revelation of God. Root ẓ-h-r.
usage: 'Manifestation, appearance', esp. the Revelation of God's Manifestation, as in ظهور جدید 'the new Revelation' and یوم ظهور.

definition: The letter ‘ayn; "‘A ‘A" (ع ع) was ‘Abdu'l-Bahá's signature initials for ‘Abbás ‘Abdu'l-Bahá.
usage: ‘Ayn, used doubled (ع ع) as ‘Abdu'l-Bahá's signature at the end of His Tablets, for ‘Abbás ‘Abdu'l-Bahá.

definition: Noun: servant, slave of God; "ín ‘abd" = this servant ('Abdu'l-Bahá of himself). Root ‘-b-d.
usage: 'Servant' of God; ‘Abdu'l-Bahá refers to Himself as این عبد 'this servant', and His title means 'Servant of Bahá'.

definition: Adjective (Arabic feminine elative of ‘aẓím): greatest, most great, supreme. Root ‘-ẓ-m.
usage: 'Most Great, supreme', as in موهبت عظمی 'the supreme bestowal' and صلح اعظم; feminine of اعظم.

definition: adjective: great, mighty; Arabic feminine of ‘aẓím agreeing with plural nouns. Root ‘-ẓ-m.
usage: 'Mighty, great', agreeing with feminine or plural nouns, as in مواهب عظیمه 'mighty bestowals'.

definition: adjective ‘aẓím (great, mighty) + indefinite -í. Root ‘-ẓ-m.
usage: 'A great, a mighty', as in موهبت عظیمی 'a mighty bounty'.

definition: Noun: reason, intellect, mind. Root ‘-q-l.
usage: 'Reason, intellect', praised as God's gift; the Writings hold that religion must agree with عقل 'reason'.

definition: noun: cause, reason; also illness, disease. Root ‘-l-l.
usage: 'Cause', as in علت عزت 'the cause of glory'; also 'illness' in older usage.

definition: Abstract noun: exaltation, sublimity, loftiness. Root ‘-l-w.
usage: 'Sublimity, exaltation', of the Cause or the human station.

definition: adjective/noun: sick, ill, ailing person. Root ‘-l-l.
usage: 'Ailing, sick', both physically and spiritually; the Manifestation as physician to the ailing world.

definition: Arabic preposition ‘alá + dual suffix -kumá: upon you both; "‘alaykumá al-Bahá'" = upon you both be glory.
usage: 'Upon you both', in the salutation علیکما البهاء الأبهی 'upon you both be the Glory of the Most Glorious'.

definition: adverb: generally, in general, as a whole. Root ‘-m-m.
usage: 'Generally, all together', e.g. addressing the friends عموماً 'one and all'.

definition: Plural of ‘unṣur; elements, constituents. Root ‘-n-ṣ-r.
usage: 'Elements', as in the composition and decomposition of elements (ترکیب عناصر) in discussions of life and death.

definition: adverb: soon, before long (Arabic ‘an qaríb). Root q-r-b.
usage: 'Soon, ere long', in promises of the future triumph of the Cause.

definition: ‘ahd + indefinite -í: a covenant, a pledge. Root ‘-h-d.
usage: 'Covenant', esp. the Covenant of Bahá'u'lláh (عهد و میثاق); here 'a covenant, a pledge'.

definition: noun: help, aid, succour. Root ‘-w-n.
usage: 'Help, succour', esp. divine aid, as in عون و عنایت 'help and favour'.

definition: Adjective: rich, wealthy; independent, self-sufficient. Root gh-n-y.
usage: 'Rich'; also 'self-sufficient', a divine attribute (الغنی 'the Self-Sufficient'), contrasted with فقیر.

definition: noun/particle: other, other than; negates adjectives (ghayr-i maghfúr = unforgivable). Root gh-y-r.
usage: 'Other than, un-', as in غیر الله 'other than God' and negating adjectives (غیر ممکن 'impossible').

definition: Slackening, languor, remissness. Root f-t-r.
usage: 'Slackness, languor', usually negated: without فتور 'without flagging' in service.

definition: Noun: flight, escape; "firár kardan" to flee. Root f-r-r.
Adjective: forgotten; farámúsh kardan/gardídan, to forget/be forgotten.
usage: 'Forgotten', as in فراموش نخواهد شد 'will not be forgotten'.

definition: farq "difference, distinction" + indefinite -í: any difference. Root f-r-q.
usage: 'Difference', as in فرقی نیست 'there is no difference' between the Manifestations or peoples.

definition: verb: (he) said, commanded; honorific plural past of farmúdan.
usage: 'Said, commanded', the honorific verb used of Bahá'u'lláh's or ‘Abdu'l-Bahá's words.

definition: Past participle of farmúdan (to command, say; honorific auxiliary); farmúdih-and = have stated.
usage: 'Have stated', honorific; e.g. فرموده‌اند, of what the Blessed Beauty has stated.

definition: 3rd person singular past of furúkhtan: (he) sold.
noun: poverty, need; mystical sense: spiritual poverty, detachment. Root f-q-r.
usage: 'Poverty', both material and spiritual: فقر 'detachment, need of God', contrasted with غنا.

definition: Plural of fann; arts, crafts, sciences, techniques. Root f-n-n.
usage: 'Arts, crafts', as in علوم و فنون 'sciences and arts'.

definition: Arabic oath: fa- + wa + Alláh: so, by God!
usage: 'By God!', a solemn oath affirming a statement.

definition: noun: thought, reflection, idea. Root f-k-r.
usage: 'Thought, reflection', as in فکر و ذکر 'thought and remembrance'.

definition: Plural of fayḍ: outpourings, bounties, grace. Root f-y-ḍ.
usage: 'Bounties, outpourings' of grace, as in فیوضات الهیه 'divine bounties'.

definition: Adjective: capable, worthy, susceptible (of). Root q-b-l.
usage: 'Capable, worthy, receptive', e.g. قابل ترقی 'capable of progress'.

definition: Noun: capacity, worthiness, receptivity. Root q-b-l.
usage: 'Capacity, receptivity', to receive divine bounties; contrasted with استعداد 'aptitude'.

definition: active participle "one who arises, standing, steadfast"; as title: the Qá’im, the promised Mahdí (the Báb). Root q-w-m.
usage: 'He Who Ariseth', the promised Qá'im of Shí‘ih Islam, whom the Báb claimed to be.

definition: Noun: kind, sort; (Arabic) host, company. Root q-b-l.
usage: 'Kind, sort', as in از این قبیل 'of this kind'.

definition: noun: worth, value, measure; chih qadr = how much. Root q-d-r.
usage: 'Worth, measure', as in قدر دانستن 'to appreciate' the value of the Day of God.

definition: Adjective: ancient, old; eternal (of God). Root q-d-m.
usage: 'Ancient, eternal'; قدیم also names God's pre-existence, as in جمال قدم 'the Ancient Beauty' (Bahá'u'lláh).

definition: the Qur'án, holy book of Islam. Root q-r-'.
usage: 'The Qur'án', cited as scripture and for its prophecies fulfilled in this Day.

definition: Verbal noun: reading, recitation. Root q-r-'.
usage: 'Reading, recitation', e.g. قرائت آیات 'reciting the verses'.

definition: noun qalb "heart" + indefinite -í: a heart; also adjective "of the heart". Root q-l-b.
usage: 'A heart', the seat of spiritual perception, as in قلب پاک 'a pure heart'.

definition: plural of quvvat with izáfih: powers, forces, faculties. Root q-w-y.
usage: 'Powers, faculties', as in قوای روحانیه 'spiritual powers' and قوای عقلیه 'intellectual faculties'.

definition: noun: delicacy, grace, refinement, freshness. Root l-ṭ-f.
usage: 'Delicacy, refinement', as in لطافت و طراوت 'freshness and delicacy' and refinement of character.

definition: proper name: London.
Plural of láyiḥih; memoranda, written statements, pamphlets. Root l-w-ḥ.
usage: 'Written statements, memoranda'; also 'Tablets', as in لوایح published for the public.

definition: Noun: moon; month.
Feminine form of mubárak: blessed, auspicious (agreeing with shajarih, tree). Root b-r-k.
usage: 'Blessed', agreeing with feminine nouns, as in شجرهٴ مبارکه 'the Blessed Tree' and بقعهٴ مبارکه.

definition: participle: proven, demonstrated. Root b-r-h-n.
usage: 'Demonstrated, proven', as in واضح و مبرهن 'clear and evident'.

definition: adjective: raised up, sent (as a prophet); resurrected. Passive participle of root b-‘-th.
usage: 'Raised up, sent', of a Prophet sent by God; also of the dead raised.

definition: participle (form V): affected, moved, saddened. Root '-th-r.
Active participle (form V): watching, on the lookout, expectant. Root r-ṣ-d.
usage: 'Watchful, expectant', awaiting news or confirmation.

definition: Active participle (form VI): different, varying, unequal. Root f-w-t.
usage: 'Differing, varying', of degrees of capacity among souls.

definition: mutafávit (differing, varied) + ast (is): is different, varies. Root f-w-t.
Plural of majma‘; gatherings, assemblies, meeting places. Root j-m-‘.
usage: 'Gatherings, assemblies', where ‘Abdu'l-Bahá spoke in the West (مجامع و محافل).

definition: active participle (form VIII): assembled, gathered together. Root j-m-‘.
usage: 'Gathered', of the friends gathered in unity.

definition: Noun: meeting, gathering, assembly; place of sitting. Root j-l-s.
usage: 'Gathering, meeting', as in مجلس روحانی 'Spiritual Assembly' and مجالس تبلیغ.

definition: plural of maḥfil: gatherings, assemblies. Root ḥ-f-l.
usage: 'Gatherings, assemblies'; in Bahá'í usage محفل denotes a Spiritual Assembly (محفل روحانی).

definition: Adjective/adverb: respectful(ly), honourable; muḥtaram + -ánih. Root ḥ-r-m.
usage: 'Respectfully', of how the friends are received or how one should address others.

definition: muḥtaram + -at: your honored/esteemed. Root ḥ-r-m.
usage: 'Your esteemed', a respectful epithet for family members or companions of the addressee.

definition: Passive participle: limited, bounded, finite. Root ḥ-d-d.
usage: 'Limited, finite', contrasted with نامحدود 'infinite', of the human mind and the world of nature.

definition: maḥzún "sad, grieved" + -am "I am". Root ḥ-z-n.
usage: 'I am grieved', in expressions of sorrow over trials or lapses.

definition: adjective: pure, sheer, utter. Root m-ḥ-ḍ.
usage: 'Pure, sheer', as in محض فضل 'out of pure grace'.

definition: passive participle: protected, preserved, safe. Root ḥ-f-ẓ.
usage: 'Protected, preserved', under God's protection; محفوظ و مصون 'protected and guarded'.

definition: passive participle: praised, praiseworthy. Root ḥ-m-d.
usage: 'Praiseworthy', of deeds and qualities (اخلاق محموده 'praiseworthy qualities').

definition: proper name: Mírzá Maḥmúd-i Zarqání, chronicler of ‘Abdu'l-Bahá's travels.
usage: 'Maḥmúd', esp. Mírzá Maḥmúd-i Zarqání, chronicler of ‘Abdu'l-Bahá's travels in the West.

definition: participle (form VIII): different, various, divergent. Root kh-l-f.
usage: 'Various, different', as in ادیان مختلفه 'the various religions' and ملل مختلفه.

definition: noun: period, duration, length of time. Root m-d-d.
Noun: help, aid, assistance. Root m-d-d.
usage: 'Help', esp. divine assistance, as in مدد غیبی 'unseen help'.

definition: Adjective: of one slaughtered; "ḥarakat-i madhbúḥí" the last struggle of a dying creature. Root dh-b-ḥ.
usage: 'Of one slaughtered'; ‘Abdu'l-Bahá uses حرکت مذبوحی 'the death-throes' of the Cause's enemies.

definition: passive participle: written; marqúm namúdan = to write. Root r-q-m.
usage: 'Written', in the formal verb مرقوم نمودن/فرمودن 'to write', used of letters and Tablets.

definition: English loanword Miss (also Mrs. in some letters), title before a woman's name.
noun: questions, issues, problems; plural of mas’alih. Root s-'-l.
usage: 'Questions, issues', as in مسایل روحانیه 'spiritual questions' and Some Answered Questions (مفاوضات).

definition: noun: question, problem, issue, matter. Root s-’-l.
usage: 'Question, matter', as in مسئلهٴ صلح 'the question of peace'.

definition: mas'alih with izáfih: question, issue, problem of. Root s-'-l.
usage: 'The question of', introducing a topic, e.g. مسئلهٴ وحدت عالم انسانی.

definition: verbal noun (form III): seeing, witnessing, beholding. Root sh-h-d.
usage: 'Beholding, witnessing', as in مشاهده نمودن 'to behold'.

definition: verbal noun (form III) with izáfih: beholding, witnessing, seeing. Root sh-h-d.
usage: 'Beholding of', e.g. مشاهدهٴ آثار 'beholding the signs'.

definition: participle (form VIII): kindled, aflame, enkindled. Root sh-‘-l.
usage: 'Ablaze, enkindled', of hearts set aflame with the love of God (مشتعل بنار محبة الله).

definition: passive participle: seen, evident, manifest. Root sh-h-d.
usage: 'Evident, visible', as in واضح و مشهود 'clear and evident'.

definition: Adverb (Arabic accusative): visibly, evidently, before one's eyes. Root sh-h-d.
usage: 'Visibly, evidently', an Arabic adverb used for emphasis.

definition: Plural of maẓhar; places of appearance; Bahá'í usage: the Manifestations of God. Root ẓ-h-r.
usage: 'Manifestations', esp. the Manifestations of God (مظاهر مقدسه 'the holy Manifestations'), who reflect God's attributes.

definition: adjective: spiritual, inner, of meaning. From ma‘ná, root ‘-n-y.
usage: 'Spiritual, inner', as in معنوی و روحانی; contrasted with صوری 'outward'.

definition: passive participle: lost, missing, absent, non-existent. Root f-q-d.
usage: 'Lost, absent, non-existent', e.g. of virtues lacking in the world.

definition: Passive participle: accepted, acceptable. Root q-b-l.
usage: 'Accepted', of deeds acceptable before God (مقبول درگاه الهی).

definition: Maqṣad (aim, purpose) + indefinite -í: any aim or purpose. Root q-ṣ-d.
usage: 'Any aim', as in مقصدی جز ... ندارم 'I have no aim but ...'.

definition: Title of a Muslim cleric or learned man, used before names.
usage: 'Mullá', a Muslim cleric, as in ملاحسین, the first believer in the Báb.

definition: Active participle: attentive, aware, noticing; "multafit shudan" = to notice, realize. Root l-f-t.
usage: 'Aware, attentive'; ملتفت شدن 'to realize, take note'.

definition: noun: realm, kingdom, territory. Root m-l-k.
usage: 'Realm, kingdom', esp. the material world in the pair ملک و ملکوت 'the earthly realm and the Kingdom'.

definition: Noun: death. Root m-w-t.
usage: 'Death', usually with حیات, as in حیات و ممات 'life and death'.

definition: Plural of mamlakat: countries, kingdoms, realms. Root m-l-k.
usage: 'Countries, realms', as in ممالک غرب 'the countries of the West'.

definition: Active participle (form III): herald, one who calls or proclaims. Root n-d-w.
usage: 'Herald', one who calls, as in منادی امر الله 'herald of the Cause of God' and منادی میثاق.

definition: Passive participle (form II): illumined, enlightened. Root n-w-r.
usage: 'Illumined', of hearts and faces lit by divine light (منور و روشن).

definition: The Mahdí, "the rightly guided one", the promised one of Islam (fulfilled by the Báb). Root h-d-y.
usage: 'The Mahdí', the promised one of Islam, whose advent the Báb fulfilled.

definition: adjective: kind, loving, compassionate.
usage: 'Kind, loving', as in خدای مهربان 'the loving God', a frequent divine epithet.

definition: Active participle (form III): agreeable, fitting, in accord; favourable. Root w-f-q.
usage: 'Agreeable, in accord', as in موافق تعالیم 'in conformity with the teachings'.

definition: noun/adjective: believer, faithful. Form IV participle of root '-m-n.
usage: 'Believer', one who has recognized the Manifestation; plural مؤمنین 'the faithful'.

definition: noun: letter, writing; passive participle "written". Root k-t-b.
usage: 'Letter', esp. letters received from the believers or sent by ‘Abdu'l-Bahá.

definition: verb: was arriving, used to reach; 3rd sg. past imperfective of rasídan.
3rd person singular present of rúyídan: grows, sprouts (also míravíd "you go").
usage: 'Grows', of seeds and plants in parables of spiritual growth.

definition: 2nd person plural present of raftan: you go, you are going.
verb: used to become, was becoming; past imperfective of shudan.
verb: says, commands (honorific); present 3rd sg. of farmúdan.
usage: 'He says', honorific of God or the Manifestation, often introducing a quotation (چنانکه میفرماید 'as He says').

definition: verb, 3rd pl. present of farmúdan (honorific): they say, decree, do.
usage: 'They say', honorific plural of the Central Figures.

definition: Verb: 3rd sg. present of namúdan, to do/make (formal auxiliary in compound verbs); also to show.
usage: Formal auxiliary 'does, makes' in compound verbs (e.g. ظاهر مینماید 'manifests').

definition: 1st sg. present of namúdan: I do, I make; du‘á mí-namáyam, I pray.
usage: Formal auxiliary 'I do', as in دعا مینمایم 'I pray'.

definition: 2nd person singular present continuous of namúdan: you do, you make.
usage: Formal auxiliary 'you do', in compound verbs.

definition: verb, 3rd sg. past continuous of namúdan: was doing, used to make.
usage: Formal auxiliary 'was doing, used to make', in compound verbs.

definition: 1st sg. present of nigáshtan: I write, I pen.
usage: 'I write', as in این نامه مینگارم.

definition: Verb: 3rd sg. past continuous of kardan, to do/make; used to make.
Adjective: ignorant, unlearned, foolish (ná- + dán "knowing").
usage: 'Ignorant', contrasted with دانا 'wise'; the ignorant are to be educated, not despised.

definition: Noun: ignorance; ná- (not) + dán (know) + -í.
usage: 'Ignorance', cited as a root of prejudice and strife, to be removed by education.

definition: Noun: people, mankind. Root n-w-s.
usage: 'People, mankind', in Arabic phrases such as بین الناس 'among the people'.

definition: Adjective: infinite, endless; ná- (not) + mutanáhí (finite). Root n-h-y.
usage: 'Infinite', of God's bounties and the worlds of God (عوالم نامتناهی).

definition: noun: strife, dispute, conflict. Root n-z-‘.
usage: 'Strife', usually in نزاع و جدال 'strife and contention', which the Teachings forbid.

definition: noun: growth, development; nashv u namá = growth and development. Root n-sh-'.
usage: 'Growth', in نشو و نما 'growth and development', of physical and spiritual evolution.

definition: verb, 3rd sg. negative present/subjunctive of shudan: does not become.
noun: explicit text, ordinance; naṣṣ-i ṣaríḥ = explicit text. Root n-ṣ-ṣ.
usage: 'Explicit text', the authoritative Word, as in نص صریح 'explicit text' and the appointment of the Centre of the Covenant by نص.

definition: noun: counsel, advice, admonition. Root n-ṣ-ḥ.
usage: 'Counsel, admonition', as in نصایح الهی 'divine counsels'.

definition: noun: blessing, favour, bounty. Root n-‘-m.
usage: 'Blessing, bounty' of God, as in نعمت الهی and شکر نعمت 'gratitude for blessings'.

definition: proper name: Na‘ím, Bahá'í poet of Tehran; literally "bliss". Root n-‘-m.
usage: 'Na‘ím', Bahá'í poet of Tehran.

definition: noun: bliss, delight; jannat-i na‘ím = garden of bliss, Paradise. Root n-‘-m.
usage: 'Bliss', as in جنت نعیم 'the Garden of Bliss'.

definition: Negative past participle of mándan: has not remained, is left no more.
noun: appearing, manifestation, being visible.
usage: 'Appearance, manifestation', of signs becoming visible.

definition: Negative continuous verbal prefix na- + mí- (split by ZWNJ): does not, is not ...-ing.
Negative 1st person singular present continuous of kardan: I do not do/make.
notes: verb, negative 1st sg. present of kardan

definition: Verb, 3rd pl. past of nivishtan: they wrote.
Negative 3rd sg. present/subjunctive of kardan: does not, may not do.
verb: they do not do; negative 3rd pl. subjunctive of kardan.
verb, 2nd pl. negative present/imperative of kardan: do not.
verb: does not become; negative 3rd sg. subjunctive of gardídan.
Noun: non-existence, nothingness, self-effacement (also "you are not").
usage: 'Nothingness, self-effacement', as in نیستی و فنا; the believer's self-effacement before God.

definition: proper name: New York.
Noun: assault, attack, onrush. Root h-j-m.
usage: 'Onrush, assault', of tests, enemies or the hosts of the Kingdom.

definition: himmat with -í: an endeavour, effort, high resolve. Root h-m-m.
usage: 'Endeavour, high resolve', as in همت بلند 'lofty resolve' in service.

definition: Noun: intimate companion, close friend.
usage: 'Intimate companion', as in همدم و همراز 'companion and confidant'.

definition: rein to rein: keeping pace with, equal, on a par with.
usage: 'Keeping pace, equal', as in همعنان 'hand in hand', e.g. material and spiritual civilization advancing together.

definition: pronoun/adjective: all, every; with izáfih (hamiy-i, all of).
Demonstrative: this very, this same; "hamín-ṭawr" just so.
Arabic pronoun: he; "lá iláha illá huwa" there is no God but He.
usage: 'He', referring to God, as in لا اله الا هو 'there is no God but He' and the invocation هو at the head of Tablets.

definition: Noun: air, weather, climate; (hawá with different spelling: desire).
usage: 'Air, weather'; distinct from هوی 'desire, passion' (هوی و هوس).

definition: Adjective (Arabic feminine of váḥid): one, single, unified. Root w-ḥ-d.
usage: 'One, single', as in نفس واحده 'one soul' and عائلهٴ واحده 'one family', of the oneness of humanity.

definition: Adjective: clear, evident, manifest. Root w-ḍ-ḥ.
usage: 'Clear, evident', as in واضح و مشهود 'clear and evident'.

definition: adjective: aware, informed, acquainted. Active participle of root w-q-f.
usage: 'Aware, informed', as in واقف بر اسرار 'aware of the mysteries'.

definition: Conjunction: otherwise, or else, if not (wa + in + lá).
plural of vaḥsh: wild beasts, wild animals. Root w-ḥ-sh.
usage: 'Wild beasts', contrasted with humans as an image of savagery, e.g. strife makes people like وحوش.

definition: noun: arrival, entry. Root w-r-d.
usage: 'Arrival', as in ورود به امریکا 'arrival in America'.

definition: noun: counsels, testaments, injunctions; plural of vaṣiyyat + izáfih. Root w-ṣ-y.
usage: 'Testaments, counsels'; الواح وصایا is the Will and Testament of ‘Abdu'l-Bahá.

definition: Noun: description, depiction; praise. Root w-ṣ-f.
usage: 'Description, praise', as in وصف نتوان کرد 'cannot be described'.

definition: noun: arrival, receipt; vuṣúl yáftan "to be received". Root w-ṣ-l.
usage: 'Arrival, receipt', esp. of a letter (وصول نامه).

definition: Noun: fidelity, faithfulness, loyalty. Root w-f-y.
usage: 'Faithfulness', fidelity to God and the Covenant, as in اهل وفا 'the faithful'.

definition: conjunction: when, at the time that; vaqt "time" + -í.
Conjunction: even if, even though (Arabic wa-law).
noun: king, sovereign, shah.
usage: 'King', of earthly sovereigns and, figuratively, of God (پادشاه حقیقی 'the true King').

definition: adjective: pure, clean, holy.
usage: 'Pure, holy', as in دل پاک 'a pure heart' and پاک و مقدس 'pure and sanctified'.

definition: Verb: 3rd sg. past of pardákhtan, to apply oneself to, engage in; also to pay.
usage: Used for devoting oneself to a task, as in بخدمت پرداخت 'engaged in service'; also, less often, to pay.

definition: Verb: 2nd pl. present/imperative of pardákhtan, to devote oneself to, occupy oneself with.
usage: An exhortation to the friends to occupy themselves with service or teaching, as in بتبلیغ پردازید 'engage in teaching'.

definition: adjective: hidden, concealed, secret.
usage: Hidden or secret, often of divine mysteries or inner realities, as in اسرار پنهان 'hidden mysteries'.

definition: adjective: hidden, concealed, secret.
usage: Hidden, secret; describes what is concealed from outward sight, often in contrast with آشکار 'manifest'.

definition: Adjective/past participle of pazhmurdan: withered, faded, dejected.
usage: Withered or dejected, often of hearts or souls revived by the breezes of God, as in دلهای پژمرده 'withered hearts'.

definition: adjective: visible, evident; "paydá shudan" = to appear, arise.
usage: Visible or evident; in پیدا شدن 'to appear' it describes the emergence of signs, conditions or persons.

definition: contraction of chunán ast: it is such; "umídam chunánast kih" = my hope is that.
usage: A common epistolary formula in ‘Abdu'l-Bahá's letters, as in امیدم چنانست که 'my hope is that'.

definition: conjunction: as, just as, so that.
Adjective: some, several, a few; how many.
noun chíz (thing) + indefinite -í: something, anything.
surname of Professor Thomas Kelly Cheyne of Oxford and his wife.
usage: Name of Professor Thomas Kelly Cheyne of Oxford, to whom ‘Abdu'l-Bahá wrote; the reading of the name is uncertain.

definition: Plural of kitáb; books, scriptures. Root k-t-b.
usage: Books, and especially Holy Books or scriptures, as in کتب مقدسه 'the sacred Books' and کتب سماویه 'the heavenly Books'.

definition: Noun: priest, clergyman (Christian).
usage: A Christian priest or clergyman; used when addressing or speaking of Christian clergy.

definition: Plural of kalimih; words; "Kalimát-i Maknúnih" the Hidden Words. Root k-l-m.
usage: Words, often the divine words, as in کلمات مکنونه 'the Hidden Words' and کلمات الهیه 'the words of God'.

definition: noun: word; in kalimatu’lláh "the Word of God". Root k-l-m.
usage: Word; in the Writings often the creative Word of God, as in کلمة الله 'the Word of God'.

definition: verb, 3rd sg. past of giriftan: took, received, seized.
usage: Took, received or seized; common in compounds such as قرار گرفت 'was established'.

definition: Adjective: caught, captive, afflicted, entangled.
usage: Caught or afflicted, as in گرفتار بلا 'afflicted with trials'; also captive, of the imprisoned believers.

definition: Noun: rose garden, flower garden.
usage: A rose garden; a frequent image for the world of hearts or the Abhá Paradise, as in گلشن الهی 'the divine rose garden'.

definition: Noun: supposition, thought, opinion; gumán namúdan, to suppose.
usage: Supposition or opinion, often idle fancy contrasted with certitude, as in گمان نمودن 'to suppose'.

definition: Verb: 3rd sg. present/subjunctive of yáftan, to find, attain; also forms passive-like compounds (shifá yábad, be healed).
usage: To find or attain, as in شفا یابد 'be healed' and نجات یابد 'be saved'.

definition: Arabic verb, 3rd m. sg. imperfect form IV: he gives life, revives, quickens. Root ḥ-y-y.
usage: Gives life or quickens; used of God reviving the dead or hearts, echoing the Qur'anic یحیی العظام 'He gives life to the bones'.

definition: proper name: John (the Baptist); also Mírzá Yaḥyá, half-brother of Bahá'u'lláh.
usage: John the Baptist (یحیی), or Mírzá Yaḥyá, the half-brother of Bahá'u'lláh who opposed Him.

definition: Arabic imperfect 3rd m. pl. of ‘alima: they know (Qur'án 39:9). Root ‘-l-m.
usage: Part of the Qur'anic question هل یستوی الذین یعلمون والذین لا یعلمون 'Are they equal, those who know and those who know not?'.

definition: Proper name: Judas (Iscariot), the disciple who betrayed Christ.
usage: Judas Iscariot; cited as the type of the disciple who betrays his Lord.

definition: noun: day; "yawm-i ..." = the day of. Root y-w-m.
usage: Day, often the promised Day of God, as in یوم الله 'the Day of God' and یوم القیامة 'the Day of Resurrection'.

definition: Pronoun: each other, one another.
usage: Each other; frequent in exhortations to unity, as in با یکدیگر الفت 'love for one another'.

definition: adverb: entirely, altogether, at once.
year 1332 AH (1914 AD) of the Islamic lunar calendar.
usage: A date in the lunar Hijri calendar (1332 AH = 1914 AD), used to date letters and Tablets.

definition: Arabic: ab "father" (accusative abá) + -ka "your": your father.
usage: Your father; used in Arabic passages and prayers addressing an individual about his father.

definition: adjective: eternal, everlasting. Root a-b-d.
usage: Eternal, as in حیات ابدی 'eternal life' and عزت ابدی 'everlasting glory'.

definition: abadí (eternal, everlasting) + ast: is eternal. Root '-b-d.
usage: Is eternal; used to affirm the everlasting nature of the spirit or of divine bounty.

definition: noun: cloud.
usage: Cloud; often an image for veils or doubts that obscure the Sun of Truth, as in ابرهای اوهام 'clouds of vain imaginings'.

definition: Plural of barr; the righteous, the pious. Root b-r-r.
usage: The righteous or pious, as in زمرهٔ ابرار 'the company of the righteous'.

definition: abrár (the righteous, pl. of barr) + -íd (you are). Root b-r-r.
usage: You are of the righteous; a word of praise addressed to believers.

definition: plural of baṣar: eyes, sight. Root b-ṣ-r.
usage: Eyes or sight, as in ابصار و بصایر 'eyes and insight'; often of spiritual vision.

definition: Adjective from Abhá: most glorious, of the Abhá Kingdom.
usage: Pertaining to Abhá, the Most Glorious, as in ملکوت ابهی 'the Abhá Kingdom' and جنت ابهی 'the Abhá Paradise'.

definition: proper name: Abhar, town in Iran; Ibn-i-Abhar, Hand of the Cause. Also "most brilliant".
usage: Abhar, a town in Iran; in ابن ابهر Ibn-i-Abhar, Hand of the Cause of God.

definition: Arabic: father of; in names (Abu'l-Faḍá'il).
usage: Father of; appears in names such as ابوالفضل Abu'l-Faḍl.

definition: plural of báb: doors, gates. Root b-w-b.
usage: Gates or doors, often of divine grace, as in ابواب ملکوت 'the gates of the Kingdom'.

definition: Proper name: Mírzá Abu'l-Faḍl of Gulpáygán, eminent Bahá'í scholar.
usage: Mírzá Abu'l-Faḍl Gulpáygání, the eminent Bahá'í scholar and apologist praised by ‘Abdu'l-Bahá.

definition: Arabic genitive of ab "father"; in Abi'l-Faḍá'il, i.e. Mírzá Abu'l-Faḍl Gulpáygání.
usage: Genitive of 'father' in names, as in ابی الفضائل Abi'l-Faḍá'il, a title of Mírzá Abu'l-Faḍl.

definition: noun: proof, establishment, affirmation. Form IV of root th-b-t.
usage: Proof or establishment, as in اثبات حقیت 'proving the truth' of the Faith or of a Manifestation.

definition: Noun: trace, sign; work, writing; "athar-i-qalam-i-a‘lá" a work of the Supreme Pen. Root '-th-r.
usage: A trace or effect, and a written work or Tablet, as in آثار قلم اعلی 'the works of the Supreme Pen'.

definition: athar (trace, effect, work) with -í: a trace. Root '-th-r.
usage: A trace or effect; often in negation, 'no trace remained'.

definition: noun: ether, the highest heaven; sarír-i athír = exalted throne.
usage: Ether or the highest heaven; in older cosmology the medium filling space, and in poetry the lofty sky.

definition: adjective: sinful, wicked; afák-i-athím "sinful liar" (Qur'anic). Root '-th-m.
usage: Sinful; in the Qur'anic phrase افاک اثیم 'sinful liar', used of slanderers.

definition: noun: rent, lease. Root '-j-r.
noun ijázih "permission" + izáfih. Root j-w-z.
usage: Permission, as in اجازهٔ تشرف 'permission to attain the presence' (pilgrimage).

definition: ijbárí "compulsory, obligatory" + ast "is". Root j-b-r.
usage: Is compulsory; used, for example, of compulsory education for children.

definition: Verbal noun (form VIII): gathering, assembling, union; society. Root j-m-‘.
usage: Gathering or society, as in عالم اجتماع 'the social world'; also assemblies of the friends.

definition: Verbal noun (form IV): encompassing, surrounding. Root ḥ-w-ṭ.
usage: Encompassing, as in احاطهٔ کلیه 'universal encompassment' of God's knowledge or of the Manifestation.

shift: Here: the friends of God, the Bahá'í believers. Today: a rare literary plural for friends (دوستان).
definition: Plural of ḥabíb; friends, loved ones; Bahá'í usage: the believers. Root ḥ-b-b.
usage: In the Writings 'the friends' or 'the beloved', meaning the Bahá'í believers, as in احبای الهی 'the friends of God'.

definition: aḥibbá' + Alláh: the beloved of God, i.e. the believers. Root ḥ-b-b.
usage: 'The beloved of God', the standard term for the Bahá'í believers, as in احباء الله.

definition: plural of ḥizb: parties, factions, sects. Root ḥ-z-b.
usage: Parties or sects; often the religious communities of the world, as in احزاب عالم 'the peoples of the world'.

definition: plural of iḥsás: feelings, emotions. Root ḥ-s-s.
usage: Feelings or sentiments, as in احساسات روحانیه 'spiritual sentiments'.

definition: Plural of ḥál: states, conditions, circumstances. Root ḥ-w-l.
usage: Conditions or circumstances; common in greetings asking after someone's well-being.

definition: Plural of ḥukm; laws, ordinances, rules. Root ḥ-k-m.
usage: Laws or ordinances, especially the laws of God, as in احکام الهیه 'divine laws'.

definition: noun: quickening, bringing to life, revival. Form IV of root ḥ-y-y.
usage: Quickening or revival, as in احیاء نفوس 'quickening of souls' and احیاء عالم 'revival of the world'.

definition: Arabic noun: sister; "ibn-i-ukht" sister's son, nephew.
usage: Sister; in ابن اخت 'sister's son', nephew.

definition: noun: allocation, being specific to; ikhtiṣáṣ dádan "to devote". Root kh-ṣ-ṣ.
usage: Being specific to or devoted to, as in اختصاص دادن 'to dedicate'.

definition: Verbal noun: choice, option, free will; "ikhtiyár kardan" = to choose, adopt. Root kh-y-r.
usage: Choice or free will, as in اختیار کردن 'to choose'; also discussed in the question of free will.

definition: Adjective: optional, voluntary; from ikhtiyár (choice). Root kh-y-r.
usage: Optional or voluntary, often contrasted with اجباری 'compulsory'.

definition: noun/adjective: end, last; dar ákhir "at the end". Root '-kh-r.
usage: The end or last, as in در آخر 'at the end' and آخر الزمان 'the end of time'.

definition: Adjective: last, latest, recent. Root '-kh-r.
usage: Last or recent, as in ایام اخیر 'recent days'.

definition: ádáb "manners, customs, good conduct" (plural of adab) + ast "is".
usage: Courtesy or good manners; ادب is a cherished virtue in the Writings, as in آداب الهیه 'divine courtesy'.

definition: adjective (fem. nisba): literary, of letters; "‘ulúm-i adabíyyih" = humanities. Root a-d-b.
usage: Literary, as in علوم ادبیه 'literary sciences', the humanities.

definition: verb: admit him!; imperative of form IV adkhala + -hu. Root d-kh-l.
usage: 'Admit him'; used in prayers for the departed, as in ادخله فی جنتک 'admit him into Thy paradise'.

definition: Verbal noun (form IV): perception, comprehension, understanding. Root d-r-k.
usage: Perception or comprehension, often the limits of human understanding of God.

definition: plural of idrák "perception, understanding" + -shán "their". Root d-r-k.
usage: Their perceptions or understanding; used of the varying capacities of souls.

definition: Arabic form IV imperative + pronoun: reach him, overtake him (with forgiveness). Root d-r-k.
usage: 'Reach him'; in prayers for forgiveness, asking God's mercy to overtake a soul.

definition: Educator, man of letters, cultured teacher. Root '-d-b.
usage: Man of letters or educator; also a title, as in ادیب Adíb, the Hand of the Cause.

definition: conjunction: when, if.
noun: permission, leave. Root a-dh-n.
usage: Permission, often divine leave, as in باذن الله 'by God's leave'.

definition: Devotion, sincere attachment. Root r-w-d.
usage: Sincere devotion or attachment, as in اظهار ارادت 'expressing devotion'.

definition: Will, volition. Root r-w-d.
usage: Will, often the will of God, as in ارادهٔ الهیه 'the divine Will'.

definition: Irádih (will, volition) with izáfih: the will of. Root r-w-d.
usage: The will of, as in ارادهٔ الله 'the Will of God'.

definition: irtibáṭ "connection, link" (form VIII) + indefinite -í. Root r-b-ṭ.
usage: Connection or link, as in ارتباط روحانی 'spiritual connection'.

definition: present 3rd sg. of ávardan (short form): brings.
usage: Brings; a short poetic form of آورد.

definition: árizú (wish, desire) + -am (my).
usage: My wish or hope; frequent in ‘Abdu'l-Bahá's expressions of His longing for the friends' progress.

definition: Árizú (wish, desire) + indefinite -í: any wish or desire.
usage: Any wish or desire; often in the sense of having no desire but God's good-pleasure.

definition: verbal noun (form IV): sending, dispatch. Root r-s-l.
usage: Sending or dispatching, as in ارسال مکتوب 'sending a letter'.

definition: proper noun: Europe.
usage: Europe; often in contrast with the East in discussions of civilization.

definition: adjective: free, liberated.
usage: Free; often freed from attachment to the world, as in آزاد از قیود 'free of fetters'.

definition: ázádigí (freedom, nobility, detachment) + ast (is).
usage: Freedom or detachment, and nobility of spirit; a virtue praised in the Writings.

definition: Noun: freedom, liberty.
usage: Freedom or liberty; the Writings discuss true liberty as submission to God's commandments.

definition: noun: ease, comfort, rest.
usage: Ease or comfort, as in آسایش عالم 'the tranquillity of the world'.

definition: verbal noun (form X): extracting, compiling out of. Root kh-r-j.
usage: Extracting or compiling, as of meanings or passages from texts.

definition: Noun: bone.
isti‘dád (capacity, readiness) with -í. Root ‘-d-d.
usage: Capacity or readiness, as in استعداد 'capacity' to receive divine bounty.

definition: istiqámat (steadfastness) + -shán (their). Root q-w-m.
usage: Their steadfastness; استقامت 'steadfastness' in the Covenant is a central virtue in the Writings.

definition: Arabic verb, 3rd m. sg. perfect, form X: became settled, established. Root q-r-r.
usage: Became settled or established, as of a throne or a cause.

definition: first part of Iskharyúṭí "Iscariot" (Judas Iscariot), written split.
usage: Part of the name Judas Iscariot (یهودای اسخریوطی), the betrayer of Christ.
notes: part of proper name; uncertain reading

definition: Proper name: Israel, the people of Israel.
usage: Israel, the children of Israel (بنی اسرائیل), and the prophecies concerning them.

definition: proper name: Istanbul, Constantinople.
usage: Istanbul (Constantinople), the Ottoman capital where Bahá'u'lláh was briefly exiled.

definition: noun: sky, heaven.
usage: Sky or heaven, as in آسمان دین 'the heaven of religion' and آسمان عرفان 'the heaven of knowledge'.

definition: Captive, prisoner. Root '-s-r.
usage: Captive or prisoner; used of the imprisoned believers and of ‘Abdu'l-Bahá Himself.

definition: Arabic verb, 1st sg. imperfect of sa’ala: I ask, beseech. Root s-'-l.
usage: I ask; a common opening in prayers, as in اسئلک 'I beseech Thee'.
notes: Arabic verb; search form of اسئل

definition: Enclitic pronoun: his, her, its; him, her.
noun: burning, enkindlement, ardour. Form VIII of root sh-‘-l.
usage: Burning or enkindlement, as in اشتعال بنار محبة الله 'enkindlement with the fire of the love of God'.

definition: noun: peace, reconciliation, concord.
usage: Peace or reconciliation, as in صلح و آشتی 'peace and concord' among peoples.

definition: Plural of shakhṣ; persons, individuals. Root sh-kh-ṣ.
plural of ishráq "splendour"; title of a Tablet of Bahá'u'lláh (Splendours). Root sh-r-q.
usage: Splendours; the title of Bahá'u'lláh's Tablet اشراقات 'Ishráqát'.

definition: Adjective: of illumination; falásifiy-i ishráqí, Illuminationist philosophers. Root sh-r-q.
usage: Illuminationist, as in حکمای اشراقیین, the school of Suhrawardí; cited in discussions of philosophy.

definition: Arabic imperative of sharaḥa + -hu: dilate, expand; sharḥ al-ṣadr = gladdening the breast. Root sh-r-ḥ.
usage: 'Expand his breast'; prayers echo the Qur'anic شرح الصدر, asking God to gladden the heart.

definition: plural of shu‘á‘: rays, beams. Root sh-‘-‘.
usage: Rays, often of the Sun of Truth, as in اشعهٔ شمس حقیقت 'the rays of the Sun of Truth'.

definition: plural of shay’: things. Root sh-y-'.
usage: Things or created beings, as in حقایق اشیاء 'the realities of things'.

definition: Elative "most truthful"; in "Ibn-i Aṣdaq", a Hand of the Cause (son of Ismu'lláhu'l-Aṣdaq). Root ṣ-d-q.
usage: Most truthful; in ابن اصدق Ibn-i-Aṣdaq, Hand of the Cause, son of اسم الله الاصدق.

definition: Verbal noun (form IV): listening, hearkening. Root ṣ-gh-w.
usage: Hearkening or attentive listening, as in اصغا نمودن 'to give ear'.

definition: elative adjective: weakest, weaker. Root ḍ-‘-f.
usage: Weakest; often in self-effacing phrases, as in اضعف عباد 'the weakest of servants'.

definition: Noun: obedience, compliance. Root ṭ-w-‘.
usage: Obedience, as in اطاعت حکومت 'obedience to government' and obedience to God's laws.

definition: Verbal noun (form VIII): knowledge, information, being informed. Root ṭ-l-‘.
usage: Being informed or knowledge, as in اطلاع یافتن 'to be informed'.

definition: iṭmínán (assurance, certitude) + ast: is assurance. Root ṭ-m-n.
usage: Is assurance; اطمینان 'assurance' of heart is the fruit of faith and certitude.

definition: Plural of ṭawr; manners, ways, conduct, behaviour. Root ṭ-w-r.
usage: Manners or conduct, as in اطوار و اخلاق 'conduct and character'.

definition: Verbal noun (form VIII): moderation, temperateness, equilibrium. Root ‘-d-l.
usage: Moderation, as in اعتدال در جمیع امور 'moderation in all things', a principle of the Writings.

definition: plural of i‘tiráḍ: objections, criticisms. Root ‘-r-ḍ.
usage: Objections, especially those raised by opponents against the Faith.

definition: i‘tiná + indefinite -í: any attention, heed. Root ‘-n-y.
usage: Any attention or heed, usually in negation: paying no heed to opposition.

definition: Plural of ‘aduww: enemies. Root ‘-d-w.
usage: Enemies, often enemies of the Cause, as in اعدای امر 'enemies of the Faith'.

definition: noun: enemies; plural of ‘aduvv. Root ‘-d-w.
usage: Enemies; the Writings counsel love and kindness even toward them.

definition: A‘dá (enemies) with izáfih -y: the enemies of. Root ‘-d-w.
usage: The enemies of, as in اعدای امر الله 'the enemies of the Cause of God'.

definition: noun, plural of ‘uḍv: members, limbs. Root ‘-ḍ-w.
usage: Members or limbs, as in اعضای محفل 'members of the Assembly'.

definition: noun: announcement, proclamation. Form IV of root ‘-l-m.
usage: Announcement or proclamation, as of the Cause.

definition: Verbal noun (form IV): overlooking, winking at, forbearance. Root gh-m-ḍ.
usage: Overlooking others' faults, as in اغماض از خطا 'forbearing with faults'; a virtue urged on the believers.

definition: noun: sheep, flocks; plural of ghanam. Root gh-n-m.
usage: Sheep or flock; in the Writings an image for the people led by the divine Shepherd.

definition: noun, plural of ghayr: others, strangers, non-believers. Root gh-y-r.
usage: Strangers or others, often non-believers or rivals, contrasted with the beloved; also the 'others' besides God.

definition: áfáq "horizons, world" (plural of ufuq) + object marker rá. Root '-f-q.
usage: The horizons, the world, as in آفاق را روشن نمود 'illumined the horizons'.

definition: Intensive form: great liar, slanderer; affák-i-athím (Qur'án 26:222). Root '-f-k.
usage: A great liar; in the Qur'anic phrase افاک اثیم 'sinful liar', of slanderers of the Cause.

definition: 1st person singular past of uftádan: I fell; "dar fikr uftádam" I came to think.
usage: I fell; in idioms such as در فکر افتادم 'I came to think'.

definition: Past participle of uftádan: fallen; uftádih ast, has fallen.
usage: Fallen; also humble, lowly, as in افتاده و خاکسار 'lowly and humble'.

definition: Verbal noun: glorying, pride, honour; "iftikhár kardan" = to take pride. Root f-kh-r.
usage: Glorying or honour, as in افتخار نمودن 'to take pride'; true glory lies in servitude.

definition: 3rd sg. present/subjunctive of uftádan: falls.
usage: Falls; in compounds such as اتفاق افتد 'it happens'.

definition: past participle of afrúkhtan: lit, kindled, burning.
usage: Kindled; often of the fire of the love of God, as in شمع افروخته 'a lighted candle'.

definition: proper noun: Africa.
Plural of afsurdih: the dejected, the frozen-hearted.
usage: The dejected or frozen-hearted, whom the breezes of God revive.

definition: past participle of afshándan: scattered, sown.
usage: Scattered or sown, as of seeds of the Word.

definition: proper noun: Afghanistan.
Arabic plural of fu'ád: hearts. Root f-'-d.
usage: Hearts, as in افئدة المقربین 'the hearts of the near ones'.

definition: Plural of iqlím: regions, climes, countries.
usage: Regions or climes, as in اقالیم عالم 'the regions of the world' reached by the Cause.

definition: Iqámih (establishing, setting forth) with izáfih: establishing of (proof). Root q-w-m.
usage: Establishing, as in اقامهٔ برهان 'setting forth proof'.

definition: noun: sir, Mr., gentleman; with izáfih (áqá-yi).
usage: Sir or Mr.; a respectful title before names, as in آقای ... 'Mr. ...'.

definition: noun: turning towards, acceptance (of the Faith); good fortune. Form IV of root q-b-l.
usage: Turning toward and accepting the Faith, as in اقبال بامر الله 'turning to the Cause of God'; also good fortune.

definition: Verbal noun (form VIII): borrowing, acquiring, deriving (light). Root q-b-s.
usage: Acquiring or deriving, as in اقتباس انوار 'acquiring light' from the Sun of Truth.

definition: verbal noun (form VIII): power, might, authority. Root q-d-r.
usage: Power or authority, often divine might, as in قدرت و اقتدار.

definition: iqlím (clime, region) with -í: which region.
usage: A region or clime, as in هر اقلیمی 'every region'.

definition: Arabic plural of saḥar with article: pre-dawn hours. Root s-ḥ-r.
usage: The pre-dawn hours, as in بالاسحار 'at dawn', the times of prayer and supplication.

definition: noun: the dawning, sunrise; illumination. Form IV of root sh-r-q.
usage: Dawn or sunrise, as in بالعشی والاشراق 'at eventide and at dawn', a Qur'anic phrase used in prayers.

definition: al- + amwál (plural of mál): wealth, goods (Qur'án 2:155). Root m-w-l.
usage: Wealth or possessions; from Qur'án 2:155, 'loss of wealth and lives and fruits', cited on tests and trials.

definition: Arabic: the souls, lives (plural of nafs); Qur'án 2:155.
usage: Souls or lives; from Qur'án 2:155 on the trials by which God tests the believers.

definition: Arabic dual of baḥr with article: the two seas. Root b-ḥ-r.
usage: The two seas, a Qur'anic image (مرج البحرین) sometimes interpreted as two realms or oceans of meaning.

definition: Arabic noun with article: mankind, humanity; "Rabbu'l-bashar" Lord of mankind. Root b-sh-r.
usage: Mankind, as in رب البشر 'the Lord of mankind' and نوع البشر 'humankind'.

definition: verbal noun (form VIII): flaming, blazing; inflammation. Root l-h-b.
usage: Blazing, of the fire of the love of God burning in hearts.

definition: Arabic relative pronoun, feminine singular (and non-human plural): which, who.
noun/adjective: the steadfast ones; plural of thábit. Root th-b-t.
usage: The steadfast, as in الثابتین علی المیثاق 'those steadfast in the Covenant'.

definition: noun: the fruits; plural of thamarah (Qur'an 2:155). Root th-m-r.
usage: The fruits; from Qur'án 2:155 on the trials of believers, and the fruits of deeds.

definition: Arabic adjective with article: the glorious, the eminent. Root j-l-l.
usage: Glorious or eminent, often in divine names or titles of honour.

definition: al- + jinán (plural of janna): the gardens of Paradise. Root j-n-n.
usage: The gardens of Paradise, as in جنان الرضوان 'the gardens of good-pleasure'.

definition: Arabic noun with article: hunger, famine (Qur'án 2:155). Root j-w-‘.
usage: Hunger; from Qur'án 2:155, 'with something of fear and hunger', on divine tests.

definition: Arabic phrase: praise be to God, thank God.
usage: 'Praise be to God'; a frequent opening or exclamation of gratitude in the Writings.

definition: al- + ḥayát: the life; mádám al-ḥayát = as long as life lasts. Root ḥ-y-y.
usage: Life, as in مادام الحیات 'as long as life lasts' and نفحات الحیات 'breaths of life'.

definition: Arabic noun with article: fear. Root kh-w-f.
usage: Fear; from Qur'án 2:155, 'with something of fear', on trials sent to the believers.

definition: Arabic plural of rásikh: those firmly grounded, steadfast. Root r-s-kh.
usage: The firmly grounded, as in الراسخین فی العلم 'those firm in knowledge' (Qur'án 3:7); in the Writings also those firm in the Covenant.

definition: Arabic: the All-Merciful (divine name). Root r-ḥ-m.
usage: The All-Merciful, as in بسم الله الرحمن الرحیم 'In the name of God, the Merciful'.

definition: Arabic: good-pleasure; Paradise ("jannat ar-Riḍván"). Root r-ḍ-w.
usage: Good-pleasure and Paradise, as in جنة الرضوان; also the Riḍván Garden and Festival.

definition: noun: the companion; ar-rafíq al-a‘lá "the Supreme Companion" (the next world). Root r-f-q.
usage: The companion; in الرفیق الاعلی 'the Supreme Companion', the realm beyond to which souls ascend.

definition: ar- + rawḥ: rest, ease, refreshment (cf. Qur'án 56:89 rawḥ wa rayḥán). Root r-w-ḥ.
usage: Rest or repose, in the Qur'anic pairing الروح و الریحان 'repose and fragrance' (56:89).

definition: Arabic: sweet basil, fragrant herb; ar-rawḥ wa'r-rayḥán, rest and fragrance. Root r-w-ḥ.
usage: Fragrance, sweet basil; in الروح و الریحان 'rest and fragrance', the bliss of the next world.

definition: Arabic noun with article: the hour, the instant; "bur’ as-sá‘ah" = instant cure (with izáfih). Root s-w-‘.
usage: The hour or instant, as in برء الساعة 'instant healing'.

definition: Arabic noun with article: the prison; "yá ṣáḥibayi's-sijn" O my two prison companions (Qur'án 12). Root s-j-n.
usage: The prison, as in یا صاحبی السجن 'O my two fellow-prisoners' (Qur'án 12), echoed in the Writings of the prisoner of ‘Akká.

definition: Arabic: the Strong, the Mighty (divine attribute). Root sh-d-d.
usage: The Strong, the Mighty; in divine names such as شدید العقاب 'severe in punishment' or القوی الشدید.

definition: Arabic plural of ṣábir with article: the patient ones. Root ṣ-b-r.
usage: The patient, as in بشر الصابرین 'give glad tidings to the patient' (Qur'án 2:155).

definition: aṣ- + ṣiddíq: the truthful one; epithet (Yúsuf aṣ-Ṣiddíq). Root ṣ-d-q.
usage: The Truthful; an epithet, as in یوسف الصدیق 'Joseph the Truthful'.

definition: Arabic noun with article: oppression, tyranny. Root ẓ-l-m.
usage: Oppression or tyranny, often contrasted with justice (العدل).

definition: Arabic plural of ‘árif with article: those who know (God), mystics. Root ‘-r-f.
usage: Those who know God, the mystic knowers, as in قلوب العارفین 'the hearts of the knowers'.

definition: Arabic: the evening; fi'l-‘ashíy wa'l-ishráq, at eventide and dawn. Root ‘-sh-w.
usage: Evening, in the Qur'anic phrase بالعشی والاشراق 'at eventide and at dawn' (38:18).

definition: noun: the bones; plural of ‘aẓm (Qur'an 36:78). Root ‘-ẓ-m.
usage: The bones, in the Qur'anic من یحیی العظام وهی رمیم 'Who shall quicken the bones when rotten?' (36:78).

definition: Arabic noun with article: pardon, forgiveness. Root ‘-f-w.
usage: Pardon or forgiveness, sought in prayers, as in اسئلک العفو 'I ask Thy pardon'.

definition: Arabic: care, favour, providence (of God). Root ‘-n-y.
usage: Divine favour or providence, as in بعنایة الله 'by the providence of God'.

definition: Arabic feminine adjective: the bright, radiant, noble. Root gh-r-r.
usage: Bright, radiant, noble; an epithet of the law or the Faith, as in الشریعة الغراء 'the resplendent Law'.

definition: Arabic divine name: the All-Forgiving. Root gh-f-r.
usage: The All-Forgiving, invoked in prayers for forgiveness.

definition: Arabic noun with article: poverty; al-faqru fakhrí = poverty is my pride. Root f-q-r.
usage: Poverty, as in الفقر فخری 'poverty is my pride'; in the Writings poverty before God and detachment.

definition: al- + qalam: the pen; al-Qalam al-A‘lá = the Most Exalted Pen (Bahá'u'lláh). Root q-l-m.
usage: The Pen, as in القلم الاعلی 'the Most Exalted Pen', a designation of Bahá'u'lláh's revelation.

definition: al- + qawíy: the Strong, the Mighty (divine name). Root q-w-y.
usage: The Strong, the Mighty, as in العزیز القوی 'the Mighty, the Powerful'.

definition: Arabic: the Subtle, the Gracious (divine name). Root l-ṭ-f.
usage: The Subtle, the Gracious, as in اللطیف الخبیر 'the Subtle, the All-Aware'.

definition: Noun: pain, grief, suffering. Root '-l-m.
usage: Pain or grief, often of trials endured in the path of God.

definition: Arabic plural active participle (form IV) with article: the sincere ones. Root kh-l-ṣ.
usage: The sincere, as in قلوب المخلصین 'the hearts of the sincere'.

definition: al- + maqámát (plural of maqám): stations, ranks. Root q-w-m.
usage: Stations or ranks, as in اعلی المقامات 'the highest stations'.

definition: Arabic plural with article: those brought near (to God); "al-malá’ika al-muqarrabín". Root q-r-b.
usage: Those brought near to God, as in الملائکة المقربین 'the angels nigh unto God'.

definition: Arabic: assembly, host; "al-Mala' al-A‘lá" the Concourse on High. Root m-l-'.
usage: Assembly, as in الملأ الاعلی 'the Concourse on High', the company of holy souls in the next world.

definition: Arabic plural of malak with article: the angels. Root m-l-k.
usage: The angels; in the Writings also holy souls detached from the world.

definition: divine name: the Ever-Bestowing, the Bountiful. Root m-n-n.
usage: The Ever-Bestowing, the Bountiful, invoked in prayers.

definition: Arabic noun with article: favour, grace; "al-minnatu lilláh" = thanks be to God. Root m-n-n.
usage: Grace or favour, as in المنة لله 'thanks be to God'.

definition: Arabic plural participle (form VII): those attracted, enraptured. Root j-dh-b.
usage: Those attracted or enraptured by the love of God, as in المنجذبین بنفحات الله.

definition: Arabic plural with article: those who affirm God's oneness, monotheists. Root w-ḥ-d.
usage: Those who affirm the unity of God, the monotheists.

definition: Arabic: the point, dot; yá ayyatuha'n-nuqṭah, O Spot (of land). Root n-q-ṭ.
usage: The point; in the Writings also النقطة الاولی 'the Primal Point', the Báb; here a spot of land addressed in a Tablet.

definition: Arabic feminine adjective: luminous, radiant (of a letter). Root n-w-r.
usage: Luminous or radiant, as of a sacred spot or letter.

definition: Arabic adjective with article: the luminous, radiant. Root n-w-r.
usage: Luminous or radiant, of spiritual realities, as in الوجه النورانی 'the luminous face'.

definition: Verbal noun: inspiration, divine prompting. Root l-h-m.
usage: Inspiration, divine prompting, as in الهامات رحمانیه 'merciful inspirations'.

definition: Arabic noun with article: guidance. Root h-d-y.
usage: Guidance, as in نور الهدی 'the light of guidance'.

definition: active participle: situated, lying; an-nuqṭat al-váqi‘ah "the point lying". Root w-q-‘.
usage: Situated or lying, describing a place, as in the point (spot) lying in a region.

definition: Arabic divine name: the Generous, the Bountiful. Root k-r-m.
usage: The Generous, the Bountiful, invoked in prayers.

definition: Arabic: today, this day. Root y-w-m.
usage: Today; in the Writings often 'this Day' of God's Revelation, as in الیوم 'today' when service is most meritorious.

definition: plural of amal: hopes, aspirations. Root a-m-l.
usage: Hopes or aspirations, as in آمال و آرزو 'hopes and wishes'.

definition: noun: handmaid, maidservant; amatu’lláh "handmaid of God". Root '-m-w.
usage: Handmaid, as in امة الله 'handmaid of God', a form of address for Bahá'í women.

definition: noun: test, trial, examination. Form VIII of root m-ḥ-n.
usage: Test or trial, as in امتحانات الهیه 'divine tests' that sift the steadfast.

definition: verbal noun (form VIII): distinction, superiority, privilege. Root m-y-z.
usage: Distinction or privilege, as in امتیاز عالم انسانی 'the distinction of the human world'.

definition: plural of mithl: likes, similar things; also of mathal: parables. Root m-th-l.
usage: The likes of, as in امثال این 'such as these'; also parables.

definition: 1st person singular past of ámadan: I came.
Infinitive: to come; as noun, the coming (of Elijah, Christ).
usage: The coming, as in آمدن ایلیا 'the coming of Elijah' or the return of Christ.

definition: verb, 3rd pl. past of ámadan: they came.
Arabic amr + -í: my Cause; also Persian amrí, a matter.
usage: 'My Cause', spoken in the voice of God, as in امری 'My Cause'; in Persian amrí 'a matter'.

definition: proper name: America (variant of Amríká).
usage: America; ‘Abdu'l-Bahá wrote often of the American believers.

definition: noun: signature; imḍá farmúdan = to sign. Root m-ḍ-y.
usage: Signature, as in امضا فرمودن 'to sign'; Tablets were sealed or signed.

definition: noun: signature, signing. Root m-ḍ-y.
imḍá' + izáfih: signature. Root m-ḍ-y.
usage: The signature of, as in امضای عبدالبهاء.

definition: Arabic active participle (accusative) of amala: hoping, in hope. Root '-m-l.
usage: In hope, hoping; used in prayers, as in آملاً 'hoping' for God's grace.

definition: Plural of amr; affairs, matters. Root '-m-r.
usage: Affairs or matters, as in جمیع امور 'all affairs'.

definition: Adjective: hopeful.
usage: Hopeful; a frequent phrase in ‘Abdu'l-Bahá's letters, as in امیدوارم 'I hope'.

definition: noun: females, women; plural of unthá. Root '-n-th.
usage: Females, as in ذکور و اناث 'males and females', used in discussing equality of men and women.

definition: Verbal noun (form VII): gladness, expansion, joy. Root b-s-ṭ.
usage: Gladness or joy, as in روح و ریحان و انبساط 'joy and fragrance and gladness'.

definition: Plural of nabí; prophets. Root n-b-'.
usage: The Prophets, as in انبیای الهی 'the Prophets of God'.

definition: Plural of injidháb; spiritual attractions, raptures. Root j-dh-b (form VII).
usage: Spiritual raptures or attractions, as in انجذابات وجدانیه 'raptures of the heart'.

definition: anjuman "assembly, gathering, council" + -í (indefinite/any).
usage: An assembly or society; anjuman is used for associations and gatherings.

definition: Noun: the Gospel, the New Testament (from Greek euangelion).
usage: The Gospel, often cited alongside تورات 'the Torah' and قرآن 'the Qur'án'.

definition: verbal noun (form VII): dissolution, decay, weakening. Root ḥ-l-l.
usage: Dissolution or decay, of bodies or of the old order.

definition: 2nd person plural past of andákhtan: you threw, cast; "rishtih-yi ulfat andákhtan" to form a bond.
usage: You cast, as in رشتهٔ الفت انداختید 'you formed a bond of fellowship'.

definition: feminine form of insání: human. Root '-n-s.
usage: Human, as in عالم انسانیه 'the world of humanity' and کمالات انسانیه 'human perfections'.

definition: Plural of naẓar; eyes, views, sight, estimation. Root n-ẓ-r.
usage: Eyes or views, as in در انظار 'in the eyes of' the people.

definition: noun, plural of nafas: breaths, breathings. Root n-f-s.
usage: Breaths, as in انفاس طیبه 'goodly breaths' of holy souls.

definition: án + -and: they are (of that opinion); bar ánand, they hold.
usage: They are (of that view), as in بر آنند 'they hold'.

definition: án "that" + ham "also": that too, and that.
án "that" + váqi‘ih "event, incident". Root w-q-‘.
usage: That event or incident.

definition: án (that) + vujúd (being, person): that (dear) person.
usage: That (dear) person; a polite way of referring to someone in letters.

definition: Proper name: (T. Fisher) Unwin, London publisher.
usage: T. Fisher Unwin, the London publisher mentioned in connection with publishing Bahá'í works.

definition: Verbal noun (form IV): denial, rejection. Root n-k-r.
usage: Denial or rejection, especially of the Manifestation, as in انکار و استکبار 'denial and arrogance'.

definition: proper name: England, Britain.
Noun: intimate companion, friend. Root '-n-s.
usage: Intimate companion, as in انیس و جلیس 'companion and associate'; God as the companion of the lonely.

definition: noun: stirring, vibration, exultation. Form VIII of root h-z-z.
usage: Stirring or exultation, as in اهتزاز ارواح 'the stirring of souls' by the breezes of God.

definition: ahammíyyat + indefinite -í: any importance. Root h-m-m.
usage: Any importance; often in negation.

definition: adjective ávárih "homeless, wandering, exiled" + izáfih.
usage: Wandering or exiled, as in آوارهٔ کوه و بیابان 'a wanderer in mountain and desert'.

definition: noun: zenith, height, summit.
usage: Zenith or summit, as in اوج عزت 'the zenith of glory'.

definition: Verb: 3rd sg. present/subjunctive of ávardan, to bring; "písh ávarad" = bring about.
usage: Brings, as in پیش آورد 'bring about'.

definition: verb: I brought; 1st sg. past of ávardan (bi-já ávardam "I fulfilled").
usage: I brought; in بجا آوردم 'I fulfilled' or performed.

definition: Plural of vaqt; times, periods. Root w-q-t.
usage: Times, as in اوقات 'times' devoted to prayer or service.

definition: compound adjective: rearing children; awlád (children) + parvar (nurturing).
usage: Child-rearing, describing devoted mothers who nurture children.

definition: the city and university of Oxford, England.
usage: Oxford, the city and university, in letters to Professor Cheyne.

definition: Plural of yawm with -í: the days (that). Root y-w-m.
usage: The days; ایام 'days' often refers to the days of the Manifestation, as in ایام الله.

definition: ayyám (days) + -í + kih: the days when.
usage: The days when; introduces recollection of past times.

definition: Arabic noun: sign, verse, token. Root '-y-y.
usage: Sign or verse, as in آیات الله 'the verses of God' and آیة من آیات 'a sign among the signs'.

definition: Arabic vocative particle (feminine): O!, used after yá.
Adjective/noun: Iranian, Persian.
usage: Persian, Iranian; the Persian believers.

definition: noun: God (Old Persian origin).
usage: God, an old Persian name used in poetry and elevated prose.

definition: pronoun: they; he/she (respectful).
usage: They; also a respectful 'he' or 'she' used of honoured persons.

definition: noun: certitude, firm conviction. Form IV of root y-q-n.
usage: Certitude, as in کتاب ایقان 'the Book of Certitude' (Kitáb-i-Íqán).

definition: proper name: Elijah, the prophet.
usage: Elijah, whose return is discussed in the Writings as a spiritual return.

definition: Ímán (faith) + ast (is) joined: is faith.
usage: Is faith; ایمان 'faith' is defined in the Writings as conscious knowledge and good deeds.

definition: ín (this) + ḥálat (state, condition).
usage: This state or condition.

definition: adverb: like this, so, in this way.
Pronoun: these, these people (plural of ín).
ín "this" + ham "also": this also, and this.
ín (this) + hamih (all): all these, so many.
bi- "to" + ákhar "end"; "bi-ákhar rasídan" = to come to an end. Root a-kh-r.
usage: To the end, as in بآخر رسیدن 'to come to an end'.

definition: Verb, optative of búdan: may it be; "har chih bádá bád" come what may. (Also noun bád "wind".)
usage: May it be, as in هر چه بادا باد 'come what may'.

definition: verb: may it be (optative of búdan); harchih bádá bád "come what may".
usage: May it be, as in هر چه بادا باد 'come what may'.

definition: Noun: wine (often mystical); "bádih-furúsh" wine-seller.
usage: Wine, the mystic wine of divine love, as in بادهٔ محبت الله 'the wine of the love of God'.

definition: bi- + irádih + izáfih: by/according to the will (of). Root r-w-d.
usage: By the will of, as in بارادهٔ الله 'by the will of God'.

definition: bi- + ism (name): in the name of, under the pretext of. Root s-m-w.
usage: In the name of, as in باسم الله 'in the name of God'; also 'under the name or pretext of'.

definition: verb, 2nd sg. imperative of búdan: be!
usage: Be!, in exhortations, as in ثابت باش 'be steadfast'.

definition: bi- + iṭṭilá‘ (knowledge, information): to the attention of. Root ṭ-l-‘.
usage: To the knowledge or attention of, as in باطلاع رسید 'came to the attention of'.

definition: Active participle: cause, motive, occasion. Root b-‘-th.
usage: Cause or occasion, as in باعث سرور 'cause of joy'.

definition: Preposition bi- + a‘lá (highest): to the highest (stations). Root ‘-l-w.
usage: To the highest, as in باعلی مقامات 'to the highest stations'.

definition: noun: gardener.
usage: Gardener; an image for the divine Educator who tends the garden of hearts.

definition: bi + iftirá (slander, calumny) with izáfih. Root f-r-y.
usage: To calumny; used of the slanders of opponents against the Faith.

definition: Noun: upper room, upstairs chamber.
usage: An upper room; in the Gospel account, the room of the Last Supper.

definition: noun bálá "top, upper part" + izáfih: top of, above.
Arabic bi- + ad-dukhúl (entering, entry); by entering. Root d-kh-l.
usage: By entering, as in بالدخول فی ملکوت الله 'by entering the Kingdom of God'.

definition: Arabic bi- + alṭáf (favours, pl. of luṭf) + -ka (Thy). Root l-ṭ-f.
usage: By Thy favours; used in prayers addressing God.

definition: bi + al- + ‘afw: with forgiveness, with pardon. Root ‘-f-w.
usage: With pardon, as in prayers that God may treat a soul with forgiveness.

definition: adverb: on the contrary, conversely. Root ‘-k-s.
bi + Alláh: in/by God; mu’min bi'lláh = believer in God.
usage: In God or by God, as in مؤمن بالله 'believer in God'.

definition: noun: pillow, bedside.
usage: Pillow or bedside, as in بر بالین بیمار 'at the bedside of the sick'.

definition: bi + umíd (hope): in the hope (that).
usage: In the hope (that); a frequent phrase in letters.

definition: Prefix bi- + án-janáb "that honoured one": to you/him (polite).
usage: To you (or him), the honoured one; a polite form of address in letters.
