definition: Preposition phrase: despite, notwithstanding (bá "with" + vujúd "existence").
Arabic bi- (by, in) + ayy (whichever); "bi-ayyi wajhin kána" = by any means whatsoever.
usage: By whatever (means), as in بای وجه کان 'in whatever way it may be'.

definition: bi "with" + bádih "wine" + izáfih.
usage: With the wine of, as in ببادهٔ محبت 'with the wine of love'.

definition: 2nd pl. imperative/subjunctive of burdan: take, carry; panáh burdan, seek refuge.
usage: Take or carry, as in پناه ببرید 'seek refuge'.

definition: Bi- (with, by) + bishárát (glad tidings): by the glad tidings. Root b-sh-r.
usage: By the glad tidings, as of prophecies fulfilled in this Day.

definition: bi- + bulúgh (maturity, attainment). Root b-l-gh.
usage: To maturity, as in ببلوغ عالم 'to the maturity of the world', or of children.

definition: Imperative 2nd sg. of búsídan: kiss!
usage: Kiss!; in letters, as in a request to kiss someone's face on ‘Abdu'l-Bahá's behalf.

definition: present 1st sg. subjunctive of dídan: (that) I see.
bi + táríkh "date, history": dated, on the date of.
usage: Dated, used in mentioning the date of a letter, as in بتاریخ ... 'dated ...'.

definition: bi- "with" + tarannum "singing, warbling" (form V). Root r-n-m.
usage: Tarannum is the warbling or chanting of birds and singers; in the Writings the nightingale's song stands for praise of God, as in ترنّم بلبل 'the warbling of the nightingale'.

definition: bi- (in, to) + tarvíj (promotion, spreading, propagation). Root r-w-j.
usage: Tarvíj is the promotion or spreading of something; ‘Abdu'l-Bahá uses it of promoting the teachings and the Cause, as in ترویج تعالیم 'promoting the teachings'.

definition: bi- + ta‘arruḍ (opposition, molestation, attack). Root ‘-r-ḍ.
usage: Ta‘arruḍ means molestation, interference or attack; in the Writings it describes persecution of the believers, as in تعرّض اعدا 'the molestation of enemies'.

definition: bi "to" + ta‘allum "learning, study"; form V of root ‘-l-m.
usage: Ta‘allum is learning or study; the Writings repeatedly urge the acquisition of knowledge, as in تعلّم علوم و فنون 'the learning of sciences and arts'.

definition: bi- + tamám: with all, with full. Root t-m-m.
usage: Bi-tamám means 'with all' or 'with full'; ‘Abdu'l-Bahá uses it of wholehearted effort, as in بتمام قوّت 'with all one's strength'.

definition: bi "to" + tu "you (sg.)".
bi- "to" + jamál "beauty"; "Jamál-i Mubárak" = the Blessed Beauty (Bahá'u'lláh). Root j-m-l.
usage: Jamál, 'Beauty', is a title of Bahá'u'lláh, as in جمال مبارک 'the Blessed Beauty' and جمال قدم 'the Ancient Beauty'; also beauty in general.

definition: bi + junúd "hosts, armies" (plural of jund).
usage: Junúd are hosts or armies; in the Writings often spiritual hosts, as in جنود ملأ اعلی 'the hosts of the Concourse on High' and جنود الهام 'hosts of inspiration'.

definition: Bi- (to) + jahán (world) + indefinite -í: to a (hidden) world.
usage: Jahán means 'world'; the Writings speak of this world and of other worlds of God, as in جهان الهی 'the divine world' and جهان پنهان 'the hidden world'.

definition: bi- + jihat (direction, side) + -í: in some direction, somewhere. Root w-j-h.
usage: Jihat means direction or side, and by extension reason or cause; بجهتی 'for some reason' and از جهتی 'in one respect' are common.

definition: plural of baḥr: seas, oceans. Root b-ḥ-r.
usage: Biḥár, 'seas', appears in imagery of divine bounty and knowledge, as in بحار علم 'the oceans of knowledge'.

definition: bi- (into) + ḥarakat (motion, movement); "bi-ḥarakat ámadan" = to be set in motion. Root ḥ-r-k.
usage: Ḥarakat is motion or movement; ‘Abdu'l-Bahá uses بحرکت آمدن 'to be set in motion' of souls stirred by the Cause.

definition: bi + ḥasrat "longing, regret".
usage: Ḥasrat is regret or longing; often in بحسرت 'with regret' and in the yearning of lovers for the Beloved.

definition: Prefix bi- "to" + ḥaḍrat "Presence, His Holiness". Root ḥ-ḍ-r.
usage: Ḥaḍrat, 'His Holiness, Presence', is the honorific prefixed to the Central Figures and prophets, as in حضرت بهاءالله and حضرت عبدالبهاء.

definition: bi- + ḥuṭám: worldly goods, transient wealth (lit. debris). Root ḥ-ṭ-m.
usage: Ḥuṭám is the transient dross of worldly goods; the Writings warn against attachment to حطام دنیا 'the vanities of the world'.

definition: bi "to, in" + ḥaqíqat "reality, truth".
usage: Ḥaqíqat is reality or truth; central in ‘Abdu'l-Bahá's talks, as in حقیقت انسانیّه 'the reality of man' and بحقیقت 'in truth, truly'.

definition: bi + ḥamd (praise); bi-ḥamdi'lláh, praise be to God. Root ḥ-m-d.
usage: Bi-ḥamd opens the formula بحمد الله 'praise be to God', used to give thanks for good news of the believers.

definition: bi- + khánih: into/to the house.
bi (to) + Khudá: to God.
usage: Khudá is the everyday Persian word for God; بخدا 'to God' or 'by God', and in phrases such as توجّه بخدا 'turning to God'.

definition: bi- + khidmat (service) + indefinite -í: in some service. Root kh-d-m.
usage: Khidmat is service; in the Writings service to the Cause and to humanity, as in خدمت امر الله 'service to the Cause of God'.

definition: 2nd person singular imperative of bakhshídan: give, bestow.
usage: Bakhshídan means to bestow or grant; used in prayers asking God for gifts, as in ببخش 'bestow' or 'forgive'.

definition: Verb, 3rd pl. subjunctive/present of bakhshídan: (that) they give, grant.
usage: Bakhshídan, 'to give, grant', describes bestowing bounties, as in روح بخشند 'they impart spirit'.

definition: Bi- (in, with) + khaṭṭ (handwriting, script): in (my) handwriting.
usage: Khaṭṭ is handwriting or script; ‘Abdu'l-Bahá notes when a Tablet is بخطّ مبارک 'in the blessed handwriting'.

definition: imperative 2nd sg. of khwándan: read! study!
usage: Khwándan means to read or recite; the Writings command the reading of the verses of God, as in بخوان 'read, recite'.

definition: verb: you (pl.) want, call for, summon; 2nd pl. subjunctive/imperative of khwástan.
usage: Khwástan means to want, ask for or summon; in letters it often means to request or call someone.

definition: bi + khud: to (him)self.
bi- + khud + -í: bi-khudí-yi khud = on one's own, of one's own accord.
usage: Bi-khudí-yi khud means 'of one's own accord'; ‘Abdu'l-Bahá uses it of things that happen without effort or human agency.

definition: Prefix bi- "with, by" + khún "blood".
usage: Khún, 'blood', appears in the imagery of martyrdom, as in بخون آغشته 'steeped in blood'.

definition: Noun: beginning, outset. Root b-d-'.
usage: Bidáyat means beginning; used in پیش از بدایت 'from the beginning' and paired with نهایت 'end'.

definition: adjective: unfortunate, wretched, miserable.
usage: Badbakht means wretched or unfortunate; ‘Abdu'l-Bahá uses it of those deprived of the divine bounty.

definition: Noun: misfortune, wretchedness; bad (bad) + bakht (fortune) + -í.
usage: Badbakhtí is misfortune or wretchedness, the state of those who turn away from God or suffer worldly ruin.

definition: Bi- (by, in) + dukhúl (entering, entry): by entering. Root d-kh-l.
usage: Dukhúl is entering; used of entering the Kingdom or the Cause, as in دخول در ملکوت 'entering the Kingdom'.

definition: bi- + darajih (degree): to such a degree. Root d-r-j.
usage: Darajih is degree or rank; بدرجه‌ای 'to such a degree' expresses extent.

definition: bi- + darajih (degree, rank): to the station/degree of. Root d-r-j.
usage: Darajih is degree or station; بدرجهٴ 'to the station of' describes reaching a spiritual rank, as in درجهٴ شهادت 'the station of martyrdom'.

definition: bi- "to" + darajih "degree, extent"; spelling variant/typo for بدرجه. Root d-r-j.
usage: Variant spelling of بدرجه; darajih is degree or extent, used to express how far something goes.

definition: Badraqih (escort, guide on a journey) with izáfih: the escort of (grace).
usage: Badraqih is an escort on a journey; ‘Abdu'l-Bahá speaks of divine grace as the escort of a traveller, as in بدرقهٴ عنایت 'the escort of grace'.

definition: Prefix bi- "to" + du "two": to (the) two.
bi- (to) + diyár (lands, homeland; plural of dár). Root d-w-r.
usage: Diyár are lands or homeland; used in phrases like دیار غربت 'lands of exile'.

definition: bi- + dídan: to see, to visit.
usage: Bi-dídan means 'to visit'; used of going to meet someone or visiting the Holy Shrines.

definition: bi + dídih (eye) with izáfih: with the eye of.
usage: Dídih means the eye; in بدیدهٴ 'with the eye of', as in دیدهٴ بصیرت 'the eye of insight'.

definition: adjective: new, wondrous, unprecedented; dawr-i badí‘ = the new dispensation. Root b-d-‘.
usage: Badí‘ means new or wondrous; in the Writings it marks the new Revelation, as in امر بدیع 'the new Cause', دور بدیع 'the new Dispensation', and the Badí‘ calendar.

definition: Adjective: self-evident, obvious, axiomatic. Root b-d-h.
usage: Badíhí means self-evident or obvious; ‘Abdu'l-Bahá uses it in rational arguments, as in واضح و بدیهی است 'it is clear and self-evident'.

definition: badhr "seed" + indefinite -í. Root b-dh-r.
usage: Badhr, 'seed', appears in the imagery of sowing the seeds of the Cause and of love in hearts.

definition: noun: healing, recovery; "bur’-i as-sá‘a" = instant cure. Root b-r-’.
usage: Bur’ is healing or recovery; ‘Abdu'l-Bahá refers to برء الساعة 'instant cure' in discussions of spiritual and material healing.

definition: Noun: brother.
usage: Barádar, 'brother'; used of the believers as brothers and in the oneness of humanity.

definition: bi- + ráh (way, path): to the path.
usage: Ráh, 'way, path'; used of the path of God, as in راه خدا 'the path of God', and in براه 'onto the path'.

definition: noun: proofs, arguments; plural of burhán. Root b-r-h-n.
usage: Baráhín are proofs; ‘Abdu'l-Bahá pairs them as دلایل و براهین 'proofs and evidences' for the truth of the Cause.

definition: verb: they snatch away; 3rd pl. subjunctive of rubúdan (bar-rubúdan).
usage: Rubúdan, 'to snatch away', is used of winning or carrying off, as in گوی سبقت بربایند 'that they carry off the palm'.

definition: verb: snatch away, carry off; imperative 2nd pl. of rubúdan.
usage: Rubúdan, 'to snatch', appears in exhortations to win the prize, as in گوی سبقت بربایید 'carry off the palm'.

definition: verb, 3rd sg. past of barkhástan: rose, arose; was removed.
usage: Barkhástan means to rise or arise, and also to be removed; used of souls arising to serve and of differences disappearing.

definition: verb: took, carried away; 3rd sg. past of burdan (az miyán burd "destroyed").
usage: Burdan means to carry or take; in از میان برد 'destroyed, removed' and figurative phrases such as پی برد 'perceived'.

definition: Past participle of burdan, to carry; "ḥasad burdih-and" = have envied.
usage: Burdih, past participle of burdan, forms compound verbs, as in حسد برده‌اند 'have envied' and پی برده 'have perceived'.

definition: adjective: established, firm, stable.
usage: Barqarár means established or firm; used of the establishment of peace and institutions, as in برقرار شود 'be established'.

definition: Burma (Myanmar).
verb: goes, may go; 3rd sg. subjunctive of raftan.
1st person plural subjunctive of raftan: (that) we go, let us go.
Adjective: wild, of the land/wilderness. Root b-r-r.
usage: Barrí means wild or of the land; contrasted with بحری 'of the sea', or describing wild nature.

definition: biryán (roasted; burning with grief) + ast: is aflame.
usage: Biryán means roasted, and figuratively a heart burning with grief, as in دل بریان 'a burning heart'.

definition: adjective (fem. nisba): wild, of the desert or land. Root b-r-r.
usage: Barriyyih means wild or of the wilderness; also 'creation' in Arabic phrases such as بریّه 'the creatures'.

definition: Noun: banquet, festive gathering.
usage: Bazm is a feast or festive gathering; in mystical imagery, as in بزم الهی 'the divine banquet'.

definition: 3rd person singular subjunctive of zadan: (that he) strike, inflict.
Prefix bi- + zíyárat "visit, pilgrimage" (to a shrine). Root z-w-r.
usage: Ziyárat is visiting a holy place; in the Writings pilgrimage to the Holy Shrines, as in زیارت روضهٴ مبارکه 'visiting the Blessed Shrine', and the Tablet of Visitation.

definition: bi- (to) + sá’ir (the rest, the other). Root s-'-r.
usage: Sá’ir means 'the rest, the other'; common in بسایر 'to the other' and سایر احبّا 'the other friends'.

definition: noun/past stem of bastan: binding; band u bast = restrictions, fetters.
usage: Bast means binding; in the pair بند و بست 'restrictions, fetters' and in بست 'sanctuary'.

definition: adjective: of the garden, cultivated (from bustán, garden).
usage: Bustání means cultivated or of the garden; ‘Abdu'l-Bahá contrasts garden-grown with wild plants in his teaching on education.

definition: bi "to" + sar-manzil "destination, goal".
usage: Sar-manzil is the final destination of a journey; figuratively the goal of the spiritual path.

definition: Arabic: bi- "in" + ism "name"; "bismi'lláh" in the name of God.
usage: Bism, 'in the name', opens Tablets and prayers, as in بسم الله الرحمن الرحیم 'In the name of God, the Merciful, the Compassionate'.

definition: conjunction: so much that, since so very; "az baskih" = because so much.
bi + sí (thirty): for thirty (pieces); elsewhere basí, much.
feminine form of basharí: human. Root b-sh-r.
usage: Bashariyyih means human; in phrases such as عالم بشریّه 'the world of humanity' and نفوس بشریّه 'human souls'.

definition: bi "to" + shumá "you (pl./polite)".
Arabic bi- + shay' (thing): with something (Qur'an 2:155). Root sh-y-'.
usage: Shay’ means 'thing'; this phrase recalls Qur'an 2:155, 'We will test you with something of fear and hunger'.

definition: Noun: sight, eye, vision. Root b-ṣ-r.
usage: Baṣar is sight or the eye; contrasted with بصیرت 'insight', as in چشم بصر 'the outward eye'.

definition: baṣírat (insight) + ast (is).
usage: Baṣírat is spiritual insight; common in دیدهٴ بصیرت 'the eye of insight', the inner perception the Writings ask believers to open.

definition: bi- + ṭabábat: by medical treatment. Root ṭ-b-b.
usage: Ṭabábat is medicine or medical treatment; ‘Abdu'l-Bahá discusses healing بطبابت 'by medicine' alongside spiritual healing.

definition: 2nd person plural imperative of ṭalabídan: seek, ask for.
usage: Ṭalabídan means to seek or ask for; used in exhortations to seek divine confirmation and knowledge.

definition: bi + ṭawr "manner" + -í + kih: in such a way that.
Adjective: slow, tardy. Root b-ṭ-'.
usage: Baṭí’ means slow; used in contrasting slow and swift progress or healing.

definition: adverb: outwardly, apparently, seemingly. Root ẓ-h-r.
usage: Bi-ẓáhir means outwardly or apparently; contrasted with باطن 'inwardly', as in بظاهر 'in outward appearance'.

definition: bi- + ẓuhúr (appearance, manifestation); "bi-ẓuhúr rasándan" = to fulfil. Root ẓ-h-r.
usage: Ẓuhúr is manifestation or appearance; in the Writings above all the appearance of a Manifestation of God, as in ظهور جمال قدم; بظهور رساندن 'to bring to pass'.

definition: Bi- (in, with) + ‘ibárat (expression, words): in (explicit) words. Root ‘-b-r.
usage: ‘Ibárat is expression or wording; in بعبارت اخری 'in other words' and بعبارت صریحه 'in explicit words'.

definition: Bi- (to) + ‘arṣih (arena, field) with izáfih: into the arena of (manifestation).
usage: ‘Arṣih is an arena or field; common in عرصهٴ وجود 'the arena of existence' and عرصهٴ شهود 'the realm of manifestation'.

definition: bi- + ‘aẓamat: to/in the greatness. Root ‘-ẓ-m.
usage: ‘Aẓamat is greatness or majesty; used of the greatness of the Cause and of God, as in عظمت امر 'the greatness of the Cause'.

definition: Prefix bi- + ‘unván "title": under the pretext of, as. Root ‘-n-w.
usage: ‘Unván is a title or heading; بعنوان means 'as' or 'under the pretext of'.

definition: bi- + ‘awn (help, aid). Root ‘-w-n.
usage: ‘Awn is help; usually divine aid, as in بعون الله 'with God's help' and بعون و عنایت 'by the help and favour (of God)'.

definition: Prefix bi- + ‘aks "reverse": on the contrary, conversely. Root ‘-k-s.
usage: Bi-‘aks means 'on the contrary, conversely'; used in argument to introduce the opposite case.

definition: Arabic adverb: suddenly, unexpectedly. Root b-gh-t.
usage: Baghtatan means 'suddenly'; recalls Qur'anic warnings that the Hour comes suddenly.

definition: noun: hatred, rancor. Root b-gh-ḍ.
usage: Bughḍ is hatred; paired with عداوت or کین in warnings against enmity, as in بغض و عداوت 'hatred and enmity'.

definition: preposition: except, other than; "bi-ghayr az" = apart from. Root gh-y-r.
usage: Bi-ghayr means 'except, other than'; common in بغیر از 'apart from'.

definition: verb: sells; 3rd sg. subjunctive of furúkhtan.
bi- (by, through) + fayḍ (grace, effulgence, bounty). Root f-y-ḍ.
usage: Fayḍ is grace or outpouring bounty; central in the Writings, as in فیض الهی 'the divine grace' and فیض روح القدس 'the bounty of the Holy Spirit'.

definition: noun: permanence, continuance, survival. Root b-q-y.
usage: Baqá is permanence or everlasting life; in mystical usage paired with فنا 'annihilation', and in عالم بقا 'the world of eternity'.

definition: bi- "with" + qirá’a "reading, recitation"; "‘alayka bi-qirá’a" = you should recite. Root q-r-’.
usage: Qirá’a is reading or recitation, especially of the verses of God, as in قرائة آیات 'reciting the verses'.

definition: bi- "according to" + qawl "saying, word": in the words of. Root q-w-l.
usage: Qawl is a saying or word; بقول 'in the words of' introduces a quotation from a poet or scripture.

definition: Plural of balad; countries, cities, lands. Root b-l-d.
usage: Bilád are countries or lands; in phrases such as بلاد غرب 'the Western lands' and سایر بلاد 'other countries'.

definition: noun: eloquence. Root b-l-gh.
usage: Balághat is eloquence; paired with فصاحت in praising the eloquence of the divine Word.

definition: balá "affliction, trial" + Persian plural -há.
usage: Balá is affliction or trial; in the Writings tests and sufferings borne in the path of God, as in بلایا و رزایا.

definition: Plural of baliyyih; calamities, trials. Root b-l-w.
usage: Baláyá are calamities or trials, often those borne by the Manifestation and the believers, as in بلایا و محن 'calamities and tribulations'.

definition: Noun: nightingale.
usage: Bulbul, the nightingale, symbolizes the lover or the Manifestation singing God's praise, as in بلبل معانی 'the Nightingale of inner meanings'.

definition: proper name: Balkh, ancient city in northern Afghanistan.
bi "with, to" + maḥabbat "love". Root ḥ-b-b.
usage: Maḥabbat is love; a keynote of ‘Abdu'l-Bahá's teaching, as in محبّت الله 'the love of God' and بمحبّت 'with love'.

definition: bi- + maḥḍ (mere); "bi-maḥḍ-i ínkih" = as soon as, the moment that. Root m-ḥ-ḍ.
usage: Bi-maḥḍ means 'as soon as' in بمحض اینکه; maḥḍ also means 'mere, pure', as in محض رضای الهی 'purely for God's good pleasure'.

definition: Prefix bi- + mukhálifat "opposition" (form III). Root kh-l-f.
usage: Mukhálifat is opposition; used of opposition to the Cause, as in بمخالفت برخاستند 'arose in opposition'.

definition: bi (to) + Misis (Mrs., from English).
bi + manẓar (view, scene, place of looking); manẓar-i-akbar, the Most Great Horizon. Root n-ẓ-r.
usage: Manẓar is a view or place of looking; in the Writings منظر اکبر 'the Most Great Horizon' refers to Bahá'u'lláh's station.

definition: bi + mítháq: to the Covenant. Root w-th-q.
usage: Mítháq is the Covenant; in the Writings the Covenant of Bahá'u'lláh centred on ‘Abdu'l-Bahá, as in ثبوت بر میثاق 'firmness in the Covenant'.

definition: noun: building, construction; biná shudan = to be built. Root b-n-y.
usage: Biná is building or construction; used of raising institutions and the Mashriqu'l-Adhkár, as in بنا شدن 'to be built'.

definition: noun, plural of bint: daughters, girls. Root b-n-y.
usage: Banát are daughters or girls; in schools for girls, as in مدرسهٴ بنات 'girls' school'.

definition: Proper name: Bonaparte (Napoleon).
Noun: bond, fetter, chain; "band u bast" restrictions.
usage: Band is a bond or fetter; in بند و بست 'restrictions' and figurative bonds of attachment from which the soul should be freed.

definition: bi- "by, to" + nidá’ "call, summons". Root n-d-w.
usage: Nidá’ is a call or summons; in the Writings the call of God, as in نداء الهی 'the divine call' and نداء ملکوت 'the call of the Kingdom'.

definition: Prefix bi- + nidá "call, cry" with izáfih. Root n-d-w.
usage: Nidá is a call; used in phrases like بندای ملکوت 'with the call of the Kingdom', the proclamation of the Cause.

definition: Plural of bandih: servants, slaves (of God).
usage: Bandagán are servants, especially servants of God, as in بندگان الهی 'the servants of God'.

definition: bi- (by) + naṣṣ (explicit text, ordinance): according to the explicit text. Root n-ṣ-ṣ.
usage: Naṣṣ is an explicit text; in the Writings the explicit text of Bahá'u'lláh, as in بنصّ صریح 'by the explicit text'.

definition: bi- + nafs (self, soul): by the self, in person. Root n-f-s.
usage: Bi-nafs means 'in person, by oneself'; nafs also means the soul or the self.

definition: verb, 3rd sg. subjunctive of namúdan: (that) he show, do.
usage: Namúdan, 'to show, do', is the common auxiliary for compound verbs in the Writings, as in قیام بنماید 'arise'.

definition: present 1st sg. subjunctive of namúdan: (that) I do/make.
usage: Namúdan serves as the auxiliary of compound verbs, as in خدمتی بنمایم 'that I render a service'.

definition: verb, 3rd sg. subjunctive of nigáshtan: (that) he write, compose.
usage: Nigáshtan means to write or compose; ‘Abdu'l-Bahá uses it for writing letters and Tablets.

definition: 3rd sg. past of nigáshtan with prefix bi-: he wrote, composed.
usage: Nigáshtan means to write or compose; used of letters and Tablets written by ‘Abdu'l-Bahá or the believers.

definition: noun: foundation, basis.
usage: Bunyád is a foundation or basis; as in بنیاد عالم انسانی 'the foundation of the world of humanity' and the foundations of the Cause.

definition: Bunyán (building, structure) + indefinite -í: a structure. Root b-n-y.
usage: Bunyán is a structure or edifice; recalls the Qur'anic بنیان مرصوص 'a solid structure', of united believers.

definition: noun: bodily constitution, physique. Root b-n-y.
usage: Bunyih is bodily constitution or physique; used of health and strength.

definition: Noun: spring (season).
usage: Bahár, spring, is a major image of the new Revelation, as in بهار روحانی 'the spiritual springtime'.

definition: Bahá (Glory, the Blessed Beauty) + ast (is); "ahl-i Bahást" = is of the people of Bahá.
usage: Bahá, 'Glory', is the Greatest Name and Bahá'u'lláh's title; in اهل بهاست 'is of the people of Bahá', meaning a true believer.

definition: bihtar + -am: I am better.
Bi- (to) + hidáyat (guidance): to the guiding (of others). Root h-d-y.
usage: Hidáyat is guidance; in the Writings divine guidance, as in هدایت الله 'the guidance of God' and guiding souls to the Faith.

definition: preposition: for, for the sake of (bahr-i).
usage: Bahr, 'for the sake of', appears in phrases like بهر خدا 'for God's sake'.

definition: bi + hamchinín: likewise, in the same way.
2nd sg. past of búdan (auxiliary): you were; marqúm namúdih búdí, you had written.
Verb, 2nd pl. past of búdan: you were; auxiliary in pluperfect (had …).
Verb: 1st pl. past of búdan, to be.
Verb: 3rd sg. subjunctive of pardákhtan, to devote oneself to, engage in.
usage: Pardákhtan means to devote oneself to or engage in; common in exhortations such as بخدمت بپردازد 'devote himself to service'.

definition: verb: ask; imperative 2nd pl. of pursídan.
bi- + púl: for money, of money.
verb, 3rd pl. subjunctive of charídan: (that) they graze.
usage: Charídan, 'to graze', is used of animals, sometimes in contrast with the spiritual life of man.

definition: bi- + chih (what): with what, by what (here "bi-chih zaḥmátí", with what hardships); also bachchih, child.
verb: they kill; 3rd pl. subjunctive of kushtan.
usage: Kushtan, 'to kill', is used of the persecution and martyrdom of the believers.

definition: Prefix bi- "to" + kull "all": to all, towards everyone. Root k-l-l.
usage: Kull means all or everyone; in بکلّ 'to all' and the Arabic کلّ شیء 'all things'.

definition: Verb, 3rd sg. past of gudákhtan (with bi-): melted, was consumed.
usage: Gudákhtan means to melt; figuratively of a heart melting with grief or love.

definition: Prefix bi- + gadá'í "begging, mendicancy".
usage: Gadá'í is begging; used literally and of the soul's humble entreaty at God's door.

definition: 3rd person singular subjunctive of gudháshtan: (that he) place, put.
usage: Gudháshtan means to put or place; in phrases such as قدم بگذارد 'set foot'.

definition: Verb: 3rd pl. subjunctive of guzáshtan, to leave, let, place.
usage: Gudháshtan means to leave, let or place; used in phrases like فرو نگذارند 'not neglect'.

definition: verb, 1st pl. subjunctive of guzáshtan: (that) we let, allow.
present 3rd pl. subjunctive of gushúdan: (that) they open.
usage: Gushúdan means to open; used of opening eyes, hearts and doors, as in ابواب بگشایند 'open the doors'.

definition: imperative/subjunctive 2nd pl. of gushúdan: open!
usage: Gushúdan, 'to open'; ‘Abdu'l-Bahá urges the friends to open their eyes and tongues, as in زبان بگشایید 'open your tongues'.

definition: bi- "in" + gumán "supposition": supposing, under the impression.
usage: Gumán is supposition or opinion; often of mistaken assumptions, as in بگمان 'supposing'.

definition: Utterance, exposition, explanation. Root b-y-n.
usage: Bayán is utterance or exposition; in the Writings the divine utterance, and also the Bayán, the Báb's Book.

definition: adjective: lifeless, without soul.
usage: Bíján, 'lifeless', describes the dead in spirit whom the breath of the Holy Spirit revives.

definition: adjective: incurable, without remedy.
usage: Bídarmán, 'incurable', describes the ills of the world for which the divine teachings are the remedy.

definition: bídarmán "incurable, without remedy" + object marker rá.
usage: Bídarmán, 'incurable', describes chronic spiritual or social ills that only the divine physician can heal.

definition: bízár (averse, disgusted) + -íd (you are).
usage: Bízár means averse or disgusted; used of turning away from the world or from strife.

definition: Number: twenty.
adjective/adverb: more, most.
Arabic feminine adjective: white, shining; "buq‘ih-yi bayḍá" = the white spot. Root b-y-ḍ.
usage: Bayḍá means white or shining; recalls Moses' يد بيضاء 'the white hand', and بقعهٴ بیضا 'the snow-white spot'.

definition: Noun: restlessness, agitation, longing; bí (without) + qarár (rest).
usage: Bíqarárí is restlessness or longing; the restlessness of the lover separated from the Beloved.

definition: Arabic preposition: between, among. Root b-y-n.
verb, 3rd pl. subjunctive of andákhtan: (that) they throw, cause.
usage: Andákhtan means to throw or cast; in phrases like بیندازند 'cast' (e.g. into prison or doubt).

definition: verb: they see; 3rd pl. present of dídan (with mí-).
Adjective/adverb: endless, infinite; extremely; bí (without) + niháyat (end).
usage: Bíniháyat means infinite or extremely; ‘Abdu'l-Bahá uses it for emphasis, as in بی‌نهایت مسرور 'extremely happy'.

definition: 1st person plural present stem of dídan (after mí-): we see.
Adjective: helpless, wretched, poor.
usage: Bícháríh means helpless or wretched; used with compassion of the poor and deprived.

definition: Adjective: beyond comparison, peerless (epithet of God); bí- "without" + chún "like".
usage: Bíchún, 'without like', is an epithet of God's incomparability, as in خداوند بیچون 'the peerless Lord'.

definition: Plural of bígánih; strangers, outsiders, non-believers.
usage: Bígánigán are strangers or outsiders; in the Writings often non-Bahá'ís, contrasted with آشنایان 'friends', with a call to treat them with kindness.

definition: noun: shining, radiance, glow.
usage: Tábish is radiance or shining; used of the rays of the Sun of Truth, as in تابش آفتاب حقیقت.

definition: active participle: follower, subordinate, dependent. Root t-b-‘.
usage: Tábi‘ means follower or subordinate; used of followers of a religion and of things dependent on others.

definition: adjective: radiant, luminous.
usage: Tábnák, 'radiant', describes faces, hearts and the Sun of Truth, as in روی تابناک 'radiant face'.

definition: noun, plural of ta'thír: influences, effects. Root '-th-r.
usage: Ta'thírát are influences or effects; used of the influence of the Word of God and of the Holy Spirit.

definition: Ta’thír (influence, effect) + indefinite -í: an influence. Root '-th-r.
usage: Ta'thír is influence or effect; ‘Abdu'l-Bahá speaks of the influence of the Word, as in تأثیر کلمة الله.

definition: noun: crown.
usage: Táj, 'crown', is used of honour and sovereignty, as in تاج عزّت 'crown of glory'.

definition: noun: history; date. Root '-r-kh.
usage: Táríkh means history or date; used of historical examples in ‘Abdu'l-Bahá's talks and of dates in letters.

definition: noun: founding, establishment. Root '-s-s.
usage: Ta'sís is founding or establishment; used of founding institutions, schools and the Cause itself.

definition: Plural of ta'sís; foundations, institutions, establishments. Root '-s-s.
usage: Ta'sísát are institutions or foundations; used of the institutions of the Cause and of civilization.

definition: noun ta'líf (compilation, written work) + indefinite -í. Root '-l-f.
usage: Ta'líf is a written work or compilation; used of books written by believers or scholars.

definition: proper name: Rabindranath Tagore, Bengali poet.
verbal noun (form V): devotion, supplication, detachment in prayer. Root b-t-l.
usage: Tabattul is devotion and detachment in prayer; paired with تضرّع, as in تضرّع و تبتّل 'supplication and devotion'.

definition: Verbal noun (form II): teaching (the Faith), conveying the message. Root b-l-gh.
usage: Tablígh is teaching the Faith; a central duty in the Writings, as in تبلیغ امر الله 'teaching the Cause of God'.

definition: verbal noun (form VI): succession, following one another. Root t-b-‘.
usage: Tatábu‘ is succession; used of events or bounties following one another.

definition: Arabic verb, 3rd f. sg. imperfect: gleams, shines, glitters. Root l-’-l-’.
usage: Tatala'la' means 'gleams, shines'; used of lights and faces glittering with divine radiance.

definition: Arabic imperfect 3rd f. sg. form V: descends (repeatedly). Root n-z-l.
usage: Tatanazzal means 'descends'; used of the continual descent of divine bounties and angels.

definition: noun: trade, commerce. Root t-j-r.
usage: Tijárat is trade or commerce; the Writings praise trade as honourable work and service.

definition: Plural of tajallí; effulgences, revelations; Tablet of Tajallíyát. Root j-l-w.
usage: Tajalliyát are effulgences or divine manifestations; also the title of Bahá'u'lláh's Tablet of Tajallíyát.

definition: preposition/noun: under, beneath; dar taḥt-i = under. Root t-ḥ-t.
usage: Taḥt means under; in phrases like در تحت حمایت 'under the protection' and تحت لوای 'under the banner'.

definition: Verbal noun (form II): praise, admiration, approval. Root ḥ-s-n.
usage: Taḥsín is praise or admiration; used of praise for the believers' services, as in تحسین نمودن 'to praise'.

definition: Verbal noun (form II): dissolution, wasting away; analysis. Root ḥ-l-l.
usage: Taḥlíl means dissolution or wasting away; ‘Abdu'l-Bahá uses it of the decomposition of composite bodies, and in modern use 'analysis'.

definition: Noun tukhm "seed" + indefinite -í.
usage: Tukhm, 'seed', appears in imagery of sowing, as in تخم محبّت 'the seed of love'.

definition: Verbal noun (form V): decline, degradation, abasement. Root d-n-w.
usage: Tadannī is decline or degradation; contrasted with ترقّی 'progress', as in ترقّی و تدنّی.

definition: adjective: earthly, of dust; from turáb "dust". Root t-r-b.
usage: Turábí means earthly or of dust; contrasted with heavenly, as in عالم ترابی 'the earthly world'.

definition: Noun: translation; "tarjumih shudan" to be translated.
usage: Tarjumih is translation; used of translating Tablets and talks, as in ترجمه شدن 'to be translated'.

definition: noun tarjumih "translation" + izáfih.
usage: Tarjumih is translation; ‘Abdu'l-Bahá refers to translations of the Writings into other languages.

definition: past participle of tarsídan: having feared, frightened.
tazalzul (shaking, wavering) with -í. Root z-l-z-l.
usage: Tazalzul is wavering or shaking; used of doubt in faith, especially wavering in the Covenant.

definition: Verbal noun (form V): consolation, comfort. Root s-l-w.
usage: Tasallí is consolation; used of comforting the bereaved and sorrowful, as in سبب تسلّی 'a cause of consolation'.

definition: Verbal noun: resemblance, mutual likeness. Root sh-b-h.
usage: Tashábuh is resemblance; ‘Abdu'l-Bahá uses it in arguments about likeness between things.

definition: Plural of tishnih (thirsty): the thirsty ones.
usage: Tishnigán are the thirsty; the seekers who long for the water of life, as in تشنگان آب حیات.

definition: Verbal noun: formation, organizing; "tashkíl dádan" = to form. Root sh-k-l.
usage: Tashkíl is forming or organizing; used of forming assemblies and meetings, as in تشکیل محافل 'forming assemblies'.

definition: verbal noun (form II): confirmation, assent, acknowledging as true. Root ṣ-d-q.
usage: Taṣdíq is assent or acknowledgement as true; in the Writings acceptance of the Faith, as in تصدیق امر الله 'acceptance of the Cause'.

definition: Verbal noun: stating explicitly, declaring clearly. Root ṣ-r-ḥ.
usage: Taṣríḥ is explicit statement; used when a text plainly states something, as in بتصریح 'explicitly'.

definition: verbal noun (form VI): mutual assistance, cooperation. Root ‘-ḍ-d.
usage: Ta‘áḍud is mutual support; paired with تعاون, as in تعاون و تعاضد 'cooperation and mutual assistance'.

definition: Verbal noun (form VI): mutual help, cooperation. Root ‘-w-n.
usage: Ta‘áwun is cooperation; a key principle of social life in the Writings, as in تعاون و تعاضد.

definition: Arabic imperfect 3rd f. sg. form II: perfumes, makes fragrant. Root ‘-ṭ-r.
usage: Tu‘aṭṭir means 'perfumes'; used of the fragrances of God perfuming the world.

definition: verbal noun (form V): learning, study. Root ‘-l-m.
usage: Ta‘allum is learning; the Writings make learning a duty, as in تعلیم و تعلّم 'teaching and learning'.

definition: noun: baptism. Root ‘-m-d.
usage: Ta‘míd is baptism; ‘Abdu'l-Bahá discusses baptism by water and the spirit in commentary on the Gospel.

definition: verbal noun (form II): change, alteration. Root gh-y-r.
usage: Taghyír is change; used of change in laws and conditions, as in تغییر و تبدیل 'change and alteration'.

definition: plural of tafṣíl: details, particulars. Root f-ṣ-l.
usage: Tafáṣíl are details; common in letters, as in تفاصیل 'the particulars' of events.

definition: noun: interpretation, commentary, exegesis. Root f-s-r.
usage: Tafsír is commentary or interpretation; used of explaining scripture, as in تفسیر آیات 'interpreting the verses'.

definition: Verbal noun (form V): superiority, ascendancy. Root f-w-q.
usage: Tafawwuq is superiority or ascendancy; ‘Abdu'l-Bahá uses it of the ascendancy of the Cause and of one people over another.

definition: Verbal noun (form II): blind imitation, following tradition. Root q-l-d.
usage: Taqlíd is blind imitation of tradition; the Writings call for its abandonment and for independent investigation of truth (تحرّی حقیقت).

definition: Noun: recitation, chanting (of scripture). Root t-l-w.
usage: Tilávat is the recitation of scripture; in تلاوت آیات 'reciting the verses' and تلاوت مناجات 'chanting prayers'.

definition: Noun: pupil, disciple, student. Root t-l-m-dh.
usage: Tilmídh is a pupil or disciple; used of students in schools and disciples of a teacher.

definition: Verbal noun (form V): civilization, refinement. Root m-d-n.
usage: Tamaddun is civilization; ‘Abdu'l-Bahá distinguishes تمدّن جسمانی 'material civilization' from تمدّن روحانی 'spiritual civilization'.

definition: noun: body; "tan-parvarí" = pampering the body, self-indulgence.
usage: Tan, 'body', contrasted with جان 'soul'; in تن‌پروری 'self-indulgence', which the Writings warn against.

definition: verbal noun (form II): sanctification, detachment, purity. Root n-z-h.
usage: Tanzíh is sanctification or purity; in the Writings God's transcendence, and the holiness of believers, as in تقدیس و تنزیه 'sanctity and purity'.

definition: Tanzíh (sanctity, freedom from defect) + ast (is) joined. Root n-z-h.
usage: Tanzíh is sanctity and freedom from defect; used of the purity required of believers and of God's transcendence.

definition: adjective: narrow, tight, constrained.
usage: Tang means narrow or constrained; used of a narrow world or straitened circumstances.

definition: noun tangná "narrow place, strait" + izáfih.
usage: Tangná is a strait or narrow place; in تنگنای 'the narrow confines of' this world or of limitation.

definition: Noun: ability, power, capacity.
usage: Tavánáyí is ability or power; used of God's power and human capacity.

definition: Verb: 2nd sg. present of tavánistan, to be able; "tá tavání" = as far as you can.
verbal noun (form V): savagery, wildness, barbarism. Root w-ḥ-sh.
usage: Tawaḥḥush is savagery or barbarism; contrasted with تمدّن 'civilization' in ‘Abdu'l-Bahá's talks.

definition: verbal noun (form II): magnifying God; saying Alláhu Akbar. Root k-b-r.
usage: Takbír is magnifying God by saying الله اکبر; in the Writings also the Bahá'í greeting الله ابهی 'God is Most Glorious'.

definition: ordinal thálith "third" + indefinite -í: a third (one). Root th-l-th.
thabát "steadfastness" + -shán "their". Root th-b-t.
usage: Thabát is steadfastness; in the Writings firmness in the Covenant, as in ثبات و استقامت 'firmness and steadfastness'.

definition: proper noun: the Pleiades star cluster. Root th-r-w.
usage: Thurayyá, the Pleiades, is an image of great height, often contrasted with ثری 'the earth'.

definition: Noun: fruit; result. Root th-m-r.
usage: Thamar is fruit or result; used of the fruits of faith and deeds, as in ثمر شجره 'the fruit of the tree'.

definition: noun: fruit, result. Root th-m-r.
usage: Thamarih is fruit or result; as in ثمرهٴ وجود 'the fruit of existence'.

definition: noun thamar "fruit, result" + indefinite -í. Root th-m-r.
usage: Thamar is fruit or result; used in asking what fruit an action yields, as in ثمری ندارد 'it bears no fruit'.

definition: active participle: attracting, drawing. Root j-dh-b.
usage: Jádhib means attracting; used of the attracting power of the love of God and of attractive qualities.

definition: noun/active participle (fem.): attraction, attractive power. Root j-dh-b.
usage: Jádhibih is attraction; in ‘Abdu'l-Bahá's talks the power of attraction among creatures and of the love of God.

definition: Active participle: flowing, running, current. Root j-r-y.
usage: Járí means flowing or current; used of flowing waters of grace and of laws in effect.

definition: noun: cup, goblet; "jám-i shahádat" = cup of martyrdom.
usage: Jám is a cup or goblet; in imagery such as جام شهادت 'the cup of martyrdom' and جام محبّت 'the cup of love'.

definition: Active participle: solid, frozen, inert, stagnant. Root j-m-d.
usage: Jámid means solid, frozen or inert; used of lifeless matter and of stagnant minds.

definition: noun: the beloved of the soul; the Beloved, God.
usage: Jánán is the beloved of the soul; in mystical poetry God or the Manifestation, as in کوی جانان 'the Beloved's street'.

definition: Jánfishán (self-sacrificing) + -and (they are): they are self-sacrificing.
usage: Jánfishán means self-sacrificing; used in praise of devoted believers.

definition: adjective: soul-nourishing, life-giving.
usage: Jánparvar, 'soul-nurturing', describes life-giving fragrances, breezes and teachings.

definition: ján (soul) with -í: (a) soul; dil va jání, heart and soul.
usage: Ján is soul or life; in phrases such as دل و جان 'heart and soul' and جان‌فشانی 'self-sacrifice'.

definition: active participle: ignorant, uneducated. Root j-h-l.
usage: Jáhil means ignorant; contrasted with عالم 'learned', and used of those unaware of the truth.

definition: Arabic verb: 3rd fem. sg. past of já’a + -ní (me): (that which) came to me. Root j-y-'.
noun já "place" + indefinite -í: somewhere, a place.
noun: forehead, brow.
usage: Jabín is the forehead; often in the image of a radiant brow, as in جبین نورانی.

definition: adjective jadíd (new) + indefinite -í. Root j-d-d.
usage: Jadíd means new; used of the new age and new creation, as in خلق جدید 'a new creation'.

definition: Noun: attraction, drawing; "jadhb namúdan" to attract. Root j-dh-b.
usage: Jadhb is attraction; used of being drawn by the love of God, as in جذب و وله 'attraction and rapture'.

definition: Noun: newspaper, journal. Root j-r-d.
usage: Jarídih in ‘Abdu'l-Bahá's time meant a newspaper; in modern Persian روزنامه is the everyday word.

definition: Jism (body) + indefinite -í: a body.
usage: Jism is the body; contrasted with روح 'spirit', as in جسم و روح.

definition: Noun: festival, feast, celebration.
usage: Jashn is a festival or celebration; used of feasts and festive gatherings of the friends.

definition: Adjective: glorious, noble, eminent. Root j-l-l.
usage: Jalíl means glorious or eminent; used of exalted persons and of God, as in ربّ جلیل 'the glorious Lord'.

definition: feminine form of jalíl: glorious, great. Root j-l-l.
usage: Jalílih, 'glorious', qualifies feminine nouns, as in امة الله الجلیله 'the noble handmaid of God'.

definition: adjective: abundant, many; "jamm-i ghafír" = a great multitude. Root j-m-m.
usage: Jamm means abundant; in the phrase جمّ غفیر 'a great multitude'.

definition: Noun: inanimate thing, mineral, lifeless matter. Root j-m-d.
usage: Jamád is the mineral kingdom or inanimate matter; ‘Abdu'l-Bahá lists جماد، نبات، حیوان، انسان 'mineral, vegetable, animal, man'.

definition: noun jamál (beauty) + indefinite -í: a beauty. Root j-m-l.
usage: Jamál is beauty; in the Writings also a title of Bahá'u'lláh, as in جمال مبارک 'the Blessed Beauty'.

definition: noun: society, association; gathering, population. Root j-m-‘.
usage: Jam‘iyyat is a society or gathering; used of associations and assemblies and in جمعیّت بشر 'the human race'.

definition: noun: sentence, phrase; also all, the whole. Root j-m-l.
usage: Jumlih is a sentence or phrase, or 'all'; in از جمله 'among them, including'.

definition: Noun: the generality, majority, the public. Root j-m-h-r.
usage: Jumhúr means the generality or the public; in جمهور ناس 'the generality of people'.

definition: Noun: garden, paradise; "jannat-i-na‘ím" garden of bliss. Root j-n-n.
usage: Jannat is paradise or garden; in the Writings both a spiritual state and the garden of nearness, as in جنّت نعیم 'garden of bliss'.

definition: noun: kind, sort, genus; sex; ham-jins "of the same kind". Root j-n-s.
usage: Jins is kind, sort or genus; in همجنس 'of the same kind' and in discussions of species.

definition: plural of jund: armies, hosts. Root j-n-d.
usage: Junúd are hosts or armies; in the Writings often spiritual hosts, as in جنود ملکوت 'the hosts of the Kingdom'.

definition: noun: war, battle, fighting.
usage: Jang is war; ‘Abdu'l-Bahá condemns war and calls for universal peace, as in جنگ و جدال 'war and strife'.

definition: adjective: wild, of the forest; jangal + -í.
usage: Jangalí means wild; used of wild plants and trees contrasted with cultivated ones, to illustrate education.

definition: noun: directions, aspects, respects; plural of jihat. Root w-j-h.
usage: Jihát are aspects or respects; in phrases like از جمیع جهات 'in every respect'.

definition: noun: ignorance, folly. Root j-h-l.
usage: Jahálat is ignorance; contrasted with knowledge, a root of prejudice in ‘Abdu'l-Bahá's talks.

definition: Compound adjective: world-illuminating, shining over the world.
usage: Jahántáb, 'world-illuminating', describes the Sun of Truth, as in آفتاب جهانتاب.

definition: Noun: neighbourhood, proximity; "jivár-i-raḥmat" the nearness of (God's) mercy. Root j-w-r.
usage: Jivár is nearness or neighbourhood; in جوار رحمت 'the nearness of (God's) mercy', said of the departed.

definition: noun: boiling, fervour, excitement.
usage: Júsh is boiling or fervour; in جوش و خروش 'fervour and tumult' of spiritual enthusiasm.

definition: adjective: substantial, essential (from jawhar, substance).
usage: Jawharí means essential or substantial; in philosophical arguments contrasted with عرضی 'accidental'.

definition: 1st sg. present of justan: (I) seek; mí-júyam, I seek.
usage: Justan, 'to seek', is used of seeking God and truth, as in می‌جویم 'I seek'.

definition: active participle: present, ready; "ḥáḍir shudan" = attend. Root ḥ-ḍ-r.
usage: Ḥáḍir means present; in حاضر شدن 'to attend' and of being present in gatherings or at the Threshold.

definition: Proper name: Ḥáfiẓ of Shíráz, the Persian poet; literally guardian, one who knows the Qur'án by heart. Root ḥ-f-ẓ.
usage: ‘Abdu'l-Bahá quotes the poet Ḥáfiẓ of Shíráz; ḥáfiẓ literally means guardian or one who knows the Qur'an by heart.

definition: adverb (colloquial): now.
noun: state, condition. Root ḥ-w-l.
usage: Ḥálat is a state or condition; used of spiritual states and in در حالتیکه 'while'.

definition: ḥálat "state, condition" + -í kih: (in a) state in which, while. Root ḥ-w-l.
noun: seed, grain. Root ḥ-b-b.
usage: Ḥabbih is a seed or grain; in imagery of a small seed growing into a great tree.

definition: Noun: veil, covering, barrier. Root ḥ-j-b.
usage: Ḥijáb is a veil; in the Writings the veils that prevent recognition of the truth, as in حجبات 'veils' and خرق حجاب 'rending the veil'.

definition: Adjective: forbidden, unlawful. Root ḥ-r-m.
usage: Ḥarám means forbidden or unlawful; used of acts prohibited by religious law.

definition: Noun: wife, consort; also sanctuary, sacred precinct. Root ḥ-r-m.
usage: Ḥaram means wife or consort, and also a sanctuary; ‘Abdu'l-Bahá uses حرم for the wife of a believer or of a Holy Figure.

definition: noun: grief, sorrow. Root ḥ-z-n.
usage: Ḥuzn is grief; paired in حزن و اندوه 'grief and sorrow', which the Writings counsel believers to overcome.

definition: adjective: sad, grieving. Root ḥ-z-n.
usage: Ḥazín means sorrowful; used of grieving hearts and of the bereaved who are comforted.

definition: noun: envy, jealousy. Root ḥ-s-d.
usage: Ḥasad is envy; the Writings condemn it, as in حسد و بغضا 'envy and hatred'.

definition: Plural: sensations, feelings, sense-desires (ḥissíyyát-i-bashariyyih, human passions). Root ḥ-s-s.
usage: Ḥissíyyát are feelings or sense-desires; in حسیات بشریه 'human passions', which spiritual souls rise above.

definition: noun: insects, vermin; plural of ḥasharih. Root ḥ-sh-r.
usage: Ḥasharát are insects; ‘Abdu'l-Bahá uses them in examples from nature.

definition: verbal noun: attainment, acquisition. Root ḥ-ṣ-l.
usage: Ḥuṣúl is attainment; in phrases like حصول مقصود 'attainment of the goal'.

definition: Noun: presence, attendance; "ijázih-yi ḥuḍúr" permission to come (on pilgrimage). Root ḥ-ḍ-r.
usage: Ḥuḍúr is presence; in the Writings attaining the presence of ‘Abdu'l-Bahá or the Holy Shrines, as in اجازهٴ حضور 'permission to come'.

definition: noun: lowest point, abyss, nadir. Root ḥ-ḍ-ḍ.
usage: Ḥaḍíḍ is the lowest point; contrasted with اوج 'height', as in از حضیض به اوج 'from the depths to the heights'.

definition: plural of ḥaqíqat: realities, truths. Root ḥ-q-q.
usage: Ḥaqáyiq are realities or truths; in حقایق اشیاء 'the realities of things' and حقایق و معانی 'realities and meanings'.

definition: Plural of ḥaqq: rights. Root ḥ-q-q.
usage: Ḥuqúq are rights; in ‘Abdu'l-Bahá's talks the rights of men and women, and in حقوق الله 'the Right of God'.

definition: Foolishness, stupidity. Root ḥ-m-q.
usage: Ḥamáqat is folly; used of the foolishness of prejudice and war.

definition: noun: protection, support. Root ḥ-m-y.
usage: Ḥimáyat is protection; in حمایت الهی 'divine protection' and protection of the believers.

definition: Noun: praise, thanksgiving (to God). Root ḥ-m-d.
usage: Ḥamd is praise of God; in الحمد لله 'praise be to God' and حمد و ثنا 'praise and glorification'.

definition: noun: colocynth, a bitter gourd; emblem of bitterness.
usage: Ḥanẓal, the bitter colocynth, is an emblem of bitterness, often contrasted with honey or sugar.

definition: noun: ruling, decree, command, status. Root ḥ-k-m.
usage: Ḥukm is a ruling or decree; in the Writings laws and ordinances of God, as in احکام الهی 'divine laws', and also status or effect.

definition: noun/adjective: ruler, governing; ḥukm + rán.
usage: Ḥukmrán means ruler; used of rulers and governing powers.

definition: ḥukm (ruling, decree, effect, influence) + indefinite -í: an influence. Root ḥ-k-m.
usage: Ḥukm here means effect or influence; in phrases like حکمی ندارد 'has no effect'.

definition: Proper name: Haifa, city at Mount Carmel in the Holy Land.
usage: Haifa, at the foot of Mount Carmel, is a centre of the Faith where ‘Abdu'l-Bahá lived and where the Shrine of the Báb stands.

definition: noun, plural of ḥayván: animals. Root ḥ-y-y.
usage: Animals; in the Writings often in the contrast between the animal and human kingdoms, as in عالم حیوان 'the animal world', to show what distinguishes man.

definition: ḥayvání (animal) + rá (object marker). Root ḥ-y-y.
usage: Animal, of the animal; used of man's lower, animal nature, as in طبیعت حیوانی 'animal nature', set against his spiritual nature.

definition: Active participle: outside, external; "khárij shudan" = to leave. Root kh-r-j.
usage: Outside, external, beyond; as in خارج شدن 'to go out, leave' and خارج از 'outside of', e.g. beyond the bounds of the Cause.

definition: noun: field of thorns, thicket.
usage: A field of thorns; a poetic image for a barren, hostile world or heart, contrasted with the rose-garden (گلزار).

definition: title: Khan, honorific after a man's name.
usage: Khan; an honorific placed after a man's name, as in names of believers such as ‘Azízu'lláh Khán.

definition: Noun: family, household, lineage.
usage: Family, household, lineage; used of the believers' families and of noble or ancient lineages.

definition: noun khánih "house, home" + izáfih.
usage: House, home of; in phrases such as خانهٴ خدا 'the house of God' or the home of a believer.

definition: noun: news, report, tidings. Root kh-b-r.
usage: News, tidings, report; in the Writings often of glad tidings (بشارت) or news of the progress of the Cause.

definition: noun, plural of khabar with izáfih: news, tidings. Root kh-b-r.
usage: News, tidings of; often news of the believers' services or of events in the Cause.

definition: adjective: ashamed, embarrassed. Root kh-j-l.
usage: Ashamed, abashed; often in expressions of humility, as in خجل و شرمسار 'ashamed and abashed' before God.

definition: noun: the Lord, God.
usage: The Lord, God; common in prayers and Tablets, as in خداوند مهربان 'the kind Lord'.

definition: Plural of khidmat; services. Root kh-d-m.
usage: Services; especially the believers' services to the Cause, as in خدمات امریه 'services to the Cause'.

definition: Noun: harvest, heap of grain, stack.
usage: Harvest, stack of grain; used figuratively of the harvest of deeds or the reaping of results.

definition: Noun: cry, outcry, roar, tumult.
usage: Outcry, roar, tumult; poetic, of the cries of lovers or the clamour of the world, often with جوش 'ferment'.

definition: noun: earthenware, potsherd, clay.
usage: Earthenware, potsherd; a figure for worthless things, contrasted with pearls or gems (خزف و درّ).

definition: adjective: tired, weary, exhausted.
usage: Tired, weary; often in exhortations not to grow weary in service, as in خسته مشوید 'be not weary'.

definition: khashyat (fear, awe) + indefinite -í: any fear. Root kh-sh-y.
usage: Fear, awe; خشیة الله 'the fear of God', reverent awe before God, a quality urged on the believers.

definition: Plural of khaṣlat; qualities, traits of character. Root kh-ṣ-l.
usage: Qualities, traits of character; often in خصایل حمیده 'praiseworthy qualities' that the believers should acquire.

definition: adverb: especially, particularly. Root kh-ṣ-ṣ.
usage: Especially, particularly; used to single out a person or group for mention.

definition: noun: address, speech; "khiṭáb kardan" = to call, address as. Root kh-ṭ-b.
usage: Address, speech; in the Writings also God's or the Manifestation's address to someone, as in خطاب کردن 'to address', and of Tablets addressed to believers.

definition: Noun: talk, address, public speech. Root kh-ṭ-b.
usage: A talk, public address; used especially of ‘Abdu'l-Bahá's talks in the West.

definition: khiṭábih (speech, address) + plural -há + izáfih: the talks of. Root kh-ṭ-b.
usage: The talks, addresses of; used of ‘Abdu'l-Bahá's public talks in Europe and America.

definition: Khiṭábih (talk, address) with izáfih: talk of. Root kh-ṭ-b.
usage: Talk, address of; of a specific talk, often ‘Abdu'l-Bahá's.

definition: Feminine adjective: hidden, secret, covert. Root kh-f-y.
usage: Hidden, secret, covert; often of secret plots or hidden intentions.

definition: noun: robe of honor. Root kh-l-‘.
usage: Robe of honour; used figuratively of the robe of divine bounty or of qualities bestowed on the believer.

definition: noun khalal (breach, defect) + indefinite -í. Root kh-l-l.
usage: A breach, flaw, defect; as in خللی وارد نشود 'that no breach occur', of harm to the unity of the Cause.

definition: Sincerity, purity. Root kh-l-ṣ.
usage: Sincerity, purity of intention; a quality much praised, as in خلوص نیت 'purity of motive'.

definition: Obscurity, lowliness, abjectness. Root kh-m-l.
usage: Obscurity, lowliness; contrasted with fame or glory, often in the soul's abasement before God.

definition: khandán (smiling, blooming) + -í: you are smiling/blooming.
usage: Smiling, blooming; used of joyful hearts and faces, and of flowers and gardens in spring.

definition: past 3rd sg. of khwábídan: slept.
usage: Slept; used literally, and figuratively of heedlessness or of death.

definition: Adjective: lowly, contemptible, despised, abased.
usage: Lowly, despised, abased; often paired with ذلیل, of the humiliation of the proud or of the believers before their oppressors.

definition: Verb, 3rd sg. past of khándan: called, named; read.
usage: Called, named; read; as in the naming of someone or the reading of a Tablet.

definition: present stem of khwástan: wishing; khayr-khwáh = well-wisher.
usage: Wishing, desiring; mostly in compounds such as خیرخواه 'well-wisher' and the clause خواه ... خواه 'whether ... or'.

definition: noun: sister.
usage: Sister; used of kin and of women believers addressed as sisters.

definition: 2nd person plural of kháhán; future auxiliary "you will".
usage: You will; the future auxiliary, as in خواهید دید 'you will see'.

definition: Adjective: good, fine, well.
usage: Good, fine, well; an everyday word, more common in spoken style and in ‘Abdu'l-Bahá's informal Tablets.

definition: khud (self) + -shán (their): themselves.
adjective: pleased, content, satisfied.
usage: Pleased, content; especially of God's or ‘Abdu'l-Bahá's good-pleasure with a believer, as in خوشنود باش 'be content'.

definition: plural of khushí + izáfih: pleasures, joys.
usage: Pleasures, joys of; often of worldly joys contrasted with spiritual delight.

definition: noun: betrayal, treachery. Root kh-w-n.
usage: Betrayal, treachery; condemned as among the worst of deeds, opposite to امانت 'trustworthiness'.

definition: Adverb: very, much, a lot.
active participle: inside, within, included. Root d-kh-l.
usage: Inside, within, included; as in داخل شدن 'to enter', e.g. to enter the Cause or the Kingdom.

definition: 3rd pl. past of dádan: they gave; shuhrat dádand, they spread a rumour.
usage: They gave; as an auxiliary in compound verbs, e.g. شهرت دادند 'they spread a rumour'.

definition: 2nd sg. present of dáshtan: you have.
usage: You have; also an auxiliary in progressive and compound verbs.

definition: Past participle of dáshtan, to have; with báshíd forms the perfect subjunctive/imperative.
usage: Had, held; used with auxiliaries to form perfect tenses, as in داشته باشید 'may you have'.

definition: 2nd person singular past of dáshtan; with "mujrá" = you carried out.
usage: You had, held; in compound verbs such as مجرا داشتی 'you carried out'.

definition: plural of dáná: the wise, the learned.
usage: The wise, the learned; often in exhortations to the learned, and contrasted with the ignorant (نادانان).

definition: Verb: 3rd sg. present/subjunctive of dánistan, to know; here to regard, consider.
usage: Knows, regards, considers; as in ... داند 'deems (it) ...'.

definition: dánish (knowledge) + enclitic -and (they are); in "bí ‘aql u dánish-and", they are without reason and knowledge.
usage: They are (with/without) knowledge; دانش 'knowledge', valued in the Writings alongside reason (عقل).

definition: noun: seed, grain, single bead.
usage: Seed, grain; a common image for the seed of faith or of the Word sown in hearts.

definition: adverb: always, constantly. Root d-w-m.
usage: Always, constantly; in prayers and exhortations to constant remembrance or steadfastness.

definition: Noun: school, primary school.
usage: School, primary school; ‘Abdu'l-Bahá uses it for schools and also figuratively, as in دبستان الهی 'the divine school'.

definition: dabistán "school" + rá (object marker).
usage: School; of schools for children, whose founding ‘Abdu'l-Bahá strongly encouraged.

definition: Second part of the name Rabindranath (Tagore), split from Rábín- in the text.
Noun: tree.
usage: Tree; a frequent image, as in the tree of life, the tree of the Cause, or believers as fruitful trees.

definition: active participle of dirakhshídan: shining, radiant.
usage: Shining, radiant; of stars, lamps, and faces illumined with faith.

definition: Adjective dirakhshandih "shining, brilliant" with izáfih.
usage: Shining, brilliant of; e.g. a shining star or lamp of guidance.

definition: Noun durdánih "single pearl, precious pearl" with izáfih.
usage: Precious, matchless pearl of; a poetic figure for something unique and precious, such as a beloved child or a believer.

definition: dard + -am: my pain.
usage: My pain; in poetry and Tablets often the pain of love or of separation, for which the Beloved is the remedy.

definition: Dard (pain, ailment) + indefinite -í: a pain, every ailment.
usage: A pain, an ailment; often paired with درمان 'remedy', the divine Physician healing every ailment.

definition: Noun: lesson, study; "dars khwándan" to study. Root d-r-s.
usage: Lesson, study; as in درس خواندن 'to study', and of the divine lessons taught by the Manifestation.

definition: darmán + indefinite -í: a remedy, a cure.
usage: A remedy, a cure; often paired with درد 'pain', of the divine remedy for the world's ills.

definition: Noun: threshold, court, portal.
usage: Threshold, court, portal; especially the divine court, as in درگاه الهی 'the divine threshold'.

definition: noun: antidote, theriac (variant of tiryáq).
usage: Antidote, theriac; a figure for the divine remedy against the poison of the world.

definition: Verb: 2nd sg. past of darídan, to tear, rend.
usage: You tore, rent; used of rending veils (پرده دریدن), i.e. casting off what hides the truth.

definition: contraction of dar ín: in this.
Noun: thief, robber.
usage: Thief, robber; used literally and of those who steal faith or hearts.

definition: Infinitive: to steal; the theft.
usage: To steal; the theft.

definition: verb: they stole; 3rd pl. past of duzdídan.
Noun: enmity, hostility.
usage: Enmity, hostility; set against love and unity, which the Writings call on all to replace it with.

definition: noun: invitation, call, summons. Root d-‘-w.
usage: Invitation, call; in the Writings especially the call to God, the summons of the Manifestation, as in دعوت الله 'the call of God'.

definition: adjective: pleasing, charming, touching the heart.
usage: Pleasing, charming, touching the heart; of words, melodies and Tablets.

definition: noun, plural of dil (heart) with izáfih: hearts of.
usage: Hearts of; the heart (دل) is the seat of faith and love, as in دلهای یاران 'the hearts of the friends'.

definition: adverb: continually, moment by moment.
usage: Continually, moment by moment; of constant outpourings of grace or constant remembrance.

definition: Adjective: in harmony, intimate, companion; dam (breath) + sáz (attuned).
usage: In harmony, intimate, companion; of souls attuned in love and fellowship.

definition: dam (breath, moment) with -í: a moment, an instant.
usage: A moment, an instant; often in 'not for a moment' (دمی) of unceasing remembrance.

definition: Noun: lowness, nearness; contrasted with ‘uluvv (height). Root d-n-w.
usage: Lowness, nearness; paired with علوّ 'height' in contrasts of the lofty and the lowly.

definition: Adjective from dunyá: worldly, temporal. Root d-n-w.
usage: Worldly, temporal; contrasted with heavenly or spiritual things.

definition: verb: give!; imperative of dádan.
usage: Give!; as in prayers such as ... ده 'grant ...'.

definition: numeral: ten.
Noun: farmer, husbandman, peasant.
usage: Farmer, husbandman; ‘Abdu'l-Bahá uses the farmer as an image of the gardener of hearts and stresses the place of agriculture.

definition: verb: you (pl.) give; 2nd pl. present/imperative of dádan.
usage: You give; as in exhortations such as ... دهید 'give ...'.

definition: Noun: cycle, era; Bahá'í usage: dispensation. Root d-w-r.
usage: Cycle, era, dispensation; in the Bahá'í Writings especially the dispensation of a Manifestation, as in دور بهائی 'the Bahá'í Dispensation'.

definition: proper name of a Western believer.
noun: friend.
usage: Friend; in the Writings often of the believers, God's friends, as in دوست 'the Friend' for God.

definition: noun, plural of dúst: friends.
usage: Friends; regularly the believers, as in دوستان الهی 'the friends of God'.

definition: Noun: friendship, love.
usage: Friendship, love; ‘Abdu'l-Bahá constantly urges friendship with all peoples, as in دوستی با جمیع ملل.

definition: Loanword: doctor, title before a name.
usage: Doctor, as a title before a name; an older French-based spelling of دکتر.

definition: Plural of dár; lands, regions, country. Root d-w-r.
usage: Lands, regions; as in دیار غرب 'the lands of the West' and دیار غربت 'foreign lands'.

definition: Short infinitive/3rd sg. past of dídan; nakhváhíd díd, you will not see.
usage: Saw; with خواهید in future forms, as in نخواهید دید 'you will not see'.

definition: noun: seeing, meeting, visit.
usage: Seeing, meeting, visit; especially meeting the Beloved, as in لقا و دیدار.

definition: 2nd sg. past of dídan: you saw.
Loanword: dynamite.
usage: Dynamite; ‘Abdu'l-Bahá uses it of modern destructive inventions and the danger of war.

definition: dhát "essence, being, self" + ast "is". Root dh-w-t.
usage: Essence, self + 'is'; ذات often the divine Essence, ذات الهی, which is unknowable.

definition: Adjective: essential, innate, intrinsic; from dhát, essence.
usage: Essential, innate, intrinsic; as in contrasts of innate (ذاتی) and acquired (اکتسابی) qualities.

definition: dharrát "atoms, motes" (plural of dharrih) + -ast "is". Root dh-r-r.
usage: Atoms, motes + 'is'; often in ذرّات کائنات 'the atoms of all things', showing God's signs in every atom.

definition: Noun: abasement, humiliation, lowliness. Root dh-l-l.
usage: Abasement, humiliation; contrasted with عزّت 'glory', of the fall of the proud or the humble submission of the believer.

definition: dhikr + indefinite -í: any mention or remembrance. Root dh-k-r.
usage: Mention, remembrance; ذکر is central in the Writings, the remembrance of God, as in ذکر الله.

definition: Plural of dhakar; males, boys. Root dh-k-r.
usage: Males; paired with اناث 'females', as in ذکور و اناث 'men and women', in teachings on the equality of the sexes.

definition: Proper name element: Rabin(dranath), in Rabindranath Tagore.
Noun: comfort, ease, rest (from Arabic ráḥat). Root r-w-ḥ.
usage: Comfort, ease, rest; often worldly comfort, which the believers are told to forgo for service.

definition: Plural of ráḥatí: comforts, ease.
usage: Comforts, ease; worldly comforts contrasted with spiritual joy.

definition: Noun: way, path, road.
usage: Way, path, road; as in راه خدا 'the path of God' and راه نجات 'the way of salvation'.

definition: noun: opinion, view, judgement; plural árá’. Root r-’-y.
usage: Opinion, view, judgement; especially in consultation, as in رأی اکثریت 'majority vote'.

definition: noun: connection, link, relation. Root r-b-ṭ.
usage: Connection, link, relation; as in ربط و ضبط 'order and organisation'.

definition: noun, plural of rajul: men. Root r-j-l.
usage: Men; often prominent men or men of affairs, as in رجال دولت 'statesmen'.

definition: rijál (men, plural of rajul) + -and (they are). Root r-j-l.
usage: They are men; رجال as true men, heroes of the Cause.

definition: noun rajá’ with izáfih: hope, expectation. Root r-j-w.
usage: Hope, expectation; common in closings such as رجای واثق 'firm hope' and in prayers.

definition: noun: departure, death; "riḥlat namúdan" = to pass away. Root r-ḥ-l.
usage: Departure, death; as in رحلت نمودن 'to pass away', of the ascension of believers or of the Manifestation.

definition: Feminine adjective of raḥmán: of the All-Merciful, divine, merciful. Root r-ḥ-m.
usage: Of the All-Merciful, divine; as in نفحات رحمانیه 'merciful breezes' and تعالیم رحمانیه.

definition: Noun: breach, crack, gap; "rakhnih kardan" to break in.
usage: Breach, crack, gap; of breaches in unity or in the Covenant, as in رخنه کردن 'to break in'.

definition: noun: calamities, misfortunes; plural of raziyyih. Root r-z-'.
usage: Calamities, misfortunes; of trials and afflictions endured in the path of God.

definition: verb, 3rd pl. present/subjunctive of rasídan: (that) they reach, attain.
usage: (That) they reach, attain; as in به مقصود رسند 'attain their goal'.

definition: noun: messenger, apostle; rasúlu’lláh "Messenger of God". Root r-s-l.
usage: Messenger, apostle; especially Muḥammad, as in رسول الله 'the Messenger of God', and Messengers of God generally.

definition: Past participle of rasídan, to arrive, reach; "bi-ákhar rasídih" = has come to an end.
usage: Reached, arrived; in perfect tenses, as in بآخر رسیده 'has come to an end'.

definition: Verb, 2nd sg. past of rasídan: you reached, arrived.
usage: You reached, arrived; often of attaining a goal or the presence.

definition: Noun: thread, cord, tie, bond (here with izáfih).
usage: Thread, cord, bond of; as in رشتهٴ محبت 'the bond of love' and رشتهٴ وحدت.

definition: riḍá + izáfih: good-pleasure, satisfaction. Root r-ḍ-w.
usage: Good-pleasure, satisfaction; especially God's good-pleasure, as in رضای الهی, the goal of the believer.

definition: verb: went; 3rd sg. past of raftan.
usage: Went, departed; also of passing from this world.

definition: past 3rd pl. of raftan: they went, departed.
past participle of raftan: gone.
usage: Gone; in perfect tenses.

definition: Noun: bondage, servitude, slavehood. Root r-q-q.
usage: Servitude, bondage; in ‘Abdu'l-Bahá's Writings especially servitude to God (عبودیّت), his chosen station.

definition: Arabic raqíq (slave, servant) + -ka (thy): Thy servant. Root r-q-q.
usage: Thy servant; a formula of self-abasement in Arabic prayers.

definition: Plural of rimmih: decayed bones, mouldering remains. Root r-m-m.
usage: Decayed bones; Qur'anic image of the dead, used of souls quickened by the breath of God.

definition: plural of ramz: signs, symbols, mysteries. Root r-m-z.
usage: Signs, symbols, mysteries; as in رموز و اسرار 'mysteries and secrets' of the Holy Books.

definition: adjective: rotten, crumbled (bones); Qur'an 36:78. Root r-m-m.
usage: Decayed, crumbled (bones); from Qur'an 36:78, in allusions to raising the dead to life.

definition: short form of ráh: way, path; "rah-numún" = guide.
usage: Way, path; poetic short form of راه, as in رهنمون 'guide'.

definition: noun: deliverance, release, freedom.
usage: Deliverance, release, freedom; of release from bondage, prison or the self.

definition: noun: guide, leader.
usage: Guide, leader; of divine guides and teachers of humanity.

definition: Noun: spirituality. Root r-w-ḥ.
usage: Spirituality; a central theme, as in روحانیّت عالم انسانی 'the spirituality of the world of humanity'.

definition: rúḥáníyyat "spirituality" + indefinite -í. Root r-w-ḥ.
usage: A spirituality; of the spiritual condition of a soul or gathering.

definition: Proper name: Russia, the Russians.
zárí (lamentation, wailing) + ast.
usage: Lamentation, wailing + 'is'; زاری of supplication and weeping before God.

definition: Noun: tongue; language.
usage: Tongue, language; as in زبان 'tongue' of praise, and the call for a universal auxiliary language (لسان عمومی).

definition: Noun: glass, lamp-chimney (here with izáfih). Root z-j-j.
usage: Glass, lamp-chimney; alluding to the Qur'anic Light verse (24:35), the glass that holds the lamp.

definition: zujáj (glass, lamp-glass) with -í: a glass. Root z-j-j.
usage: A glass; of the glass of the lamp through which the light shines.

definition: Zaḥamát (toils, troubles) + indefinite -í: (what) toils. Root z-ḥ-m.
usage: Toils, troubles; often the toils and labours of the believers in service.

definition: noun: toil, trouble, hardship, effort. Root z-ḥ-m.
usage: Toil, trouble, effort; as in زحمت کشیدن 'to labour', of labour for the Cause.

definition: 3rd person singular past of zadan: struck; "shu‘lih zad" flared up.
usage: Struck; in compound verbs, as in شعله زد 'flared up'.

definition: verb, 1st sg. past of zadan: I struck; "takbír zadam" = I pronounced.
usage: I struck; in compound verbs such as تکبیر زدم 'I pronounced the takbír'.

definition: verb: they struck; 3rd pl. past of zadan.
usage: They struck; also in compound verbs.

definition: Noun: gold.
usage: Gold; paired with سیم 'silver' for wealth, and as an image of purity tested by fire.

definition: Proper name: Mírzá Maḥmúd-i Zarqání, ‘Abdu'l-Bahá's secretary and diarist.
adjective: clever, shrewd, cunning.
usage: Clever, shrewd; in older usage often with a sense of cunning.

definition: Zaqqúm, a bitter infernal tree in the Qur'án; bitter plant.
usage: Zaqqúm, the bitter infernal tree of the Qur'an; a figure for bitterness and the fruit of evil.

definition: Noun zamín "earth, land" + indefinite -í (in context: on earth); also adj. "earthly".
usage: Earth, land; earthly; contrasted with heavenly (آسمانی).

definition: Zindigí (life) + 1st sg. pronoun suffix -am: my life; "gar zindigíyam kháhí".
usage: My life; in poetic lines expressing readiness to sacrifice one's life.

definition: adjective: much, many, abundant. Root z-y-d.
Active participle: previous, former, aforementioned. Root s-b-q.
usage: Former, previous; as in سابق 'formerly' and the former dispensations.

definition: verb: I made; 1st sg. past of sákhtan (vuḍú sákhtam "I made ablution").
usage: I made; in compound verbs, as in وضو ساختم 'I made ablution'.

definition: Hour; time. Root s-w-‘.
usage: Hour, time; in religious contexts also the Hour of resurrection (الساعة).

definition: active participle: motionless, still; resident. Root s-k-n.
usage: Still, motionless; resident; often contrasted with movement and progress.

definition: noun: shadow, shade.
usage: Shadow, shade; as in سایهٴ عنایت 'the shade of His grace' and the shelter of the Cause.

definition: noun: glory, praise; subḥána’lláh "glory be to God!". Root s-b-ḥ.
usage: Glory, praise; in the formula سبحان الله 'Glory be to God', and سبحانک 'Glorified art Thou'.

definition: Adjective: green, fresh, verdant.
usage: Green, fresh, verdant; of spiritual springtime, as in سبز و خرّم 'verdant and flourishing'.

definition: noun: precedence, priority, getting ahead. Root s-b-q.
usage: Precedence, getting ahead; as in سبقت گرفتن 'to excel, outstrip', urging believers to excel one another in service.

definition: Noun: star.
usage: Star; often believers as shining stars, as in ستارهٴ درخشنده.

definition: noun: praise, laudation.
usage: Praise, laudation; especially praise of God, as in حمد و ستایش.

definition: Covering, concealing; satr kardan, to conceal. Root s-t-r.
usage: Covering, concealing; as in ستر کردن 'to conceal', and God's covering of faults (ستّار).

definition: Noun: prostration, adoration. Root s-j-d.
usage: Prostration, adoration; prostration before God in prayer.

definition: noun: cloud(s). Root s-ḥ-b.
usage: Cloud(s); often clouds of mercy (سحاب رحمت) raining bounty.

definition: Adjective: cold.
usage: Cold; often of cold, unresponsive hearts contrasted with those aflame with love.

definition: Adjective: brimful, overflowing.
usage: Brimful, overflowing; as in سرشار از محبت 'overflowing with love'.

definition: sarmáyih (capital, source, stock) with izáfih.
usage: Capital, source of; as in سرمایهٴ سعادت 'the source of happiness'.

definition: Adjective: everlasting, eternal.
usage: Everlasting, eternal; as in حیات سرمدی 'everlasting life' and عزّت سرمدیه.

definition: compound adjective: delightful, joy-inspiring; surúr (joy) + angíz (arousing).
usage: Delightful, joy-inspiring; of glad news and spiritual gatherings.

definition: Adjective: swift, rapid, quick. Root s-r-‘.
usage: Swift, rapid; as in سریع الانتشار 'rapidly spreading'.

definition: Adjective: sick, ailing, defective. Root s-q-m.
usage: Sick, ailing; of sick souls and the ailing body of the world, healed by the divine Physician.

definition: Noun: health, safety, well-being. Root s-l-m.
usage: Health, well-being; often in wishes for the believers' health.

definition: salṭanat "reign, sovereignty" + -ash "his". Root s-l-ṭ.
usage: His reign, sovereignty; سلطنت of earthly or divine sovereignty.

definition: noun: conduct, behaviour; walking a path. Root s-l-k.
usage: Conduct; walking the spiritual path; as in سیر و سلوک 'the journey of the wayfarer'.

definition: adjective: sound, healthy, whole; ‘aql-i-salím "sound reason". Root s-l-m.
usage: Sound, whole; as in عقل سلیم 'sound reason' and قلب سلیم 'a sound heart' (Qur'anic).

definition: Noun: mark, character, quality; "simat-i taḥrír yáft" = was written down. (Also samt: direction.) Root w-s-m.
usage: Mark, character; in the idiom سمت تحریر یافت 'was written down'.

definition: Noun: hearing, ear. Root s-m-‘.
usage: Hearing, ear; as in سمع و بصر 'hearing and sight', often of the inner ear opened to the call of God.

definition: Shaykh Kázim-i Samandar of Qazvín, a prominent early believer; literally "salamander".
sanad "document, credential, warrant" + indefinite -í. Root s-n-d.
usage: A document, credential, proof; as in سند 'warrant' for a claim.

definition: plural of sunúḥ: occurrences, inspirations, outpourings. Root s-n-ḥ.
usage: Occurrences, inspirations; as in سنوحات قلبیه 'heartfelt inspirations'.

definition: noun: stone, rock.
usage: Stone, rock; of hard hearts and of stones thrown in persecution.

definition: Numeral: three.
adjective: riding, mounted; savár gashtan = to board.
usage: Riding, mounted; as in سوار شدن 'to board' a ship or train.

definition: plural of súrákh: holes, burrows.
Adjective: black, dark.
usage: Black, dark; as in سیاه 'black' for darkness and in the unity of black and white races.

definition: Noun/title: lord, master; title of descendants of the Prophet. Root s-w-d.
usage: Siyyid, title of descendants of the Prophet; also 'lord, master'.

definition: Proper name: Sístán, region of eastern Iran.
Noun: branch, bough; also horn.
usage: Branch, bough; as in شاخ و برگ, of believers as branches of one tree.

definition: Noun: branch, twig, bough (here with izáfih).
usage: Branch of; of branches of the divine tree, or the friends as branches.

definition: shádmán "glad, joyful" + -am "I am".
usage: I am glad, joyful; often in ‘Abdu'l-Bahá's expressions of joy at the believers' services.

definition: Active participle: including, encompassing, embracing. Root sh-m-l.
usage: Including, encompassing; as in شامل حال 'bestowed upon', of God's favour encompassing someone.

definition: Station, dignity, rank; affair, matter. Root sh-'-n.
usage: Station, dignity, rank; affair; as in شأن انسان 'the station of man'.

definition: noun: witness; evidence. Root sh-h-d.
usage: Witness, evidence; as in شاهد 'witness' to the truth, and God as all-witnessing.

definition: noun, plural of shágird: pupils, students.
Noun shab "night" + indefinite -í: a (single) night.
usage: A night; of nights of prayer and meeting.

definition: noun shajarih "tree" + izáfih. Root sh-j-r.
usage: Tree of; as in شجرهٴ مبارکه 'the Blessed Tree' and شجرهٴ امر.

definition: 2nd sg. past of shudan: you became; muvaffaq shudí, you succeeded.
usage: You became; in compound verbs, as in موفّق شدی 'you succeeded'.

definition: adjective: intense, severe, strong. Root sh-d-d.
usage: Intense, severe, strong; of severe trials or intense love.

definition: Adjective: ashamed, abashed.
usage: Ashamed, abashed; in expressions of humility, often with خجل.

definition: noun: participation, partnership; company. Root sh-r-k.
usage: Participation, partnership; company; as in شرکت در 'participation in' meetings and services.

definition: Noun: ray, beam of light. Root sh-‘-‘.
usage: Ray, beam; of the rays of the Sun of Truth (شمس حقیقت).

definition: proper noun: eighth month of the Islamic lunar calendar.
Noun: flame, blaze; "shu‘lih zadan" = to flare up. Root sh-‘-l.
usage: Flame, blaze; of the flame of the love of God, as in شعله زدن 'to flare up'.

definition: Noun: perception, understanding, consciousness. Root sh-‘-r.
usage: Perception, consciousness; as in شعور انسانی, man's conscious understanding.

definition: Healing, cure, recovery. Root sh-f-y.
usage: Healing, cure; of physical and spiritual healing, as in prayers for healing.

definition: noun: gloating, reproach, taunting. Root sh-m-t.
usage: Gloating, reproach; the taunting of enemies at the believers' misfortunes.

definition: verb, imperative of shumárdan: count, consider; "ghanímat shumár" = consider precious.
usage: Count, consider; as in غنیمت شمار 'consider (it) precious'.

definition: Noun sham‘ "candle" + indefinite -í.
usage: A candle; often believers as lighted candles, as in شمع روشن.

definition: past 2nd sg. of shanídan: you heard.
noun, plural of shahíd: martyrs. Root sh-h-d.
usage: Martyrs; especially the martyrs of the Faith, as in شهدای امر.

definition: noun: city, town.
noun: fame, renown; shuhrat dádan = to spread a rumor. Root sh-h-r.
usage: Fame, renown; rumour; as in شهرت دادن 'to spread a rumour'.

definition: shahr "city" + -í: a city, any city.
usage: A city, any city.

definition: Personal name (also a musical mode): Shahnaz, a woman addressed in a Tablet.
1st person singular subjunctive of shudan: that I become.
usage: (That) I become; as in prayers asking to become worthy, e.g. ... شوم.

definition: noun: doubt; lá shakka = no doubt. Root sh-k-k.
usage: Doubt; in Arabic phrases such as لا شکّ 'no doubt'.

definition: Noun: thanks, gratitude; "shukr kardan" = to thank. Root sh-k-r.
usage: Thanks, gratitude; especially to God, as in شکر خدا and شکرانه.

definition: Adjective: sugary, sweet.
usage: Sugary, sweet; poetic, of sweet speech or the sweetness of the Beloved's lips.

definition: Noun: thing, object. Root sh-y-'.
usage: Thing, object; as in کلّ شیء 'all things'.

definition: Arabic verb, 2nd sg. masc. past of shá'a: you wished/desire. Root sh-y-'.
usage: Thou didst wish; in prayer formulas like انّک انت المقتدر علی ما تشاء.

definition: Noun: milk; also lion (context: milk).
usage: Milk; also lion; milk of spiritual nourishment, as in milk for spiritual infants.

definition: Proper name: Shiraz, city in Iran; "Ḥáfiẓ-i-Shíráz".
Adjective: sweet, pleasant, delightful.
