usage: Sweet, pleasant; of sweet melodies, words and the sweetness of the love of God.

definition: Adjective: infatuated, enamoured, captivated (here with izáfih).
usage: Infatuated, enamoured; of hearts enraptured by the Beloved.

definition: Arabic dual ṣáḥibay (two companions) in "yá ṣáḥibayi's-sijn", O my two fellow-prisoners (Qur'án 12:39). Root ṣ-ḥ-b.
usage: Two companions; in Joseph's address يا صاحبي السجن 'O my two fellow-prisoners' (Qur'an 12:39).

definition: active participle: truthful, sincere, faithful. Root ṣ-d-q.
usage: Truthful, sincere; of sincere believers and truthful Prophets.

definition: Noun: morning, dawn. Root ṣ-b-ḥ.
usage: Morning, dawn; often the dawn of guidance or a new day of God, as in صبح هدی.

definition: Adjective: radiant, beautiful (of a face). Root ṣ-b-ḥ.
usage: Radiant, beautiful (of a face); as in وجه صبیح 'radiant face'.

definition: Noun: conversation, talk, companionship; "ṣuḥbat kardan" to talk. Root ṣ-ḥ-b.
usage: Conversation, talk; as in صحبت کردن 'to talk', and of ‘Abdu'l-Bahá's talks.

definition: Noun ṣaḥrá "desert, wilderness" with izáfih. Root ṣ-ḥ-r.
usage: Desert, wilderness of; often the desert of search or of heedlessness.

definition: adjective: correct, sound, true. Root ṣ-ḥ-ḥ.
ṣaḥífa + -ka: your letter, your page. Root ṣ-ḥ-f.
usage: Thy letter, page; in ‘Abdu'l-Bahá's Arabic Tablets acknowledging a believer's letter.

definition: ṣadá (sound, voice) with -í: a sound.
usage: A sound, a voice; of the call of God or a voice raised in praise.

definition: Compound: hundred-leafed; the full-blown (hundred-petalled) rose.
usage: The hundred-petalled rose; a poetic image of perfection and spiritual beauty.

definition: Arabic ṣadr "breast, heart" + -hu "his". Root ṣ-d-r.
usage: His breast, heart; as in شرح صدره 'expanded his breast', i.e. gladdened his heart.

definition: adjective: centennial, of a hundred years.
usage: Centennial, of a hundred years.

definition: Noun: blow, injury, harm. Root ṣ-d-m.
usage: Blow, injury, harm; as in صدمه زدن 'to harm'.

definition: noun: outcry, cry for help. Root ṣ-r-kh.
usage: Outcry, cry for help; in phrases like ضجیج و صریخ 'clamour and outcry'.

definition: noun, plural of ṣaghír: the small, young ones; ṣighár u kibár = young and old. Root ṣ-gh-r.
usage: The young; in صغار و کبار 'young and old'.

definition: Plural of ṣifat: attributes, qualities. Root w-ṣ-f.
usage: Attributes, qualities; especially the divine attributes, as in اسماء و صفات 'names and attributes'.

definition: noun ṣafá "purity, serenity" + izáfih. Root ṣ-f-w.
usage: Purity, serenity of; as in صفای قلب 'purity of heart'.

definition: feminine adjective from ṣamad "the Eternal": of the Eternal God, divine. Root ṣ-m-d.
usage: Of the Eternal God, divine; as in تأییدات صمدانیه 'divine confirmations'.

definition: adjective: sincere, heartfelt; from ṣamím (core). Root ṣ-m-m.
usage: Sincere, heartfelt; as in محبت صمیمی 'heartfelt love'.

definition: Plural of ṣawma‘ih; hermitages, cloisters, monasteries. Root ṣ-m-‘.
usage: Cloisters, hermitages; of monks who withdraw from the world, which the Writings ask them to leave.

definition: Adjective (Arabic feminine): ferocious, predatory (of beasts). Root ḍ-r-y.
usage: Ferocious, predatory; as in حیوانات ضاریه 'beasts of prey', a figure for violent human behaviour.

definition: Control, discipline, good order; ḍabṭ va rabṭ, order and organisation. Root ḍ-b-ṭ.
usage: Control, order; in ضبط و ربط 'order and organisation'.

definition: Clamour, outcry, loud crying. Root ḍ-j-j.
usage: Clamour, outcry; of the cries of the afflicted or the tumult of the world.

definition: noun: forenoon, morning brightness; shams-i-ḍuḥá "the midmorning sun".
usage: Forenoon brightness; as in شمس ضحی 'the midmorning sun', of the full radiance of the Manifestation.

definition: noun/preposition: opposite, against. Root ḍ-d-d.
usage: Opposite, against; as in ضدّ 'opposed to' and اضداد 'opposites'.

definition: ḍarr + -ash: his harm, harm from him. Root ḍ-r-r.
usage: His harm, harm from him.

definition: ḍarr + indefinite -í: any harm. Root ḍ-r-r.
usage: Any harm; as in ضرّی نرساند 'cause no harm'.

definition: noun/adjective: the weak; plural of ḍa‘íf. Root ḍ-‘-f.
usage: The weak; of the weak and needy, whom the believers are to protect.

definition: Arabic feminine of ḍa‘íf "weak"; a (dismissive) title for women. Root ḍ-‘-f.
usage: 'Weak one', an old dismissive term for a woman; ‘Abdu'l-Bahá counters such usage in teaching the equality of women and men.

definition: Active participle: flying, soaring; bird. Root ṭ-y-r.
usage: Flying, soaring; bird; often the soul as a bird soaring to the heights.

definition: Proper name: Tiberias, town on the Sea of Galilee.
Noun: physician, doctor, healer. Root ṭ-b-b.
usage: Physician; the Manifestation as the divine Physician (طبیب الهی) who diagnoses the world's ills.

definition: noun: nature, physical world. Root ṭ-b-‘.
usage: Nature, the physical world; contrasted with the spirit, as in عالم طبیعت 'the world of nature'.

definition: noun: ornaments, embellishments; plural of ṭaráz; Lawḥ-i-Ṭarázát (Tablet of Ṭarázát) by Bahá’u’lláh.
usage: Ornaments; the title of Bahá'u'lláh's Lawḥ-i-Ṭarázát, the Tablet of Ṭarázát.

definition: noun: freshness, verdure, bloom. Root ṭ-r-w.
usage: Freshness, verdure; of spiritual springtime, as in طراوت و لطافت.

definition: ṭaraf (side) with -í; az ṭarafí, on one hand. Root ṭ-r-f.
usage: One side; in از طرفی ... از طرف دیگر 'on one hand ... on the other'.

definition: Noun: seeking, request, quest; "ṭalab kardan" to ask for. Root ṭ-l-b.
usage: Seeking, quest; the first valley of the mystic journey (وادی طلب) and request, as in طلب کردن.

definition: Noun: rising, dawning (of the sun). Root ṭ-l-‘.
usage: Rising, dawning; of the dawning of the Sun of Truth or a new Manifestation.

definition: proper name: Tehran, capital of Iran.
Noun: circumambulation (of a shrine), going round. Root ṭ-w-f.
usage: Circumambulation of a shrine; as in طواف روضهٴ مبارکه, and figuratively circling around the Beloved.

definition: Noun: storm, flood, deluge; here abundant downpour.
usage: Storm, flood, deluge; of a storm of trials or of an abundant outpouring.

definition: Noun: folding; "dar ṭayy-i" enclosed in, within. Root ṭ-w-y.
usage: Folding; in در طیّ 'within, enclosed in' (a letter), and طیّ کردن 'to traverse'.

definition: Plural of ṭayr; birds. Root ṭ-y-r.
usage: Birds; often birds of the heart singing in the divine garden.

definition: Active participle: oppressor, tyrant; unjust. Root ẓ-l-m.
usage: Oppressor, tyrant; of the persecutors of the Faith.

definition: Feminine active participle: outward, manifest, open. Root ẓ-h-r.
usage: Outward, manifest; contrasted with باطنه 'inward'.

definition: Plural of ẓulmat; darknesses, darkness. Root ẓ-l-m.
usage: Darknesses; of ignorance and heedlessness, contrasted with the light (نور) of guidance.

definition: noun: health, well-being, safety. Root ‘-f-w.
noun: end, outcome; adverb: in the end, finally. Root ‘-q-b.
usage: End, outcome; finally; as in عاقبت امر 'the outcome of the matter'.

definition: ‘áqibat (end, outcome) + -shán (their). Root ‘-q-b.
usage: Their end, outcome; of the end of the heedless or the faithful.

definition: noun: expressions, phrases, words; plural of ‘ibárat. Root ‘-b-r.
Expression, phrase; ‘ibárat az, consisting of, meaning. Root ‘-b-r.
usage: Expression, phrase; in عبارت از 'consisting of, meaning'.

definition: Proper name: ‘Abbás, given name of ‘Abdu'l-Bahá. Root ‘-b-s.
noun: threshold, sacred threshold. Root ‘-t-b.
usage: Threshold, especially a sacred threshold, as in عتبهٴ مقدّسه 'the Sacred Threshold', where ‘Abdu'l-Bahá placed himself as servant.

definition: Noun: powerlessness, weakness, inability. Root ‘-j-z.
usage: Powerlessness, weakness; in confessions of human helplessness before God, as in عجز و نیاز.

definition: adjective: strange, wondrous, astonishing. Root ‘-j-b.
Enmity, hostility. Root ‘-d-w.
usage: Enmity, hostility; to be replaced by love and unity, as in عداوت و بغضا.

definition: Noun: number, group, a number of people. Root ‘-d-d.
usage: A number, group of people.

definition: ‘udhr with -í: an excuse. Root ‘-dh-r.
usage: An excuse; as in عذری نماند 'no excuse remains'.

definition: noun: resolve, determination, intention. Root ‘-z-m.
usage: Resolve, determination; as in عزم راسخ 'firm resolve'.

definition: Proper name ("beloved of God"): ‘Azízu'lláh Khán.
‘Azíz (dear) + 2nd sg. pronoun suffix -at: your dear (daughter).
usage: Your dear one; عزیز 'dear, precious', common in loving address.

definition: ‘azíz "dear, beloved" + -am "my". Root ‘-z-z.
usage: My dear; a common loving address to believers.

definition: ‘azíz "dear, precious" + -íd "you (pl.) are". Root ‘-z-z.
usage: You are dear, precious; as in عزیز 'dear' in God's sight.

definition: noun: member, limb; member of an assembly. Root ‘-ḍ-w.
usage: Member, limb; members of one body, and members of an assembly (محفل).

definition: noun: membership; from ‘uḍv (member). Root ‘-ḍ-w.
usage: Membership, of an assembly or community.

definition: ‘aẓím "great" + comparative -tar: greater.
usage: Greater; عظیم 'great, mighty'.

definition: Necklace, string (of pearls); also contract. Root ‘-q-d.
usage: Necklace, string of pearls; also contract, as in عقد نکاح 'marriage contract'.

definition: plural of ‘áqil: wise men, sages. Root ‘-q-l.
usage: Wise men, sages; as in عقلا و علما 'the wise and learned'.

definition: noun: belief, creed, conviction. Root ‘-q-d.
usage: Belief, creed, conviction; as in عقاید 'beliefs' and freedom of conscience.

definition: ‘iláj (remedy, cure, treatment) + indefinite -í. Root ‘-l-j.
usage: Remedy, cure; in the Writings often of spiritual remedies for the ills of the world, as in علاج امراض عالم 'the remedy for the ills of the world'.

definition: noun: the learned, divines, clergy; plural of ‘álim. Root ‘-l-m.
usage: The learned, especially the Muslim clergy or divines; the Writings often describe the opposition of the علمای ایران 'divines of Persia'.

definition: adjective ‘ilmiyyih "scientific, learned" + izáfih. Root ‘-l-m.
usage: Scientific, of learning; used with Arabic agreement, as in مسائل علمیه 'scientific questions', often where religion and science are shown to agree.

definition: Adverb: openly, publicly. Root ‘-l-n.
usage: Openly, publicly, as of proclaiming the Cause or acting without concealment.

definition: Arabic preposition ‘alá with 3rd pl. pronoun: upon them (in benedictions).
usage: Upon them, chiefly in benedictions such as علیهم بهاء الله 'upon them be the Glory of God' and علیهم السلام 'peace be upon them'.

definition: Paternal uncle. Root ‘-m-m.
usage: Paternal uncle, in family references and greetings; distinct from خال 'maternal uncle'.

definition: noun: building, edifice. Root ‘-m-r.
usage: Building, edifice; used of houses and other structures, and of material construction as against spiritual edification.

definition: noun: life, lifetime, age. Root ‘-m-r.
usage: Life, lifetime, as in مدت عمر 'the span of life'; the Writings urge that life be spent in service to the Cause.

definition: Plural of ‘ináyat: favours, bounties, care. Root ‘-n-y.
usage: Favours, bounties; very frequent of divine grace, as in عنایات الهیه 'divine favours' and عنایات جمال مبارک 'the bounties of the Blessed Beauty'.

definition: noun: element, substance; plural ‘anáṣir. Root ‘-n-ṣ-r.
usage: Element; in the Writings of the physical elements (عناصر) whose composition and decomposition explain life and death.

definition: noun: covenant, pact; era. Root ‘-h-d.
usage: The Covenant; especially عهد و میثاق 'the Covenant', the provision for unity and succession; also an era, and in عهد عتیق 'the Old Testament'.

definition: ‘ahd "covenant" + -í + kih "which": a/the covenant which. Root ‘-h-d.
usage: The Covenant (عهد) followed by a relative clause: 'the covenant which ...'.

definition: plural of ‘áṭifih: affections, sentiments. Root ‘-ṭ-f.
usage: Affections, kindly sentiments; frequent in letters, as in عواطف رحمانیه 'merciful affections'.

definition: Plural of ‘álam; worlds, realms. Root ‘-l-m.
usage: Worlds, realms; for the spiritual worlds of God, as in عوالم الهی 'the worlds of God' and عوالم وجود 'the worlds of existence'.

definition: Proper name: ‘Akká, prison-city in Palestine.
usage: ‘Akká, the prison-city in the Holy Land to which Bahá'u'lláh was exiled in 1868, often called سجن اعظم 'the Most Great Prison'.

definition: noun: photograph, image, reflection; opposite. Root ‘-k-s.
usage: Photograph or image, as in requests for or gifts of photographs; also reflection, and the opposite (بالعکس 'on the contrary').

definition: Noun: eye, essence, self; "farḍ-i-‘ayn" an individual obligation. Root ‘-y-n.
usage: Eye, essence, the very self; in legal usage فرض عین 'an individual obligation'; also 'the very same', as in عین حقیقت 'the very truth'.

definition: adjective: concrete, of the essence; here a kind of motion. Root ‘-y-n.
usage: Concrete, of the thing itself; in philosophical passages of a kind of motion or existence, contrasted with ذهنی 'mental'.

definition: gháfil (heedless) + -and: they are heedless. Root gh-f-l.
usage: Heedless; the Writings often lament that people غافلند 'are heedless' of God and of the new Revelation.

definition: Active participle: prevailing, dominant, victorious. Root gh-l-b.
usage: Prevailing, victorious, dominant; used of the Cause prevailing over all opposition; also 'most' (غالباً 'mostly').

definition: noun: exile, being far from home, strangeness. Root gh-r-b.
usage: Exile, life far from home; used of the banishments of Bahá'u'lláh and of those who travel in the path of God.

definition: noun: pride, arrogance, delusion. Root gh-r-r.
usage: Pride, arrogance, self-delusion; condemned in the Writings, often alongside غفلت 'heedlessness'.

definition: adjective: drowned, immersed, submerged. Root gh-r-q.
usage: Drowned, immersed; usually figurative, as in غریق بحر رحمت 'immersed in the ocean of mercy', said of the departed.

definition: Plural of ghazál (gazelle).
usage: Gazelles; a poetic image of beauty and of gentle souls.

definition: noun: branch; Bahá'í title for sons of Bahá'u'lláh (Ghuṣn-i A‘ẓam = ‘Abdu'l-Bahá). Root gh-ṣ-n.
usage: Branch; the title of the sons of Bahá'u'lláh, as in غصن اعظم 'the Most Great Branch' (‘Abdu'l-Bahá) and اغصان 'the Branches'.

definition: ghafír (numerous) + indefinite -í; "jamm-i ghafírí" = a great multitude. Root gh-f-r.
usage: Numerous; almost only in the phrase جمّ غفیر 'a great multitude'.

definition: proper name: Kaiser Wilhelm (Guillaume) of Germany.
usage: Wilhelm (Guillaume), the German Kaiser, mentioned in the Writings among the rulers of the age.

definition: adjective: sad, sorrowful, grieved.
usage: Sad, sorrowful; used of grieved hearts the Writings console.

definition: adjective (fem.): invisible, of the unseen realm. Root gh-y-b.
usage: Of the unseen; frequent in phrases like تأییدات غیبیه 'invisible confirmations' and جنود غیبیه 'unseen hosts'.

definition: ghayr (other than, non-) + mu’min (believer). Root '-m-n.
usage: Non-believer; of those outside the Faith, often in counsel to treat all with kindness.

definition: adjective: jealous (protective), zealous; divine epithet. Root gh-y-r.
usage: Jealous in the protective sense, zealous; a divine attribute, and praise of believers zealous for the Cause.

definition: Adjective/noun: Persian language, Persian.
usage: Persian, the Persian language; the Writings were revealed in Persian and Arabic, and the Hidden Words have a Persian (فارسی) part.

definition: Discerning; diryáq-i-fárúq, the great theriac, sovereign antidote. Root f-r-q.
usage: Discerning; in the Writings mainly in تریاق فاروق 'the sovereign antidote', a metaphor for the healing power of the divine teachings.

definition: Arabic: fa- "so" + unẓur "look, behold" (imperative). Root n-ẓ-r.
usage: Arabic 'so behold', inviting the reader to consider an example or a sign.

definition: noun: benefit, use, profit. Root f-y-d.
usage: Benefit, use; in phrases like فایده ندارد 'it is of no use' and of the fruit of deeds.

definition: Arabic: fa- "so" + bashshir "give glad tidings" (form II imperative). Root b-sh-r.
usage: Arabic 'so give glad tidings', Qur'anic in tone; urges announcing the good news of the Kingdom.

definition: Noun: sedition, strife, mischief; trial. Root f-t-n.
usage: Sedition, strife, also trial; of disturbances raised against the Cause and of tests of faith (فتنه و امتحان).

definition: Arabic fakhr "pride, glory" + -í "my"; "al-faqru fakhrí" = poverty is my pride.
usage: My pride; in the saying الفقر فخری 'poverty is my pride', cited in praise of detachment.

definition: noun fidá "sacrifice, ransom" + izáfih: sacrifice for. Root f-d-y.
usage: Sacrifice, ransom; in devotional formulas like روحی له الفداء 'my soul be His sacrifice' and جان فدای ... 'my life a sacrifice for ...'.

definition: adverb/adjective: gathered, provided; faráham ámadan = to be provided.
usage: Gathered, provided; in compounds فراهم آمدن 'to be provided' and فراهم آوردن 'to bring about'.

definition: Joy, gladness. Root f-r-ḥ.
usage: Joy, gladness, often paired as فرح و سرور 'joy and gladness'.

definition: Noun: individual, single one; "fardan fard" one by one. Root f-r-d.
usage: Individual; in exhortations addressed to each believer and in فرداً فرد 'one by one'.

definition: adverb/noun: tomorrow.
usage: Tomorrow; also figuratively the future.

definition: noun: paradise, garden of paradise.
usage: Paradise; often فردوس اعلی 'the Most High Paradise' or فردوس ابهی 'the Abhá Paradise', the spiritual worlds near God.

definition: 1st sg. past of firistádan: I sent.
usage: 'I sent', common in letters about sending Tablets, gifts or messengers.

definition: Infinitive/verbal noun: to send, sending.
usage: To send, sending; of letters, Tablets, teachers and gifts.

definition: Past participle of firistádan: sent.
usage: Sent; also a noun 'envoy, messenger'.

definition: noun: angel.
usage: Angel; used of holy souls and figuratively of pure-hearted believers.

definition: Branch, offshoot, secondary thing (opposite aṣl, root). Root f-r-‘.
usage: Branch, secondary matter, contrasted with اصل 'root, principle'; used to distinguish fundamentals from secondary matters.

definition: Verb: 3rd sg. present/subjunctive of farmúdan, honorific to do/command/say; used in compound verbs.
usage: Honorific 'do, make, say', used of God or exalted persons in compounds like عنایت فرماید 'may He grant' and تأیید فرماید 'may He confirm'.

definition: verb: (they) deign, command, say; honorific 3rd pl. present of farmúdan.
usage: Honorific 'they do, command, say', used of exalted persons in compound verbs.

definition: verb: you (sg.) do, make (honorific); 2nd sg. subjunctive of farmúdan.
usage: Honorific 'you do', in prayers addressed to God, as in عنایت فرمایی 'that Thou mayest grant'.

definition: present stem of furúkhtan "to sell"; in compounds: -seller (bádih-furúsh = wine-seller).
usage: 'Seller' in compounds, e.g. باده‌فروش 'wine-seller'; from فروختن 'to sell'.

definition: noun: deceit, deception.
usage: Deception, deceit; of the deceptions of the world and of those who mislead.

definition: Noun: corruption, mischief, sedition, disorder. Root f-s-d.
usage: Corruption, mischief, disorder; condemned in the Writings, as in فساد و نزاع 'mischief and contention'.

definition: noun: virtues, excellences; plural of faḍílat. Root f-ḍ-l.
usage: Virtues, excellences; as in فضایل عالم انسانی 'the virtues of the world of humanity'.

definition: plural of faylasúf + izáfih: philosophers.
usage: Philosophers; in discussions of their views, as in فلاسفهٴ یونان 'the Greek philosophers'.

definition: Noun: philosophy (from Greek philosophia).
usage: Philosophy; the Writings discuss divine philosophy (فلسفهٴ الهی) and its harmony with religion.

definition: Noun: art, craft, skill, branch of knowledge. Root f-n-n.
usage: Art, craft, branch of knowledge; in علوم و فنون 'sciences and arts', whose acquisition the Writings encourage.

definition: Arabic fa- "so" + ni‘ma "how excellent"; "fa-ni‘ma má qál" = how well he said.
usage: Arabic 'how excellent'; in فنعم ما قال 'how well he said', after quoting a saying.

definition: Adverb: immediately, at once. Root f-w-r.
Proper name: Fisher, as in the London publisher Fisher Unwin.
usage: Fisher, as in the London publisher Fisher Unwin.

definition: qábilíyyat "capacity" + indefinite -í: any capacity. Root q-b-l.
usage: Capacity, receptivity; a key concept, as in قابلیت و استعداد 'capacity and readiness', the measure in which souls receive divine bounty.

definition: Arabic verb, 3rd m. sg. perfect: he said. Root q-w-l.
usage: Arabic 'he said', introducing quotations, as in قال الله 'God said'.

definition: Arabic verb, 3rd masc. sg. past: he arose, stood up. Root q-w-m.
usage: Arabic 'he arose, stood up', used of arising to serve the Cause.

definition: nisba: of Qá'in; Mullá Muḥammad-‘Alíy-i Qá'iní.
usage: Of Qá'in in eastern Persia; part of names of believers from there, such as Mullá Muḥammad-‘Alíy-i Qá'iní.

definition: noun: grave, tomb. Root q-b-r.
usage: Grave, tomb; of the resting-places of the departed.

definition: Noun: killing, slaying, execution. Root q-t-l.
usage: Killing, execution; frequent of the martyrdom of believers.

definition: Arabic particle before verbs: indeed, already (with perfect).
Noun: power, might, ability. Root q-d-r.
usage: Power, might; very frequent of divine power, as in قدرت الهی 'divine power' and قدرت کلمة الله 'the power of the Word of God'.

definition: feminine form of qudsí + izáfih: holy, sacred. Root q-d-s.
usage: Holy, sacred; in phrases like نفوس قدسیه 'holy souls' and نفثات قدسیه 'holy breaths'.

definition: Noun: foot, step; "ham-qadam" in step with. Root q-d-m.
usage: Foot, step; in ثابت قدم 'firm, steadfast' and قدم نهادن 'to set foot'; distinct from قِدَم 'pre-existence'.

definition: noun: settledness, decision, agreement; az qarár-i = according to. Root q-r-r.
usage: Settledness, decision, agreement; in از قرار 'according to' and قرار گرفتن 'to be settled'; also peace of heart (بی‌قرار 'restless').

definition: qirá’at "reading" + -ash "its". Root q-r-’.
usage: Reading, recitation (قرائت); of reading or chanting Tablets and prayers.

definition: noun: companion, consort, spouse; also near, joined. Root q-r-n.
usage: Companion, consort, joined with; as in قرین عنایت 'attended by favour'; also a spouse.

definition: Part, section, portion; lot. Root q-s-m.
usage: Part, portion; also one's lot or destiny.

definition: Arabic verb, 3rd sg. past: he made for, intended, set out toward. Root q-ṣ-d.
usage: Arabic 'he set out for, intended'; in Persian قصد is the noun 'intention, purpose'.
notes: Arabic verb; Persian noun qaṣd, intention

definition: Palace, castle. Root q-ṣ-r.
usage: Palace, mansion; of the Mansion of Bahjí (قصر بهجی) and of the palaces of kings.

definition: Noun: pole, axis, centre. Root q-ṭ-b.
usage: Pole, axis, centre; in Sufi usage the spiritual pole of the age; in the Writings figuratively the centre around which things turn.

definition: qalb "heart" + -at "your (sg.)". Root q-l-b.
usage: Heart; 'your heart', in addresses urging the reader to purify and illumine the heart.

definition: Qalb (heart) + 3rd sg. pronoun suffix -ash: his/her heart.
usage: Heart; 'his/her heart', the seat of faith and love in the Writings.

definition: Qalb (heart) + Persian plural -há: hearts.
usage: Hearts (Persian plural); the Writings speak of hearts being attracted, illumined and united.

definition: qulúb "hearts" (plural of qalb) + rá (object marker). Root q-l-b.
usage: Hearts (Arabic plural); very frequent, as in تألیف قلوب 'the union of hearts' and قلوب را منجذب نماید 'attracts the hearts'.

definition: Plural qulúb "hearts" (of qalb) + indefinite -í. Root q-l-b.
usage: Hearts (Arabic plural); as in تألیف قلوب 'the union of hearts'; with -í 'hearts that ...'.

definition: adjective: few, little, scant. Root q-l-l.
usage: Few, little; as in عددی قلیل 'a small number', often noting that few souls achieved great results.

definition: quvvat (power) with -í: a power, a strength. Root q-w-y.
usage: Power, strength (قوّت); of spiritual strength and the power of the Holy Spirit.

definition: Saying, word, speech; qawl-i-váḥid, one word. Root q-w-l.
usage: Saying, word; in قول واحد 'one word' (unanimity) and قول و فعل 'word and deed'.

definition: Noun: power, strength, faculty; "bi-qadr-i quvvih" as far as able. Root q-w-y.
usage: Power, faculty; a key term for spiritual and rational faculties, as in قوهٴ روحانیه 'spiritual power' and قوهٴ عاقله 'rational faculty'.

definition: plural of quvvat: powers, faculties, strength; "inḥilál-i qavá" = failing of strength. Root q-w-y.
usage: Powers, faculties (plural of قوّه), as in قوای روحانی 'spiritual powers' and انحلال قوی 'failing of strength'.

definition: adjective: strong, powerful, mighty. Root q-w-y.
usage: Strong, powerful; of strong faith or a mighty power.

definition: Arabic negative lá + passive tuḥṣá: which cannot be counted, innumerable. Root ḥ-ṣ-y.
usage: Arabic 'that cannot be counted', innumerable, usually of bounties: الطاف لاتحصی 'countless favours'.

definition: Arabic li- (for) + aḥibbá’ (loved ones) + -hi (his); in "rúḥí li-aḥibbá’ihi al-fidá’", my soul be a sacrifice for His loved ones.
usage: In the formula روحی لاحبائه الفداء 'my soul be a sacrifice for His loved ones'; احبّا is the Bahá'í term for the believers.

definition: adjective: necessary, required; lázim-tar "more necessary". Root l-z-m.
usage: Necessary, required; in لازم است 'it is necessary' in counsels and instructions.

definition: adjective: lustrous, glittering; lu'lu'-i la'lá' = lustrous pearl. Root l-'-l-'.
usage: Lustrous, glittering; in لؤلؤ لالاء 'lustrous pearl', a poetic image.

definition: Active participle: shining, gleaming, brilliant. Root l-m-‘.
usage: Shining, gleaming; of lights and countenances, often paired as ساطع و لامع 'radiant and shining'.

definition: Proper name: Leipzig, city in Germany.
usage: Leipzig, city in Germany.

definition: Part of a Western proper name (Hook Lerk?) in a list of greetings.
usage: Part of a Western name in a list of greetings.

definition: noun: kindness, grace, gentleness. Root l-ṭ-f.
usage: Kindness, grace; frequent of divine grace, as in لطف و عنایت 'grace and favour' and الطاف 'favours'.

definition: noun: title, epithet, nickname. Root l-q-b.
usage: Title, epithet; of the titles conferred on believers by Bahá'u'lláh and ‘Abdu'l-Bahá.

definition: Arabic (Qur'án 2:155): "We will surely test you", form I energetic of b-l-w with -kum.
usage: Qur'anic 'We will surely test you' (2:155), cited to explain that believers are tested by afflictions.

definition: lavá’iḥ (plural of lá’iḥih: memoranda, tracts) + -í: some tracts. Root l-w-ḥ.
usage: Tracts, memoranda; of written statements and treatises, including those of opponents.

definition: Noun: pearl. Arabic loanword.
usage: Pearl; a poetic image for precious words and truths, as in لئالی حکمت 'pearls of wisdom'.

definition: lu’lu’ "pearls" + la’lá’ "glittering": a string of shining pearls, written run together.
usage: Glittering pearls (لؤلؤ لالاء), a poetic phrase for brilliant words.

definition: Arabic preposition li- + -ka: for you, to you.
Noun: worthiness, merit, capacity. Root l-y-q.
usage: Worthiness, merit, capacity; as in لیاقت و استعداد 'worthiness and capacity' to receive bounty.

definition: proper name of a Western believer (von Limert).
usage: Limert, the name of a Western believer.

definition: Proper name: Leon (Dr. Leon Harvey, Unitarian minister).
usage: Leon, here the first name of Dr. Leon Harvey.

definition: Conjunction: but, however (Persian form of lákin).
Preposition: between, among. Arabic má + bayn.
passive participle: taken; held responsible, called to account. Root a-kh-dh.
usage: Taken; held accountable, especially of being called to account by God for one's deeds.

definition: Arabic conjunction má dáma: as long as; "mádámu'l-ḥayát" lifelong. Root d-w-m.
usage: As long as; in مادام الحیات 'for life' and مادام که 'so long as'.

definition: Feminine adjective of mádda: material, physical. Root m-d-d.
usage: Material, physical; contrasted with روحانیه 'spiritual', as in مدنیت مادیه 'material civilization'.

definition: ma’dhún (permitted, authorized) + -í: authorized (sanad-i ma’dhúní, a written authorization). Root '-dh-n.
usage: Permitted, authorized; as in سند مأذونی 'a written authorization'.

definition: Arabic má + fawq: what is above; beyond, more than.
usage: What is above, beyond; as in مافوق طبیعت 'beyond nature', of the power of the Prophets.

definition: Property, wealth, possessions. Root m-w-l.
usage: Property, wealth; in counsels on detachment from worldly wealth.

definition: Past participle of mándan: remained, left; "mándih bud" had remained.
usage: Remained, left; as in مانده بود 'had remained'.

definition: colloquial plural of má: we, us.
Essence, quiddity, true nature. From Arabic má hiya.
usage: Essence, quiddity; a philosophical term, as in the teaching that the essence (ماهیت) of God is unknowable.

definition: Proper name: Maxwell, i.e. William Sutherland Maxwell, husband of May Maxwell.
usage: Maxwell, i.e. William Sutherland Maxwell of Montreal, husband of May Maxwell.

definition: mubárak "blessed" + object marker rá. Root b-r-k.
usage: Blessed; the standard epithet for Bahá'u'lláh and holy things, as in جمال مبارک 'the Blessed Beauty' and الواح مبارکه 'the blessed Tablets'.

definition: Mubárak (blessed) + indefinite -í: blessed (souls).
usage: Blessed; with -í, 'blessed (souls)', as in نفوس مبارکی 'blessed souls'.

definition: Verbal noun (form III): glorying, pride, boasting. Root b-h-y.
usage: Glorying, pride; as in مباهات نمودن 'to take pride', of the honour of serving the Cause.

definition: passive participle: expended, devoted, bestowed; "mabdhúl dáshtan" = to devote. Root b-dh-l.
usage: Expended, devoted; in مبذول داشتن 'to devote (effort, kindness)', as in exhortations to exert the utmost endeavour.

definition: active participle (form II): herald, bearer of good news. Root b-sh-r.
usage: Herald, bearer of good news; used of the Báb as the herald of Bahá'u'lláh and of those who give glad tidings.

definition: noun: sending forth, mission; Bahá'í usage: Declaration of the Báb. Root b-‘-th.
usage: Sending forth, prophetic mission; in Bahá'í usage the Declaration of the Báb.

definition: passive participle: hated, detested. Root b-gh-ḍ.
usage: Hated, detested; of what is abhorrent to God, contrasted with محبوب 'beloved'.

definition: Noun: goods, possessions, chattels; worldly provision. Root m-t-‘.
usage: Goods, chattels; worldly provision, often in warnings about متاع دنیا 'the goods of this world'.

definition: adjective (form VI participle): differing, distinct, diverse. Root b-y-n.
usage: Differing, diverse; as in آراء متباینه 'divergent opinions'.

definition: Passive participle: one who is followed, leader. Root t-b-‘.
usage: One who is followed, a leader; contrasted with تابع 'follower'.

definition: Active participle (form V): bewildered, astonished. Root ḥ-y-r.
usage: Bewildered, astonished; as in متحیر شدند 'they were astonished'.

definition: mutaraṣṣid (watchful, expectant) + -am (I am). Root r-ṣ-d.
usage: Watchful, expectant; 'I am watching for' news or results.

definition: mutasáví "equal" (form VI participle, root s-w-y) + -st "is": are equal.
usage: Equal; used of equality of rights, as of men and women.

definition: Active participle (form VIII): characterized by, endowed with (a quality). Root w-ṣ-f.
usage: Characterized by, endowed with; as in متصف به صفات رحمانیه 'endowed with divine qualities'.

definition: participle (form VIII): connected; as adverb: continually. Root w-ṣ-l.
usage: Connected; adverbially 'continually', as in متصل دعا مینمایم 'I continually pray'.

definition: Active participle (form V, Arabic feminine): numerous, several. Root ‘-d-d.
usage: Numerous, several; with Arabic agreement, as in مکاتیب متعدده 'numerous letters'.

definition: adjective (form V participle): alone, unique, singular. Root f-r-d.
usage: Alone, unique; a divine attribute expressing God's singleness.

definition: adverb: continuously, at length. Form VI of root m-d-y.
usage: Continuously, at length; compare سنین متمادیه 'many long years'.

definition: participle (form V): civilized. Root m-d-n.
usage: Civilized; as in ملل متمدنه 'civilized nations', contrasted with savage peoples.

definition: adjective (fem., form V participle): civilized. Root m-d-n.
usage: Civilized, with Arabic feminine agreement, as in ملل متمدنه 'civilized nations'.

definition: adjective: holding fast, clinging. Form V participle of root m-s-k.
usage: Holding fast; mostly of holding fast to the Covenant, as in متمسک به عهد و میثاق.

definition: mutamassik "holding fast" (form V participle, root m-s-k) + -and "they are".
usage: 'They hold fast', mostly of holding fast to the Covenant (عهد و میثاق).

shift: Here: savage, uncivilized (وحشی). Today: frightened, alarmed.
definition: Adjective: savage, wild, uncivilized. Root w-ḥ-sh.
usage: Savage, uncivilized, of peoples before civilization; in modern Persian the word usually means 'frightened'.

definition: participle (form V): blessed, auspicious; "mutayamman farmáyad" = bless. Root y-m-n.
usage: Blessed, auspicious; in متیمّن فرماید 'may He bless'.

definition: Adverb: for example, for instance. Root m-th-l.
usage: For example, introducing illustrations in explanations.

definition: verbal noun (form III): argument, contention. Root j-d-l.
usage: Argument, contention; the Writings counsel against disputation and strife (نزاع و جدال).

definition: Plural of mujtahid: Shí'í divines qualified for independent legal judgement. Root j-h-d.
usage: Mujtahids, Shí'í divines with authority of independent judgement; often mentioned as opponents of the Faith.

definition: adverb: again, anew. Root j-d-d.
Arabic majrá (course, sailing) + -há (its); Qur'an 11:41 bismi'lláhi majráhá. Root j-r-y.
usage: Its course; in the Qur'anic بسم الله مجریها و مرسیها 'in the name of God be its course and its mooring' (11:41), of Noah's ark.

definition: passive participle (form II): embodied, incarnate. Root j-s-m.
usage: Embodied, incarnate; as in مجسّم شدن 'to become embodied', of virtues made visible.

definition: passive participle (fem., form II): embodied, incarnate; also statue. Root j-s-m.
usage: Embodied, incarnate (Arabic feminine agreement); also a noun 'statue'.

definition: adjective: impossible, absurd; farḍ-i muḥál = impossible supposition. Root ḥ-w-l.
usage: Impossible, absurd; as in فرض محال 'an impossible supposition' in arguments.

definition: maḥabbat "love" + ast "is". Root ḥ-b-b.
usage: Love; the foundation of the teachings, as in محبت الله 'the love of God'; here 'it is love'.

definition: muḥtaram (honoured) + vocative -á: O honoured one. Root ḥ-r-m.
usage: O honoured one; a respectful form of address in letters.

definition: feminine form of muḥtaram: esteemed, honored. Root ḥ-r-m.
usage: Esteemed, honoured; feminine form used in addressing or describing women.

definition: muḥtaram "respected, honoured" + -í. Root ḥ-r-m.
usage: Respected, honoured, in respectful address and description.

definition: passive participle: decreed, inevitable, binding. Root ḥ-t-m.
usage: Decreed, inevitable, binding; as in قضای محتوم 'the irrevocable decree' and of binding duties.

definition: passive participle: deprived, bereft. Root ḥ-r-m.
usage: Deprived, bereft; often of those deprived of divine bounty or of attaining the presence.

definition: Noun: deprivation, privation (maḥrúm "deprived" + -í). Root ḥ-r-m.
usage: Deprivation; as in محرومی از لقا 'deprivation of meeting'.

definition: Passive participle: gathered, assembled; "maḥshúr namúdan" = to gather together. Root ḥ-sh-r.
usage: Gathered, assembled; often of being gathered with holy souls in the next world (محشور شدن).

definition: Noun: assembly, gathering; Bahá'í usage: Spiritual Assembly. Root ḥ-f-l.
usage: Gathering, assembly; in Bahá'í usage the Spiritual Assembly (محفل روحانی) and meetings of the friends.

definition: maḥfil + indefinite -í: a gathering, a meeting. Root ḥ-f-l.
usage: A gathering, a meeting, as of the friends meeting together.

definition: Plural of maḥfúẓ; preserved items, extant writings. Root ḥ-f-ẓ.
usage: Preserved items, extant writings; of records and Tablets kept for posterity.

definition: passive participle (form II): verified, established, certain. Root ḥ-q-q.
usage: Verified, certain, established; as in محقّق است 'it is certain', of promises fulfilled.

definition: Passive participle: carried; in logic the predicate ("mawḍú‘ va maḥmúl", subject and predicate). Root ḥ-m-l.
usage: Carried; in logic the predicate, as in موضوع و محمول 'subject and predicate', in philosophical explanations.

definition: noun: effacement, erasure, annihilation. Root m-ḥ-w.
usage: Effacement, annihilation; in mystical usage self-effacement, often paired as محو و فنا 'effacement and nothingness'.

shift: Here: correspondence by letter or telegraph. Today: telecommunication, transmitting a message (مخابرات).
definition: Verbal noun (form III): correspondence, communication. Root kh-b-r.
usage: Correspondence, communication by letter or telegraph; in modern usage it means telecommunication.

definition: Active participle (form III): contrary, opposing; opponent. Root kh-l-f.
usage: Contrary, opposing; as a noun 'opponent', of the enemies of the Cause.

definition: mukhtaṣar (brief, summary) + indefinite -í: a short account. Root kh-ṣ-r.
usage: A brief account; as in مختصری مرقوم شد 'a brief word was written'.

definition: Passive participle: special, particular, specific. Root kh-ṣ-ṣ.
usage: Special, particular; as in مخصوص شما 'especially for you'.

definition: adjective makhṣúṣ "special, particular" + indefinite -í. Root kh-ṣ-ṣ.
usage: Special, particular; 'a special (thing)'.

definition: Passive participle: hidden, concealed. Root kh-f-y.
usage: Hidden, concealed; of hidden truths and mysteries.

definition: plural of makhlúq: creatures, created things. Root kh-l-q.
usage: Creatures, created things; contrasted with the Creator.

definition: verbal noun (form III): continuance, persistence, constant practice. Root d-w-m.
usage: Persistence, constant practice; as in مداومت بر تبلیغ 'constancy in teaching'.

definition: Noun muddat "period" + indefinite -í: for some time. Root m-d-d.
usage: For a while, some time.

definition: madḥúr (driven away, rejected, banished) + -and (they are). Root d-ḥ-r.
usage: Driven away, rejected; a Qur'anic word, of those rejected for opposing the Cause.

definition: Passive participle (form IV): what is meant, intended; desire. Root r-w-d.
usage: What is meant, the intended sense; as in مراد از ... 'what is meant by ...' in interpreting scripture; also desire.

definition: noun: rank, degree; time, occasion (chandín martabih = several times). Root r-t-b.
usage: Rank, degree, station; also 'time, occasion' (چندین مرتبه 'several times').

definition: adjective: raised, lofty; removed (of obstacles). Form VIII participle of root r-f-‘.
usage: Raised, lofty; also removed, of obstacles (مرتفع شود 'be removed').

definition: Noun: point of reference, authority to be turned to. Root r-j-‘.
usage: Point of reference, authority; of the Centre to which all must turn, as in مرجع کل 'the authority for all'.

definition: murdih (dead, corpse) with izáfih; murdiy-i ṣad-sálih, one dead a hundred years.
usage: Dead, a corpse; figuratively the spiritually dead, whom the Word of God revives.

definition: passive participle: rejected, repudiated. Root r-d-d.
usage: Rejected, repudiated; of deeds or persons rejected by God.

definition: noun, plural of murdih: the dead.
usage: The dead; often figuratively of the spiritually dead.

definition: noun mazra‘ih "field, farm" + izáfih. Root z-r-‘. Spelling as in text.
usage: Field, farm (مزرعه); a frequent image, as in مزرعهٴ قلوب 'the field of hearts' where seeds are sown.

definition: Arabic noun with suffix: its mooring, anchoring; Qur'an 11:41 "majráhá wa mursáhá". Root r-s-w.
usage: Its mooring; in بسم الله مجریها و مرسیها 'in the name of God be its course and its mooring' (Qur'an 11:41).

definition: Noun: illness, disease. Root m-r-ḍ.
usage: Illness, disease; both physical and spiritual, as in امراض روحانیه 'spiritual maladies'.

definition: maraḍ "illness, disease" + indefinite -í. Root m-r-ḍ.
usage: A disease, an illness; physical or spiritual.

definition: Passive participle (form II): composed, compounded (of). Root r-k-b.
usage: Composed, compounded; in explanations that composite things decompose, contrasted with بسیط 'simple'.

definition: markaz + indefinite -í: a center. Root r-k-z.
usage: Centre; in Bahá'í usage especially مرکز میثاق 'the Centre of the Covenant'; here 'a centre'.

definition: Adjective/noun: sick, ill; a patient. Root m-r-ḍ.
usage: Sick, ill; a patient.

definition: Compound noun: hospital (maríḍ "sick" + khánih "house").
Muzmin (chronic) + indefinite -í: a chronic (disease). Root z-m-n.
usage: Chronic, of a lingering illness.

definition: Verbal noun: equality, equivalence. Root s-w-y.
usage: Equality; in the teaching of مساوات رجال و نساء 'the equality of men and women'.

definition: Active participle, form X: rejoicing at good news, gladdened. Root b-sh-r.
usage: Rejoicing at good news; frequent in letters, as in مستبشر شدم 'I rejoiced' at news received.

shift: Here: receiving light, illumined. Today: an orientalist.
definition: Active participle (form X): receiving light, illumined (here, not "orientalist"). Root sh-r-q.
usage: Receiving light, illumined, as of hearts lit by the Sun of Truth; in modern usage the word means 'orientalist'.

definition: active participle (form X): partaking of grace, receiving bounty. Root f-y-ḍ.
usage: Partaking of grace, receiving bounty; as in مستفیض از فیوضات 'receiving the outpourings'.

definition: adjective: seeking aid, drawing sustenance. Form X participle of root m-d-d.
usage: Seeking aid, drawing sustenance; as in مستمد از تأییدات 'seeking the confirmations'.

definition: Active participle (form X): continuous, lasting. Root m-r-r.
noun: joy, gladness. Root s-r-r.
usage: Joy, gladness; very frequent in letters, as in سبب مسرت گردید 'became a cause of joy'.

definition: masrúr "glad, pleased" (root s-r-r) + -am "I am".
usage: Glad, pleased; 'I am pleased', common in letters responding to good news.

definition: passive participle (form II): armed. Root s-l-ḥ.
usage: Armed; figuratively armed with spiritual weapons, as in مسلح به سلاح تقوی 'armed with the weapon of piety'.

definition: passive participle: heard; "az qarár-i masmú‘" = reportedly. Root s-m-‘.
usage: Heard; as in از قرار مسموع 'reportedly', and of prayers being heard.

definition: noun, plural of musavvadih: drafts, rough copies. Root s-w-d.
usage: Drafts, rough copies; of drafts of Tablets and other writings.

definition: Adjective: Messianic, Christ-like (life-giving), from Masíḥá.
usage: Christ-like, life-giving, from Christ raising the dead, as in نفس مسیحایی 'the Messianic breath'.

definition: title Monsieur, Mr. (from French).
usage: Monsieur, Mr., before Western names.

definition: Passive participle: answerable, accountable, responsible. Root s-'-l.
Plural of mashghalih; occupations, tasks, preoccupations. Root sh-gh-l.
usage: Occupations, preoccupations; as in کثرت مشاغل 'the multitude of tasks', often excusing a brief letter.

definition: Plural of mashamm; nostrils, organs of smell. Root sh-m-m.
usage: Nostrils, sense of smell; figuratively spiritual perception, as in مشام جان 'the nostrils of the soul' that perceive divine fragrances.

definition: noun masham "nostril, sense of smell" + indefinite -í. Root sh-m-m.
usage: Sense of smell; figuratively spiritual perception of divine fragrances.

definition: Active participle (form VIII): longing, eager, yearning. Root sh-w-q.
usage: Longing, eager; as in مشتاق لقا 'longing for the meeting'.

definition: Feminine passive participle (form II): embodied, personified, specified. Root sh-kh-ṣ.
usage: Personified, embodied, specified; also a noun 'distinguishing feature'.

definition: Place of sunrise, East; Mashriqu'l-Adhkár, Bahá'í House of Worship. Root sh-r-q.
usage: Dawning-place, the East; in Bahá'í usage مشرق الاذکار 'the House of Worship' and مشرق وحی 'the Dawning-place of Revelation'.

definition: passive participle: busy, occupied, engaged. Root sh-gh-l.
usage: Busy, occupied; as in مشغول به خدمت 'engaged in service'.

definition: adjective: visible, witnessed; feminine of mashhúd. Root sh-h-d.
usage: Visible, witnessed; as in the visible world (عالم مشهود), contrasted with the unseen.

definition: noun: musk; "náfa-yi mushk" = musk pod.
usage: Musk; a frequent image of the fragrance of the divine words, as in نافهٴ مشک 'musk pod'.

definition: adjective: musk-scattering, fragrant; mushk "musk" + -bár "raining".
usage: Musk-laden, fragrant; poetic, of breezes and pens spreading divine fragrance.

definition: Adjective: difficult, problematic; noun: problem. Root sh-k-l.
mushkilát (difficulties) + -í relative + kih: the difficulties which.
usage: 'The difficulties that ...', of difficulties met in teaching or in life.

definition: adjective: musky, fragrant; kilk-i mushkín = musk-laden pen.
usage: Musky, fragrant; poetic, as in کلک مشکین 'musk-laden pen', of the Pen of Revelation.

definition: Plural maṣá'ib "calamities, afflictions" (of muṣíbat) + -í. Root ṣ-w-b.
usage: Calamities, afflictions; of the sufferings of Bahá'u'lláh and the believers, as in بلایا و مصائب.

definition: Noun: source, origin, fountainhead. Root ṣ-d-r.
usage: Source, origin; as in مصدر امر 'the source of the Cause'.

definition: Proper name: Egypt; also Cairo.
usage: Egypt, where ‘Abdu'l-Bahá stayed before and after His Western travels; also Cairo.

definition: passive participle: protected, safeguarded. Root ṣ-w-n.
usage: Protected, safeguarded; as in مصون و محفوظ 'protected and preserved', of the Cause.

definition: active participle (form VIII): agitated, disturbed, anxious. Root ḍ-r-b.
usage: Agitated, anxious; often in counsel not to be disturbed by events.

definition: Passive participle/noun: content, meaning, purport. Root ḍ-m-n.
usage: Content, purport; as in مضمون نامه 'the contents of the letter'.

definition: adjective (form III participle): conforming, in accord with. Root ṭ-b-q.
usage: Conforming, in accord with; as in مطابق تعالیم 'in accordance with the teachings'.

definition: noun: place of circumambulation. Root ṭ-w-f.
usage: Place of circumambulation; of holy places and shrines circled by pilgrims and, figuratively, by the Concourse on high.

definition: Noun: doctor's surgery, clinic. Root ṭ-b-b.
usage: A doctor's surgery or clinic.

definition: Noun: dawning-place, place of rising (of lights). Root ṭ-l-‘.
usage: Dawning-place; frequent in titles like مطلع انوار 'the Dawning-place of lights' and مطلع امر, of the Manifestation of God.

definition: passive participle: buried, hidden, concealed. Root ṭ-m-r.
usage: Buried, hidden; of hidden treasures or concealed capacities.

definition: Noun: state of being wronged, oppression suffered. Root ẓ-l-m.
usage: The state of being wronged; frequently of the sufferings of Bahá'u'lláh, who is called مظلوم 'the Wronged One'.

definition: plural of ma‘bad: temples, places of worship. Root ‘-b-d.
usage: Temples, places of worship; as in کنائس و معابد 'churches and temples'.

definition: Arabic phrase: God forbid, I seek refuge in God. Root ‘-w-dh.
usage: God forbid; used to reject an unthinkable idea.

definition: noun: knowledge, learning; education; plural of ma‘rifat. Root ‘-r-f.
usage: Knowledge, learning, education; as in علوم و معارف 'sciences and learning', whose spread the Writings encourage.

definition: Verbal noun: social intercourse, association, fellowship. Root ‘-sh-r.
usage: Association, fellowship; as in the command to consort with the followers of all religions in a spirit of friendliness.

definition: mu‘ávanat "help, assistance" + indefinite -í. Root ‘-w-n.
Active participle (form VIII): confessing, acknowledging. Root ‘-r-f.
usage: Acknowledging, confessing; as in معترف شدند 'they acknowledged', of opponents admitting the truth.

definition: Active participle (form VIII): believer, convinced, believing. Root ‘-q-d.
usage: Believing, convinced; also a believer.

definition: noun: compounded remedy, electuary. Root ‘-j-n.
usage: Compounded remedy, electuary; figuratively the divine remedy for the ills of the world.

definition: Passive participle ma‘dúd "counted, few" + indefinite -í: a small number. Root ‘-d-d.
usage: A few, a small number (عدهٴ معدودی).

definition: Passive participle: tormented, afflicted, punished. Root ‘-dh-b.
Passive participle: innocent, sinless, protected. Root ‘-ṣ-m.
usage: Innocent, sinless, protected from error; of the station of the Manifestation (compare عصمت کبری 'the Most Great Infallibility') and of innocent children.

definition: Passive participle (form II): perfumed, fragrant. Root ‘-ṭ-r.
usage: Perfumed, fragrant; as in معطّر شد 'was perfumed' by divine fragrances.

definition: Active participle (form II): teacher, instructor. Root ‘-l-m.
usage: Teacher; the Writings stress the high station of teachers and education.

definition: passive participle: inhabited, flourishing, well-built. Root ‘-m-r.
usage: Inhabited, flourishing; often paired as معمور و آباد 'prosperous and flourishing'.

definition: passive participle: forgiven, pardoned. Root gh-f-r.
usage: Forgiven; used of the departed, 'the late (forgiven) one'.

definition: Passive participle: overcome, defeated, vanquished. Root gh-l-b.
usage: Overcome, defeated; contrasted with غالب 'victorious'.

definition: Verbal noun (form III): separation, parting. Root f-r-q.
usage: Separation, parting; of separation from loved ones or from the Master.

definition: Plural of muftará with -í: slanders, fabrications. Root f-r-y.
usage: Slanders, fabrications; of calumnies spread by enemies of the Cause.

definition: Arabic passive participle, feminine: opened, open. Root f-t-ḥ.
usage: Open, opened; as in ابواب مفتوحه 'open doors'.

definition: adjective: enamoured, captivated, infatuated. Passive participle of root f-t-n.
usage: Enamoured, captivated; of lovers captivated by the divine Beauty.

definition: passive participle (form II): detailed, lengthy. Root f-ṣ-l.
usage: Detailed, lengthy; as in مفصّلاً 'in detail'.

definition: mafqúd (lost, absent) + -am (I am). Root f-q-d.
usage: Lost, absent; 'I am gone', of self-effacement or simply being absent.

definition: Noun/preposition: facing, opposite; "dar muqábil" in return for. Root q-b-l.
usage: Facing, opposite; in در مقابل 'in return for, in the face of'.

definition: muqávimat "resistance, endurance" + -ishán "their". Root q-w-m.
usage: Resistance, endurance; 'their resistance'.

definition: active participle (form VIII): one who acquires light, derives (from). Root q-b-s.
usage: Acquiring light, deriving from; as in مقتبس از انوار 'drawing light from the lights'.

definition: adjective (fem.): holy, sanctified. Root q-d-s.
usage: Holy, sanctified; in phrases like ارض مقدسه 'the Holy Land' and نفوس مقدسه 'holy souls'.

definition: Aim, purpose, destination. Root q-ṣ-d.
usage: Aim, purpose, destination; as in مقصد از ... 'the purpose of ...'.

definition: Noun: blame, reproach. Root l-w-m.
usage: Blame, reproach; often of the reproach believers endure in the path of God.

definition: Arabic plural of malak: angels.
usage: Angels; also figuratively of sanctified souls.

definition: millat + indefinite -í: a nation, a people. Root m-l-l.
usage: Nation, people; originally a religious community, and both senses of ملت occur in the Writings.

definition: Noun: refuge, shelter. Root l-j-'.
usage: Refuge, shelter; of God as the refuge of all, as in ملجأ و ملاذ 'refuge and shelter'.

definition: Plural of millat; nations, peoples, religious communities. Root m-l-l.
usage: Nations, peoples, religious communities; as in ادیان و ملل 'religions and peoples'.

definition: noun, plural of malik: kings. Root m-l-k.
usage: Kings; of the kings addressed by Bahá'u'lláh in His Tablets to the rulers.

definition: Feminine of malakútí: of the Kingdom, celestial. Root m-l-k.
usage: Of the Kingdom, celestial; in phrases like تأییدات ملکوتیه 'heavenly confirmations'.

definition: adjective: comely, charming, graceful. Root m-l-ḥ.
usage: Comely, charming; poetic praise of beauty.

definition: Passive participle: tested, tried, proven. Root m-ḥ-n.
usage: Tested, tried; of souls tested and proven in faith.

definition: mumtaḥan (tested, tried, proven) + indefinite -í. Root m-ḥ-n.
usage: Tested, tried; 'a tested (soul)', proven in faith.

definition: mamlakat with -í: a country, kingdom. Root m-l-k.
adjective: grateful, obliged, thankful. Root m-n-n.
usage: Grateful, obliged; in expressions of thanks.

definition: Noun: intimate prayer, communion with God. Root n-j-w.
usage: Intimate prayer, communion with God (Arabic spelling with tá' marbúṭa); the heading of many prayers.

definition: noun: prayer, supplication, intimate communion with God. Root n-j-w.
usage: Prayer, intimate communion with God; the heading of prayers revealed by Bahá'u'lláh and ‘Abdu'l-Bahá; مناجات نمودن 'to pray'.

definition: participle (form III): fitting, suitable. Root n-s-b.
noun: those related or attached; plural of muntasib. Form VIII of root n-s-b.
usage: Those related or attached; of those connected with the Cause or with a family.

definition: muntaẓir "waiting, expectant" (form VIII, root n-ẓ-r) + -am "I am".
usage: Waiting, expectant; 'I await' news or results.

definition: muntahá "utmost, end" + -yash "its": the most of it is, only. Root n-h-y.
usage: Utmost, end; منتهایش 'at most, only'; also منتهای آمال 'the utmost of hopes'.

definition: Plural of munjadhib (form VII participle): those attracted, enraptured. Root j-dh-b.
usage: Those attracted or enraptured; frequent of the believers drawn to the Cause, as in منجذبین بنفحات الله 'those attracted by the fragrances of God'.

definition: Active participle: included, contained, enfolded (latent). Root d-r-j.
usage: Contained, included; as in مندرج در 'included in' a letter or book; also latent.

definition: active participle (form VII): enfolded, latent, contained within. Root d-m-j.
usage: Enfolded, latent; in explanations of capacities latent in a seed.

definition: noun: house, dwelling, lodging; stage of a journey. Root n-z-l.
usage: House, lodging; also a stage of a journey or of the spiritual path.

definition: Passive participle: exalted above, free from (imperfection), holy. Root n-z-h.
usage: Exalted above, free from imperfection; as in منزّه و مقدّس 'sanctified and holy', of God's transcendence.

definition: passive participle: related, attributed; a relative. Root n-s-b.
usage: Related, attributed; a relative, as in منسوبین 'kinsfolk'.

definition: Active participle (form VII): detached, severed (from the world). Root q-ṭ-‘.
usage: Detached; a key virtue, as in منقطع از ما سوی الله 'detached from all save God'.

definition: Path, way, method. Root n-h-j.
usage: Path, method; as in منهج قویم 'the straight path'.

definition: noun: feast, banquet, hospitality.
usage: Feast, banquet; of gatherings and hospitality.

definition: adjective: held accountable, answerable, reproached. Form III passive participle of root '-kh-dh.
usage: Held accountable, answerable; of being called to account by God.

definition: Plural of máni‘; obstacles, hindrances. Root m-n-‘.
usage: Obstacles, hindrances; as in رفع موانع 'removing obstacles'.

definition: Noun: death. Root m-w-t.
usage: Death, physical and spiritual, contrasted with حیات 'life'.

definition: Noun: wave; "mawj zadan" to surge. Root m-w-j.
usage: Wave; often of the ocean of divine bounty, as in موج زدن 'to surge'.

definition: adjective: existing, present, available; noun: a being. Root w-j-d.
usage: Existing, present; also 'a being', as in موجودات 'beings'.

definition: mawjúd "existent, present" + -am "I am". Root w-j-d.
usage: Existing, present; 'I am present'.

definition: plural of muvaḥḥid: believers in divine unity; here Unitarians. Root w-ḥ-d.
usage: Those who affirm the unity of God; in these letters it also names the Unitarians of the West, whom ‘Abdu'l-Bahá addressed in their churches.

definition: Noun: case, instance, matter; place of arrival. Root w-r-d.
usage: A case, instance or occasion, as in در این مورد 'in this case'; also used of a place where something arrives or is bestowed.

definition: Noun mawrid "case, occasion, instance" + indefinite -í. Root w-r-d.
usage: 'A case' or 'an occasion', as in در موردی 'in a certain case'.

definition: Proper name: a Western man addressed as Monsieur in Paris (Mozer/Moser).
noun: season, time. Root w-s-m.
usage: A season or appointed time, often figurative, as in موسم بهار 'the season of spring', the springtime of God's Revelation.

definition: Proper name: Moses, the Prophet.
usage: Moses, the Prophet of Israel, named among the Manifestations of God whose teachings form one progressive religion.

definition: Passive participle/noun: subject, topic; logical subject (paired with maḥmúl). Root w-ḍ-‘.
usage: A subject or topic of discussion; in philosophical passages the logical subject of a proposition, paired with محمول 'predicate'.

definition: maw‘úd "promised (one)" + -í + kih "who". Root w-‘-d.
usage: From موعود 'the Promised One', the awaited Figure foretold in earlier scriptures, whom the Writings identify with Bahá'u'lláh.

definition: Muvaffaq (confirmed, successful) + 2nd sg. -í (you are). Root w-f-q.
usage: From موفق 'confirmed, successful', usually of believers aided by divine confirmation, as in موفق و مؤید 'confirmed and assisted'.

definition: passive participle: abundant, ample. Root w-f-r.
usage: Abundant, ample, often of divine bounty, as in عنایت موفور 'abundant favour'.

definition: noun mawqi‘ "occasion, situation" + indefinite -í. Root w-q-‘.
usage: 'An occasion' or 'a time', as in موقعی که 'at a time when'.

definition: noun (fem. passive participle): newborn child (girl). Root w-l-d.
usage: A newborn child, used in letters of congratulation on a birth; a girl when feminine.

definition: Active participle: intimate friend, companion, comforter. Root '-n-s.
usage: An intimate friend or comforter; in prayers God or His remembrance is called the مونس of the lonely heart.

definition: mawhibat (gift, bounty) + indefinite -í: a bounty. Root w-h-b.
usage: From موهبت 'gift, bounty', a frequent word for the gifts of God, as in موهبت کبری 'the supreme bounty'.

definition: Comparative of mu'ayyad "confirmed, assisted (by God)". Root '-y-d.
usage: From مؤید 'confirmed, assisted by God'; the Writings often pair it with موفق for believers aided by the Holy Spirit.

definition: noun: good news, glad tidings.
usage: Glad tidings, often of the coming of the Kingdom or of the progress of the Cause, as in مژدهٴ ملکوت 'the glad tidings of the Kingdom'.

definition: makátíb "letters" (plural of maktúb) + -ash "his". Root k-t-b.
usage: Letters or epistles; مکاتیب عبدالبهاء names the collected letters of ‘Abdu'l-Bahá.

definition: noun mukálamih "conversation, dialogue" + izáfih. Root k-l-m.
usage: A conversation or dialogue, as in مکالمهٴ با 'conversation with'.

definition: mukallaf (obligated) + -and (they are): they are bound, obliged. Root k-l-f.
usage: Bound or obliged by a religious duty, as when the believers are مکلف 'bound' to obey a law of the Book.

definition: Feminine passive participle: hidden, concealed; Kalimát-i-Maknúnih = The Hidden Words. Root k-n-n.
usage: Hidden, treasured; above all in کلمات مکنونه 'the Hidden Words' of Bahá'u'lláh, and in phrases like اسرار مکنونه 'hidden mysteries'.

definition: verb: they know; 3rd pl. present of dánistan.
present 2nd pl. of dánistan: you know.
1st sg. past continuous of dídan: I was seeing, I saw.
verb, 3rd pl. present of raftan: they go.
Verb: 1st sg. past continuous of shudan, to become; I would be/become.
Verb: 1st sg. present of shudan, to become.
Verb, 1st sg. present of ṭalabídan: I ask for, seek.
usage: 'I ask', often in prayerful wishes such as از خدا میطلبم 'I ask of God'.

definition: present 3rd sg. of mándan: remains; with mithl: resembles.
usage: Remains; with مثل 'like' it means 'resembles', used in comparisons and parables.

definition: verb, 3rd pl. present of namúdan: they do, make, show.
usage: Namúdan, the formal counterpart of kardan, forms compound verbs throughout the Writings, as in ملاحظه مینمایند 'they observe'.

definition: verb: you (pl.) do, make; present 2nd pl. of namúdan.
usage: Formal 'you do', forming compound verbs in exhortations to the believers.

definition: present 1st pl. of namúdan: we do; with muláḥaẓih: we observe.
usage: Formal 'we do', as in ملاحظه مینماییم 'we observe'.

definition: verb: I was doing, used to do; 1st sg. past imperfective of namúdan.
usage: Formal 'I was doing', forming compound verbs in ‘Abdu'l-Bahá's narratives.

definition: 3rd pl. past continuous of nivishtan: they were writing.
verb: writes; present 3rd sg. of nivishtan.
mívih + izáfih: fruit.
usage: Fruit, often figurative for the results of deeds or faith, as in میوهٴ شجرهٴ انسانی 'the fruit of the human tree'.

definition: 2nd person singular present continuous of kardan: you do, you make.
past continuous 3rd sg. of guzashtan: was passing, was happening.
Verb, 3rd sg. present of guftan: says.
Active participle: growing, firmly rooted; paired with thábit "steadfast". Root n-b-t.
usage: Growing, firmly rooted; paired with ثابت in ثابت و نابت 'firm and rooted' for steadfast believers.

definition: Adjective: blind; ná- (not) + bíná (seeing).
usage: Blind, frequently figurative for spiritual blindness, contrasted with بینا 'seeing'.

definition: Adjective: weak, powerless, feeble; ná- (not) + tuván (power).
usage: Weak, powerless; often in humble self-description before God.

definition: Fire. Root n-w-r.
usage: Fire; in the Writings both the fire of the love of God and the fire of separation or hell, as in نار محبت الله 'the fire of the love of God'.

definition: adjective: displeased, dissatisfied; ná- "not" + ráḍí "content".
usage: Displeased, dissatisfied, as in a person displeased with another.

definition: Proper name: Náṣiri'd-Dín Sháh, Qájár king of Persia (r. 1848–1896); literally helper of the faith.
usage: Náṣiri'd-Dín Sháh, the Qájár king during whose reign Bahá'u'lláh was imprisoned and exiled, and to whom He addressed a Tablet.

definition: active participle: speaking, eloquent; testifying. Root n-ṭ-q.
usage: Speaking, eloquent; in the Writings also of a sign that bears witness, as in ناطق بر 'testifying to'.

definition: adjective (active participle, fem.): penetrating, effective. Root n-f-dh.
usage: Penetrating, effective, as in کلمهٴ نافذه 'the penetrating Word' and قوهٴ نافذه 'penetrating power' of the Cause.

definition: noun: musk-bag, musk pod; náfiy-i mushk = pod of musk.
usage: The musk pod, a poetic image for the fragrance of God's Word spreading through the world.

definition: noun: name; renown.
usage: A name or renown, as in نام نیک 'a good name'.

definition: Adjective: unlimited, infinite (ná- + maḥdúd). Root ḥ-d-d.
usage: Unlimited, infinite, often of divine bounty or the potential of the human spirit.

definition: Nám (name) + indefinite -í: a name, any name.
noun with izáfih: fire, flame, blaze. Root n-w-r.
usage: Flame or blaze, often of war or of the love of God, as in نایرهٴ حرب 'the flame of war'.

definition: náy (reed flute) + -am (I am): I am the reed.
usage: Part of the mystical line من نایم و تو نایی 'I am the reed and Thou art the player', the soul as a flute voiced by God.

definition: ná "reed, reed-flute" + -í "you are"; "man náy-am u tu ná’í".
usage: From the line من نایم و تو نایی, the reed and its player as an image of the soul's dependence on God.

definition: negative of báyad: must not, should not.
verb: was not; negative past 3rd sg. of búdan.
notes: verb, negative past 3rd sg. of búdan

definition: Verb, 1st sg. negative past of búdan: I was not.
Negative past participle of búdan: has not been.
Verb, 3rd sg. negative subjunctive of dídan: (it) does not see.
Plural of natíjih: results, fruits, consequences. Root n-t-j.
usage: Results or fruits, as in نتایج عظیمه 'mighty results' of service to the Cause.

definition: Negative 3rd sg. subjunctive of tarsídan: (that) he not fear.
Verb: 1st sg. negative present/subjunctive of tavánistan, to be able; I cannot.
Noun: scattering, strewing as an offering; "nithár namúdan" = to bestow, lavish. Root n-th-r.
usage: A scattering as an offering; نثار نمودن 'to lavish' and جان نثار 'one who sacrifices his life', used of devoted believers.

definition: Proper name (from Nakhchivan): Mírzá ‘Alí-Akbar Nakhjavání.
negative present 3rd sg. of khwástan: does not want; also negative future auxiliary.
Negative 1st sg. of khwástan; future auxiliary: I will not.
Verb, 3rd pl. negative present of khástan: they do not want, (here) they should not allow.
negative 2nd pl. of khwástan as future auxiliary: you will not.
verb: I do not have; negative present 1st sg. of dáshtan.
Negative 3rd pl. present of dáshtan: they have not.
Negative 3rd sg. past of dáshtan: did not have.
Negative 1st person singular past of dáshtan: I did not have.
notes: verb, negative 1st sg. past of dáshtan

definition: Negative past participle of dáshtan: not having; nadáshtih báshad, should not have.
Negative 3rd sg. present/subjunctive of dánistan: knows not, recognises not.
Nidá (call, cry) with izáfih -y: the call of. Root n-d-w.
usage: A call or cry, very often the call of God, as in ندای الهی 'the Divine Call' and ندای ملکوت 'the call of the Kingdom'.

definition: nidá (call, voice) + -ash (his). Root n-d-w.
usage: 'His call', usually the summons of God or of His Manifestation raised to the world.

definition: noun nidá "call, cry" + indefinite -í. Root n-d-w.
usage: 'A call', as in ندایی بلند 'a loud call' raised for the Cause.

definition: Negative 3rd person plural subjunctive of dádan; "tashkíl nadihand" (that) they not form.
notes: verb, negative 3rd pl. subjunctive of dádan

definition: verb: does not drive/utter; negative 3rd sg. subjunctive of rándan.
Negative 3rd person plural subjunctive of rasándan; "bi-ẓuhúr narasánand" not bring to realization.
notes: verb, negative 3rd pl. subjunctive of rasándan

definition: Negative 3rd person singular subjunctive of raftan: (that it) not go; "hadar naravad" not be wasted.
notes: verb, negative 3rd sg. subjunctive of raftan

definition: Adjective/adverb: near, close.
noun: relation, connection; nisbat bi = in relation to. Root n-s-b.
usage: Relation or proportion; نسبت به 'towards, in relation to' is very common in the Writings.

definition: noun: breeze, gentle wind. Root n-s-m.
usage: A gentle breeze, often the breezes of God, as in نسیم عنایت 'the breeze of bounty' and نسیم ریاض ملکوت 'the breeze from the gardens of the Kingdom'.

definition: verb, 3rd sg. present/subjunctive of nishándan (to seat, set): seats, places.
nishán + indefinite -í: a sign, a trace.
usage: 'A sign' or 'a trace', as in نام و نشانی 'name and trace', often in phrases of utter effacement.

definition: past participle of nishastan: sitting, seated.
Verb: 3rd sg. negative present/subjunctive of shinákhtan, to know, recognize.
Arabic: help, victory, assistance; ‘alá nuṣrati amrí = to help My Cause. Root n-ṣ-r.
usage: Help or victory; in Arabic passages the assistance of God's Cause, as in علی نصرة امری 'to help My Cause'.

definition: Noun: help, aid, victory; "nuṣrat namúdan" = to assist. Root n-ṣ-r.
usage: Divine aid and victory, and the believers' service in promoting the Faith, as in نصرت امر الله 'assisting the Cause of God'.

definition: nuṣrat (help, assistance) + -ash (him). Root n-ṣ-r.
usage: 'Assisting him', from نصرت, the aid given by God or the believers.

definition: noun: speech, talk, address. Root n-ṭ-q.
usage: Speech or a public talk; ‘Abdu'l-Bahá's addresses in the West are called نطقها 'talks'.

definition: nuṭq (speech, talk) + plural -há + izáfih: talks of. Root n-ṭ-q.
usage: 'The talks of', used for ‘Abdu'l-Bahá's public addresses in Europe and America.

definition: nuṭq "speech, talk" + plural -há + indefinite -í: talks, addresses. Root n-ṭ-q.
usage: 'Talks' or 'addresses', usually of ‘Abdu'l-Bahá's public speeches.

definition: nuṭq (speech, address, talk) + indefinite -í: a speech. Root n-ṭ-q.
usage: 'A talk', a public address such as those ‘Abdu'l-Bahá gave in churches and halls.

definition: naẓar (gaze, regard) + -shán (their).
usage: 'Their gaze' or 'their view'; نظر also means regard or favour, as in نظر عنایت 'the glance of favour'.

definition: naẓar + -and: they are (in view); dar naẓar-and = they are remembered.
usage: In در نظرند 'they are in view', meaning 'they are remembered', a common reassurance in ‘Abdu'l-Bahá's letters.

definition: Noun naẓír "like, equal, peer" + indefinite -í. Root n-ẓ-r.
usage: 'A peer, an equal', as in بی نظیر 'peerless, unequalled'.

definition: Melody, song, tune. Root n-gh-m.
usage: A melody or song, often the melodies of the Kingdom or of the nightingale of the spirit, as in نغمهٴ ملکوت 'the melody of the Kingdom'.

definition: Verbal noun: banishment, exile; negation. Root n-f-y.
usage: Here banishment and exile, as of Bahá'u'lláh; elsewhere negation, paired with اثبات 'affirmation'.

definition: Feminine of nafís: precious, valuable. Root n-f-s.
usage: Precious, valuable, as in آثار نفیسه 'precious writings' or gifts.

definition: plural of naqíṣih: defects, shortcomings. Root n-q-ṣ.
usage: Defects or shortcomings, contrasted with کمالات 'perfections'.

definition: Noun: deficiency, loss, decrease. Root n-q-ṣ.
usage: Deficiency or loss, the opposite of کمال 'perfection' and زیادت 'increase'.

definition: Noun: breaking, violation (of the Covenant). Root n-q-ḍ.
usage: Breaking, especially breaking of the Covenant; ناقضین 'Covenant-breakers' are those who violate it.

definition: Noun: point, dot; centre (here with izáfih). Root n-q-ṭ.
usage: A point or centre; نقطهٴ اولی 'the Primal Point' is a title of the Báb.

definition: noun: transmission, narration; "naql kardan" = to relate, report. Root n-q-l.
usage: Transmission or narration; نقل کردن 'to relate, report' a saying or event.

definition: adjective: visible, apparent, manifest.
usage: Visible, manifest, often of signs of God or of results appearing in the world.

definition: 1st pl. present/subjunctive of namúdan: we do, we make.
usage: Formal 'we do', forming compound verbs in prayers and letters.

definition: adjective: evident, visible, manifest.
usage: Evident, manifest, as in نمودار گردید 'became manifest'.

definition: namún (guide, one who shows) + ast (is); in "rah-namún ast", is the guide.
usage: Part of رهنمون است 'is the guide', of God or the Teachings guiding souls.

definition: Impersonal verb: one cannot, it is not possible (negative of tavánistan).
Negative 1st sg. present of rasándan: I do not cause, do not deliver (harm).
verb: they do not hear; negative 3rd pl. present of shanídan.
noun namíqah "letter, missive" + -k "your". Root n-m-q.
usage: 'Your letter'; نمیقه is a standard Arabic opening word in ‘Abdu'l-Bahá's replies, as in قد وصلت نمیقتک 'your letter has arrived'.

definition: Verb, 1st pl. negative present of kardan: we do not do.
verb: I was not saying; negative past continuous 1st sg. of guftan.
notes: verb, past continuous 1st sg. of guftan

definition: Arabic verb, 1st pl. imperfect of naṣara: We will assist. Root n-ṣ-r.
usage: 'We will assist', God's promise of aid to the faithful, as in ننصر من قام علی خدمة امری 'We will assist whoso arises to serve My Cause'.

definition: negative present 3rd sg. of namúdan: does not do; does not seem.
verb: you (pl.) do not do/make; negative 2nd pl. subjunctive of namúdan.
Negative 1st sg. past of namúdan: I did not (pay attention).
verb, 3rd pl. past of nihádan: they placed, laid.
Past participle of nahádan: placed, set, put.
Verbal noun of navákhtan: caressing, kindness, cherishing.
usage: Tender kindness and cherishing, often of God's loving care, as in نوازش و عنایت 'kindness and favour'.

definition: Adjective: of early spring, vernal; naw (new) + bahár (spring) + -í.
usage: Vernal, of early spring, often figurative for the spiritual springtime of the new Revelation.

definition: núrániyyat (luminosity) + ast. Root n-w-r.
usage: From نورانیت 'radiance, spirituality', a frequent ideal for hearts and souls, as in نورانیت قلوب 'radiance of hearts'.

definition: Persian New Year at the spring equinox; a Bahá'í holy day.
usage: Naw-Rúz, the Persian New Year at the vernal equinox and a Bahá'í holy day, the first day of the Badí‘ calendar.

definition: personal name (Miss Nuri), recipient of greetings.
Verb: 1st sg. past of nivishtan, to write.
infinitive: to write, writing.
Verb: 3rd pl. past of núshídan, to drink.
usage: Drank, often figurative, as of those who drank from the cup of guidance or of the love of God.

definition: Negative 3rd pl. present/subjunctive of pazíruftan: they do not accept.
verb: I did not approve; negative 1st sg. past of pasandídan.
Negative 3rd sg. past of kardan: did not (do).
verb: I did not do; negative 1st sg. past of kardan.
Verbal noun of nigáshtan: writing, composing.
usage: Writing or composing, as in نگارش نامه 'writing a letter'.

definition: noun: look, glance; nigáh kardan "to look".
verb: did not let, did not allow; negative 3rd sg. past of gudháshtan.
negative past participle of gardídan: has not become; "faramúsh nagardídih" = not forgotten.
verb: did not take; negative 3rd sg. past of giriftan.
verb, 1st sg. negative past of guftan: I did not say.
verb, 3rd sg. negative past of árámídan: did not rest.
usage: Did not rest, as of one who laboured without rest in service.

definition: verb, 1st sg. negative past of yáftan: I did not find.
negative present 3rd pl. subjunctive of ávardan: (that) they not bring; bijá niyávarand = not fulfill.
verb: does not come; negative 3rd sg. subjunctive of ámadan.
níyyat "intention" + -am "my". Root n-w-y.
usage: 'My intention'; نیت 'intention' is stressed in the Writings, as in نیت خالص 'pure intention'.

definition: Negative 3rd person plural present of hastan: they are not.
Persian plural suffix -há, here split from its noun by ZWNJ (yád-dásht-há, notes).
Active participle: destroying, demolisher, subverter. Root h-d-m.
usage: Destroying or subverting, as of forces that undermine the foundation of religion, as in هادم بنیان 'destroyer of the foundation'.

definition: proper name: Harvey (Dr. Leon Harvey, a Unitarian minister).
hujúm (attack, assault) + rá (object marker). Root h-j-m.
usage: Attack or assault, as of enemies assailing the Cause.

definition: Noun/adjective: in vain, wasted; "hadar raftan" = to be lost, go to waste. Root h-d-r.
usage: In هدر رفتن 'to go to waste', of efforts or blood spent in vain.

definition: noun: guidance, right path. Root h-d-y.
usage: Guidance, the right path, as in نور هدی 'the light of guidance' and the Qur'ánic هدی للمتقین 'a guidance to the God-fearing'.

definition: Arabic demonstrative (masc.): this.
adverb: wherever, everywhere.
pronoun: whoever, everyone (har + kas).
Pronoun: each one, every one.
hast + -í: you are; also noun: existence.
usage: As a noun هستی 'existence, being', as in عالم هستی 'the world of being'; here 'you are'.

definition: 2nd pl. present of hastan: you are.
verb, 1st pl. present of hastan: we are.
Arabic interrogative particle introducing a yes/no question; is? are? (Qur'ánic quotation).
Noun: destruction, perdition, death. Root h-l-k.
usage: Perdition or ruin, the fate of those who turn away, contrasted with نجات 'salvation'.

definition: demonstrative: that very, the same.
adverb: at that very moment.
himmat (high aspiration) + ast: is aspiration. Root h-m-m.
usage: From همت 'high resolve, aspiration', a key virtue in the Writings, as in همت بلند 'lofty endeavour' in serving the Cause.

definition: noun: accompanying, support, companionship.
usage: Accompanying or support, as in همراهی و مساعدت 'support and help'.

definition: noun: companion, one who sits together with another.
usage: A companion, often of God or of virtues as the soul's companions.

definition: adverb: always, constantly.
usage: Always, constantly, in wishes and prayers.

definition: proper name: India.
Proper name: India.
Noun: time, season, moment.
usage: Time or moment, as in هنگام صبح 'at dawn'.

definition: Plural of hájis; idle fancies, misgivings, passing thoughts. Root h-j-s.
usage: Idle fancies and misgivings that veil the soul, paired with ظنون 'vain imaginings' and اوهام 'idle fancies'.

definition: noun: air, weather; with izáfih. Root h-w-y.
usage: Air or atmosphere; هوای here 'air', but هوی also means 'passion, selfish desire' in the Writings.

definition: Part of the name "King's Weigh House" (church in London) transcribed in Persian; elsewhere havas "whim".
part of a Western surname (Mr. and Mrs. Hook-Lerk?), recipients of greetings.
Arabic feminine pronoun: she, it (Qur'án 36:78 "wa hiya ramím").
pronoun: none, not one.
noun: form, body; association, committee (Hay’at-i Ittiḥád = Committee of Union and Progress). Root h-y-'.
usage: A body, form or committee; in later Bahá'í usage هیئت names assemblies and boards; here هیئت اتحاد 'the Committee of Union and Progress'.

definition: adjective: arriving, entering; várid shudan "to arrive". Root w-r-d.
usage: Arriving, entering; وارد شدن 'to arrive', as in arrival of ‘Abdu'l-Bahá in a city.

definition: Proper name: a Western believer, Mrs. Wares (?) addressed as amatu'lláh.
active participle: happening, occurring; váqi‘ gardídan = to take place. Root w-q-‘.
usage: Occurring, located; واقع گردیدن 'to take place', and در واقع 'in reality'.

definition: Steamship (from French vapeur).
usage: Steamer, from French vapeur, used of ‘Abdu'l-Bahá's sea voyages.

definition: adjective: inner, intuitive, heartfelt, of conscience. Root w-j-d.
usage: Inner, of conscience, as in احساسات وجدانی 'heartfelt feelings'.

definition: Noun: face; manner, way; "bi-ayy-i-vajh" by any means. Root w-j-h.
usage: Face, manner; وجه الله 'the Face of God', and بأی وجه 'by any means'.

definition: noun vajh "face, countenance" + indefinite -í: a face. Root w-j-h.
usage: 'A face' or 'a manner', as in به وجهی 'in some manner'.

definition: vujúdí "existential, of being" + ast "is". Root w-j-d.
usage: From وجودی 'existential, of being', used in philosophical passages on the reality of existence.

definition: noun: leaf, sheet; foil (varaq-i-zar "gold leaf"). Root w-r-q.
usage: A leaf or sheet; ورقه 'leaf' is also a Bahá'í term for women believers.

definition: Adjective: vast, wide, extensive. Root w-s-‘.
usage: Vast or extensive, as of the range of God's mercy or of the field of service.

definition: Ritual ablution before prayer. Root w-ḍ-'.
usage: Ritual ablution before prayer, a law of the Kitáb-i-Aqdas.

definition: Homeland, native country; ham-vaṭan, compatriot. Root w-ṭ-n.
usage: Homeland; Bahá'u'lláh's saying that 'pride is not for him who loveth his country' redirects love from وطن to the whole world.

definition: noun: promise; va‘dih dádan = to promise. Root w-‘-d.
usage: A promise, especially God's promises in scripture; وعدهٴ الهی 'the divine promise'.

definition: vaqt (time) + ast: it is time.
Conjunction: when, at the time that.
Arabic verb, 1st sg. perfect of waqafa: I stood; with ‘alá, I became acquainted with. Root w-q-f.
usage: In وقفت علی 'I became acquainted with', a frequent phrase in ‘Abdu'l-Bahá's Arabic replies to letters.

definition: va + ma‘ání (plural of ma‘ná): and meanings, inner truths. Root ‘-n-y.
