usage: Meanings or inner truths, as in معانی کلمات 'the meanings of the Words', contrasted with outward words.

definition: Part of a Western proper name "Van Limert" (vun Limert), as vowelled in the text.
second syllable of Kingsway in "Kingsway Hall" (London), written separately.
pronoun: he, she, him, her (literary).
Proper name: Mr. Vail (probably Albert Vail, American Unitarian minister and Bahá'í).
va "and" + yagánigí "oneness, unity" (written joined).
usage: Oneness or unity, as in یگانگی عالم انسانی 'the oneness of humanity'.

definition: noun: piece, fragment; coin (pieces of silver).
noun: guard, watchman, protector.
usage: Guardian or watchman, often of God as protector.

definition: Proper name: Mrs. Pollock (?), a Western believer.
pákí "purity" + ast "is".
usage: From پاکی 'purity', of heart and deeds.

definition: noun: end, conclusion.
usage: End, as in بی پایان 'endless', often of God's bounty.

definition: 3rd sg. present/subjunctive of pazíruftan: accept; ḥuṣúl pazírad, be realised.
usage: In compound verbs like حصول پذیرد 'be realised' and تحقق پذیرد 'be fulfilled'.

definition: Partaw (ray, beam) + indefinite -í: a ray of light.
usage: 'A ray', often of divine light, as in پرتو شمس حقیقت 'a ray of the Sun of Truth'.

definition: verb: they engaged in, attended to; 3rd pl. past of pardákhtan.
usage: Engaged in, as in به خدمت پرداختند 'they engaged in service'.

definition: past participle of pardákhtan: having engaged in, devoted to.
imperative of pardákhtan: devote yourself to, engage in.
verb: engages in, devotes himself to; 3rd sg. subjunctive of pardákhtan.
present stem of parvardan as suffix: -nurturing; ján-parvar = soul-nourishing.
usage: Nourishing, in compounds like جان پرور 'soul-nourishing' and روح پرور 'spirit-refreshing'.

definition: -parvar "nurturing, fostering" + plural -án; ḥurriyyat-parvarán "liberty-lovers".
Noun: the Lord, Sustainer, Nourisher (God).
usage: The Lord, Sustainer and Nourisher, a Persian name of God common in prayers.

definition: Noun: nurturing, fostering; "tan-parvarí" = pampering the body, self-indulgence.
usage: In compounds like تن پروری 'self-indulgence', which the Writings warn against.

definition: proper name; also Pleiades (Parvín).
adjective: distressed, troubled, dishevelled, scattered.
usage: Distressed or scattered, often contrasted with جمع 'gathered, composed' and of hearts troubled by separation.

definition: paríshán (troubled, distressed) + ast: is in disarray.
noun: breast, udder.
usage: Breast; often in the image of a child nourished at the breast of divine grace.

definition: Plural pisarán "boys, sons" + -ast "is".
pisarán (sons, boys) + -and (they are): they are (like) sons.
panj (five) + sál (year).
Ordinal number: fifth.
verb: they put on, wore; 3rd pl. past of púshídan.
Past participle of púshídan: worn, put on; also hidden.
usage: Worn or hidden; چشم پوشیدن 'to close one's eyes to', i.e. to renounce, is common in the Writings.

definition: plural of púl "money" + indefinite -í: some monies, what sums.
adverb: one after another, continually.
preposition/adverb: before, forward; "písh ávardan" = bring about.
Noun: precedence, being ahead; "gúy-i sabqat va píshí" the prize of precedence.
usage: Precedence, in گوی سبقت و پیشی 'the ball of precedence', a polo image for excelling others in service.

definition: noun: body, form, figure; dú paykar = Gemini (the Twins).
usage: Body or figure, as in پیکر عالم 'the body of the world'.

definition: Number: four (poetic form of chahár).
usage: Four, poetic form, as in چار سو 'the four directions'.

definition: Noun: eye; chashm púshídan, to renounce, close one's eyes to.
usage: The eye, often of spiritual perception, as in چشم بینا 'a seeing eye'.

definition: plural of chashm: eyes.
adverb (colloquial): how.
adverb: how much, how.
noun: meadow, grassland (chaman + -zár).
usage: A meadow, used in images of the spiritual springtime.

definition: conjunction: as, just as; also if.
adjective/pronoun: several, some, a few; also "for a while".
Adjective: several, so many.
Conjunction: because, since.
adverb: how, in what way.
noun: work, deed, action, affair.
usage: Work, deed or affair, as in کار و کوشش 'work and effort'.

definition: noun: palate, mouth; desire.
usage: Palate or desire, as in شیرین کام 'sweet-palated', of those who taste divine grace.

definition: feminine form of kámil: perfect, complete. Root k-m-l.
usage: Perfect or complete, as in قوهٴ کامله 'perfect power' and حکمت کامله 'perfect wisdom'.

definition: Arabic perfect 3rd m. sg. of kána "to be"; bi-ayyi wajhin kána = by whatever means. Root k-w-n.
noun: beings, all created things, the universe; plural of ká’in. Root k-w-n.
usage: All created things, the universe, as in حقائق کائنات 'the realities of all created things'.

definition: plural of kabír: the great, elders; "ṣighár u kibár" = young and old. Root k-b-r.
usage: The great or elders, as in صغار و کبار 'young and old'.

definition: Proper name: Mr. Cuthbert, an English believer (Arthur Cuthbert).
noun: abundance, multitude, great number. Root k-th-r.
usage: Multitude, contrasted with وحدت 'unity' in mystical passages on the One and the many.

definition: adjective: many, numerous, abundant. Root k-th-r.
usage: Many or abundant, as in جمع کثیر 'a great number'.

definition: Interrogative/indefinite: which; "har kudám" each one.
Aversion, disgust, dislike. Root k-r-h.
usage: Aversion or dislike, as of loathsome qualities.

definition: infinitive: to do, to make.
verb, 2nd sg. past of kardan: you did.
1st pl. past of kardan: we did, we made.
Noun: person, anyone; "har kas" whoever.
noun, plural of kas + -í: certain people, those who.
Verbal noun: acquiring, earning, gaining; trade. Root k-s-b.
usage: Acquiring, earning, as in کسب کمالات 'acquiring perfections' and کسب فیض 'receiving grace'.

definition: Past participle of kishtan, to sow (here); also kushtih, killed, from kushtan.
usage: Sown, in images of the seed sown in hearts; also killed (کشته) of martyrs.

definition: Verbal noun: uncovering, revealing, discovery; "kashf-i ḥijáb" = removal of the veil. Root k-sh-f.
usage: Unveiling or discovery, as in کشف حقائق 'discovery of realities'; کشف حجاب 'removal of the veil'.

definition: Noun: country, land, realm.
adverb: wholly, all together. Root k-l-l.
noun: word, utterance; plural kalimát. Root k-l-m.
usage: Word, especially the Word of God, as in کلمة الله 'the Word of God' and کلمات مکنونه 'the Hidden Words'.

definition: Noun: reed pen, pen (literary).
usage: The reed pen, often the Pen of ‘Abdu'l-Bahá or the Supreme Pen of revelation.

definition: Adjective: total, universal, general; great. Root k-l-l.
usage: Universal, as in عقل کلی 'Universal Mind'; also general or great.

definition: kalísá + izáfih: church.
kalísiyá (church) + ast: is (of a) church.
adjective: universal, comprehensive, total; feminine of kullí. Root k-l-l.
usage: Universal or all, as in کلیهٴ امور 'all affairs'.

definition: noun: help, assistance; "kumak kardan" = to help.
Adjective from kamm: quantitative. Root k-m-m.
usage: Quantitative, paired with کیفی 'qualitative' in philosophical passages.

definition: Loanword (French conférence): lecture, talk.
Plural of kaníz: handmaidens, maidservants.
usage: Handmaidens, often کنیزان الهی 'the handmaidens of God', the women believers.

definition: Adjective: old, ancient, aged.
usage: Old or ancient, as in جهان کهن 'the ancient world'.

definition: noun: negligence, shortcoming; kútáhí kardan = to fall short.
usage: Shortcoming or negligence, as in کوتاهی ننمایید 'do not fall short'.

definition: Noun: child.
noun: childhood (kúdak, child + -í).
adjective: blind.
usage: Blind, often figurative for spiritual blindness.

definition: Verb, 3rd pl. subjunctive/present of kúshídan: (that) they strive.
usage: Strive, in exhortations such as بکوشند 'let them strive' in service.

definition: verb: I strove; past 1st sg. of kúshídan.
verb: they strove; past 3rd pl. of kúshídan.
noun: smallness; az kúchikí = from childhood.
Noun: star; "kawkab-i Thurayyá" the Pleiades. Root k-w-k-b.
usage: A star, also a figure for a soul or a believer shining in the heavens of the Cause.

definition: Probably a misprint for magar "unless, perhaps, is it that"; interrogative/conditional particle.
Adjective: qualitative, relating to kayf (quality, how).
usage: Qualitative, paired with کمی 'quantitative' in philosophical passages.

definition: English word "King's", in King's Weigh House (London church).
noun: begging, beggary; gadá "beggar" + -í.
usage: Beggary, often in humble prayers before God's wealth.

definition: Verb, 3rd sg. past of guzáshtan: put, laid; "biná guzáshtan" to begin.
verb, 3rd pl. past of guzáshtan: they put, laid, began.
Past participle of guzáshtan: left, placed; "báqí guzáshtih nashud" was not left.
Verb, 3rd sg. past of guzashtan: passed, went by.
past participle of guzashtan: past; guzashtih az = apart from.
past 2nd sg. of guzashtan: you passed; az ... guzashtan = to renounce.
usage: In از ... گذشتن 'to renounce', of giving up self and the world for God.

definition: Conjunction: if (poetic short form of agar).
Infinitive: to take, seize; "‘aks giriftan" to take a photograph.
usage: In the Writings 'to take, seize, receive'; common in compounds such as قرار گرفتن 'to be established' and پیش گرفتن 'to adopt (a path)'.

definition: verb: they took; past 3rd pl. of giriftan (also honorific singular).
usage: Past of گرفتن 'they took'; often in the sense of seizing or adopting, as in راه ... گرفتند 'they took the path of'.

definition: Noun: pledge, pawn, mortgage; dar girav, mortgaged.
usage: Rare in the Writings; dar girav 'held in pledge', used figuratively of a heart or soul bound to something.

definition: Present participle/adjective of gíristan, to weep: weeping, tearful.
usage: Describes tearful supplication, as in گریان و نالان 'weeping and lamenting', of lovers separated from the Beloved.

definition: verb: I became; I wandered; 1st sg. past of gashtan.
usage: Past of گشتن 'to become; wander'; as an auxiliary it forms passive and change-of-state phrases.

definition: past 3rd pl. of gashtan: they became.
usage: Past of گشتن 'they became'; frequent with adjectives, as in منقطع گشتند 'they became detached'.

definition: past participle of gashtan: become, turned; forms perfect tenses.
usage: Past participle of گشتن 'become, turned'; forms perfect and passive phrases such as ظاهر گشته 'has become manifest'.

definition: Verb: 1st sg. past of guftan, to say.
usage: Past of گفتن 'I said'; introduces direct speech in narrative passages.

definition: Noun: rose garden, flower garden.
usage: A frequent image for the garden of the spirit or of the divine Cause, as in گلزار معانی 'the rose garden of inner meanings'.

definition: plural of gumgashtih: the lost, those gone astray.
usage: Those who have strayed from the path of God, typically in calls to guide the gumgashtigán back to the right way.

definition: gunáh "sin" + ast "is".
usage: Combines گناه 'sin' with است; used in statements that something is sinful, as in backbiting is a grievous sin.

definition: Gunáh (sin) + indefinite -í + ast (is) joined: is a sin.
usage: 'Is a sin'; used in moral injunctions naming conduct that is sinful in the sight of God.

definition: proper name: probably Gotha, a town in Germany.
usage: Appears in ‘Abdu'l-Bahá's letters as a place name, probably the German town of Gotha.

definition: Noun: grave, tomb.
usage: Used of the grave and of spiritual death, as in the image of souls buried in the grave of heedlessness.

definition: noun: ear; corner (chahár gúsh = four-cornered).
usage: Mostly 'ear'; in the Writings the inner ear that hears the divine call, as in گوش هوش 'the ear of the spirit'.

definition: noun: corner, nook.
usage: 'Corner, nook'; often in گوشه و کنار 'every corner', of the spread of the Faith to all regions.

definition: Adjective: various, diverse, manifold.
usage: 'Various, diverse'; used of the diversity of peoples, languages and religions united in the Cause.

definition: noun: cheek; also kind, manner.
usage: 'Cheek' or 'kind, manner'; in the Writings mostly in بدین گونه 'in this manner' and هر گونه 'every kind of'.

definition: Noun: ball; gúy-i-sabqat rubúdan, to win the prize.
usage: Chiefly in the idiom گوی سبقت ربودن 'to carry off the ball of precedence', to outstrip all in service.

definition: Verb, 1st sg. subjunctive/present of guftan: (that) I say, call.
usage: Present of گفتن '(that) I say, call'; common in rhetorical turns like چه گویم 'what shall I say'.

definition: present 3rd sg. subjunctive of giriftan: takes, receives.
usage: Present of گرفتن 'takes, receives'; frequent in phrases such as قرار گیرد 'be established'.

definition: proper name: part of a Western woman's name, "Mrs. Game(s)".
usage: Part of a Western believer's name in ‘Abdu'l-Bahá's letters.

definition: noun: note, memorandum.
usage: 'Note, memorandum'; occurs in letters referring to notes taken by pilgrims or secretaries.

definition: Noun: memorial, keepsake, reminder.
usage: 'Memorial, keepsake'; used of a lasting memorial left in the world, as in یادگار باقی 'an enduring remembrance'.

definition: Yárán (friends) + object marker rá joined.
usage: 'The friends' as direct object; یاران is a common term for the believers.

definition: past 3rd pl. of yáftan: they found, attained.
usage: Past of یافتن 'they found, attained'; often of attaining a spiritual goal, as in بلقای الهی فائز یافتند.

definition: verb: you (pl.) found; 2nd pl. past of yáftan.
usage: Past of یافتن 'you found'; used when addressing believers who have attained faith or a bounty.

definition: Arabic imperfect form V: it changes; lan yatabaddal = it will never change. Root b-d-l.
usage: Echoes the Qur'anic assurance that God's way does not change, as in لن یتبدّل 'it shall never be changed'.

definition: Arabic verb, 3rd sg. imperfect form V: changes; "lan yataghayyar" will never change. Root gh-y-r.
usage: In لن یتغیّر 'it will never change', of the unchanging divine law or covenant.

definition: Noun yatím "orphan" + indefinite -í. Root y-t-m.
usage: 'An orphan'; the Writings repeatedly enjoin care and education of orphans.

definition: verb: he makes, renders; imperfect of ja‘ala. Root j-‘-l.
usage: 'He makes, renders'; common in Arabic passages about God making something a sign or a cause.

definition: noun, plural: followers of Mírzá Yaḥyá (Azalís).
usage: The followers of Mírzá Yaḥyá (Azalís), the opponents of Bahá'u'lláh within the Bábí community.

definition: Arabic form IV verb + pronoun: that He may admit him (into paradise). Root d-kh-l.
usage: 'That He may admit him', of God admitting souls into paradise or His mercy; Qur'anic phrasing.

definition: Arabic verb, 3rd pl. jussive of ra'á: (if) they see. Qur'án 6:25.
usage: Quoting Qur'an 6:25, 'if they see every sign they will not believe', applied to deniers of the Manifestation.

definition: proper name: Yazd, city in central Iran, site of the 1903 persecutions.
usage: The city of Yazd in Iran, remembered in the Writings for the persecution and martyrdom of Bahá'ís in 1903.

definition: Noun: God (Persian).
usage: The Persian name of God, frequent in the Writings, as in بندگان یزدان 'the servants of God'.

definition: Adjective from Yazdán (God): divine, godly.
usage: 'Divine, godly'; as in فیض یزدانی 'divine bounty' and تعالیم یزدانی 'divine teachings'.

definition: Arabic verb, 3rd masc. sg. imperfect of istawá (form VIII): to be equal (Qur'án 39:9).
usage: Qur'anic question 'are they equal?' (39:9), contrasting those who know with those who know not.

definition: Arabic verb form IV, 3rd sg. + pronoun: makes Him manifest; in "Man Yuẓhiruhu'lláh" (Him Whom God shall make manifest). Root ẓ-h-r.
usage: Part of من یظهره الله 'Him Whom God shall make manifest', the Báb's title for the Promised One, fulfilled in Bahá'u'lláh.

definition: noun: the Jews, the Jewish people.
usage: 'The Jews', the people of Moses; mentioned in discussions of the succession of religions and their reception of Christ.

definition: Proper name: Judas (Iscariot), with izáfih.
usage: Judas Iscariot, cited in the Writings as the example of the betrayer of a Manifestation.

definition: Proper name: Joseph; here a believer named Yúsuf.
usage: Joseph, the son of Jacob, whose story is a recurring symbol of the Manifestation; also a personal name of believers.

definition: Second half of "Iskhar-yúṭí" (Iscariot), split in the text.
usage: Part of the name Judas Iscariot.

definition: Arabic verb, 3rd m. pl. subjunctive/jussive form IV: (they will not) believe. Root a-m-n.
usage: Qur'anic phrasing of those who will not believe even when they see signs.

definition: Yawm (day) + indefinite -í: a day.
usage: 'A day'; یوم is common in the Writings for the Day of God.

definition: Adverb: one day, some day.
usage: 'One day, some day'; used in narrative and in anticipations of what will come to pass.

definition: yik + sá‘at: one hour.
usage: 'One hour'; used in letters for short periods of time.

definition: Noun phrase: one person, someone.
usage: 'One person, someone'; common in letters referring to an individual.

definition: Adjective: sole, only, unique.
usage: 'Sole, unique, matchless'; in the Writings of God, as in خداوند یگانه 'the one God', and of the oneness of humanity.

definition: noun: oneness, unity.
usage: 'Oneness, unity'; central in the Writings, as in یگانگی عالم انسانی 'the oneness of the world of humanity'.

definition: Summer quarters, countryside retreat (Turkish origin).
usage: 'Summer quarters'; occurs in letters about stays in the hills during summer.
